205046.description:
Yan Jingjun and Zhu Gong are two high school students who like to make experiments. Both compete with each other, showing off the crazy things they came with at the time. This often leads to disaster, to the point of even creating an alien form in the laboratory!

(Source: INKR)

title.native: 蠢萌科学家VS眼镜拳法家
title.romaji: Chun Meng Kexuejia VS Yanjing Quanfa Jia

205047.description:
"Before me array the soldiers, line up to fight". This protection spell in traditional Chinese culture includes nine characters, each contains enormous energy of a different kind. With the power of the nine characters of truth, Ye Xuan is reborn from his fall. The power in the nine words was thus drained. In order to regain the power of revenge, Ye Xuan embarked on the road to reboot the nine characters of truth.

(Source: MangaToon)
synonyms: Contender - Return of Nine Words Emperor!
The Return Of Emperor Ye Xuan

205048.description:
The zombie apocalypse suddenly descended. As the virus spreads among everyone and they are faced with countless walking corpses. How should they handle it? And how do they survive?

(Source: Coolmic)
synonyms: The Walking Dead in the White Night

205049.description:
Lin’s life is about to be over. After failing to pitch her comic book over 110 times, she’s broke and—worst of all—she’s 26-year-old and doesn’t even have a boyfriend yet! That is until a young college boy rents her extra room and begins staying with her. Well, that solves some of her problems anyway.

Under the eaves of this small home, two people share their joys, their struggles, and learn to share their lives together.
synonyms: The Witch and the Warm Boy
The Witch and the Warm Man

title.native: 24時間、愛の檻。～守ってくれるはずのイケメンSPは一番キケンな男でした
title.romaji: 24-jikan, Ai no Ori.: Mamotte Kureru Hazu no Ikemen SP wa Ichiban Kiken na Otoko de Shita

205051.description:
"No one else can do this but you."

She's engaged to her CEO for one night a week?! Miri, a CEO's secretary, has recently been dumped by her boyfriend for being too much of a workaholic. Meanwhile, Mr. Takatsu, the CEO she works for, is rumored to be a womanizer with a new girl every day of the week. While Miri is on a date her mom set her up with, Mr. Takatsu suddenly appears and throws everything into chaos! Miri is angry at the sudden interruption, but Mr. Takatsu asks her out of the blue to be his fiancée every Wednesday...?! "I'm so glad my fiancée is such a go-getter." Miri finds herself ensnared by his sweet words in this strategic adult game of love!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: Wednesday Fiancée: What if the Handsome Womanizing CEO Got Serious?
title.native: 水曜日の婚約者～女たらしのハイスペ社長が本気になったら
title.romaji: Suiyoubi no Konyakusha: Onnatarashi no High-Spec Shachou ga Honki ni Nattara

205052.description:
High schooler Yokoya has a bad reputation at school. To change this, he comes up with a genius plan... lie about having amnesia and take on a whole new persona! However, in a stroke of wild circumstances, the new Yokoya finds himself suddenly surrounded...with three girls claiming to be his girlfriend?! This is the story of Yokoya, the boy who unwillingly becomes entangled in a three-way harem!

(Source: Renta!)

205053.description:
I tested out a hypnosis app on the girl I like...

(Source: Coolmic)

title.native: 催芽さんは催眠アプられたい

205055.description:
A master of love, who is only worthless when it comes to the person they like, begins a secret mission! While working a day job at Men's Cosplay Cafe and a night job as a Cabaret Hostess, without regard to gender, she'd never had trouble making people fall in love and reigned as the "Love Master." But, with the childhood friend she likes, Makoto, it seems like none of her techniques work...! Disheartened, the first time Makoto reacted to her was when she spilled a drink on herself making her clothes see-through. This was it! A Fan-Service filled love comedy with one girl bent on making her childhood friend fall for her, one sneak peek at a time!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: プロジェクト・ラッキーすけべ～恋愛マスターは本命にだけポンコツです。
title.romaji: Project Lucky Sukebe: Renai Master wa Honmei ni Dake Ponkotsu desu.

205056.description:
"The floor plan of this dungeon looks familiar." I fall into a trap right as I reach the place of my reincarnation!? The key to victory is my knowledge of this cursed apartment house!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: From Cursed House to Isekai Dungeon
title.native: 事故物件に呪われて死んだおじさん、異世界でダンジョン平定する
title.romaji: Jiko Bukken ni Norowarete Shinda Oji-san, Isekai de Dungeon Heitei suru

205057.description:
"But she's mine, isn't she?" My girlfriend was supposed to love me, and only me, but somehow, she found happiness with another man. Taichi is your average office worker who's been dating his girlfriend for five years, ever since they were in college. He has no doubt that Mirei loves him, but when she hints at marriage, he brushes it off, instead wanting to use her as someone convenient to do his housework and take care of his needs. However, he soon becomes infatuated with Hinako, a bright and beautiful girl he met at a mixer. Then, while on a date with Hinako, he sees Mirei with a handsome man he's never seen before. Could it be that he was the one who got dumped...?

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: A Story of Foolish Ignorance: How I Lost the Girlfriend I Took for Granted
title.native: あなたじゃなくても大丈夫でした。～見下していた彼女を失った、愚かな俺の顛末
title.romaji: Anata Janakute mo Daijoubu de Shita.: Mikudashite Ita Kanojo o Ushinatta, Oroka na Ore no Tenmatsu

205058.description:
Aoi, a part-time housewife stuck in a passionless marriage, one day stumbles upon her husband's, Kazuhisa, secret social media account. Suspecting an affair, she decides to uncover the truth by meeting him disguised as "Mitsuba." To her shock, not only does Kazuhisa fail to recognize her, he also begins to flirt intensely with "Mitsuba"!Distrustful yet curious, Aoi is taken aback by how unexpectedly comfortable it feels to spend time with her husband again. As the night wears on, the two end up at a love hotel together."Tonight, I'm not 'Aoi'. I'm a different person." Caught between suspicion and rekindled feelings, their tangled emotions as husband and wife begin to collide!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: A Secret Affair With My Husband
title.native: 今夜、私は夫と不倫する。
title.romaji: Konya, Watashi wa Otto to Furin Suru.

205059.description:
My best friend and my boyfriend may have betrayed me, but somehow, I managed to turn my entire life around with the help of a hot CEO?! Koharu, an office worker, has been dating her boyfriend for almost two years and is expecting a proposal any day now. Her best friend and coworker assures her that their upcoming anniversary will be an unforgettable memory... or so she claims. However, on the day of her date, Koharu accidentally crashes an engagement party for none other than her boyfriend and her best friend! Her boyfriend accuses her of lies she doesn't even remember, and she's surrounded by icy glares from every direction. With no one to turn to, the person who comes to her rescue is none other than a handsome CEO, a client from her dinner event. Why is he saying that he was about to ask her out?! Suddenly, she's whisked away from the depths of despair and into a brand-new life...!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: My Best Friend Stole My Boyfriend But I Got the Hot CEO
title.native: サレカノ革命～親友に男を奪われたけど、ハイスぺ社長に愛されます～
title.romaji: Sarekano Kakumei: Shinyuu ni Otoko wo Ubawa Retakedo, High-Spec Shachou ni Ai Saremasu

205060.description:
A box, a sunbeam, or a comfy lap, there are plenty of places to find a napping cat! When they aren’t stalking or snacking, you can always find a cat that’s napping. Maybe they’re curled up on the couch or stretched out by the door, or they found their way into an empty box that fits them just right. No matter where or how a cat is sleeping, there’s one thing for certain: it’s adorable! So, curl up and enjoy these pawsitively adorable cats as they find their comfy spot.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: あっち こっち ネッチ!

205061.description: Manga adaptation based of Kyuuzou Kobayashi's 1978 mystery novel "Koutei no Inai Hachigatsu".
synonyms: DER KAISER IST NICHT AM AUGUST

title.native: 皇帝のいない八月 鉤十字の葬送
title.romaji: Koutei no Inai Hachigatsu: Kagijuuji no Sousou

205062.description:
1. Nemuri Hime (眠り姫) [Mami Takezaki - Original Story: Jacob and Wilhelm Grimm]
2. Cinderella (シンデレラ) [Chieko Ikesumi - Original Story: Jacob and Wilhelm Grimm]
3. Hansel to Gretel (ヘンゼルとグレーテル) [Tomo Kazuhashi - Original Story: Jacob and Wilhelm Grimm]
4. Tsugumi no Hige no Ousama (つぐみの髭の王さま) [Shiho Takase - Original Story: Jacob and Wilhelm Grimm]
5. Aoi Tori (青い鳥) [Junko Okada - Original Story: Maurice Maeterlinck]
6. Oedipus Ou (オイディプス王) [Kazuko Teradate - Original Story: Sophocle]

title.native: まんがグリム童話 禁断の性編
title.romaji: Manga Grimm Douwa: Kindan no Sei-hen

205065.description:
Yoshida Satoshi is a pioneer of youth manga, producing numerous hit series such as "Shonan Bakusozoku," "Chotto Yoroshiku!", "Arakure KNIGHT," and the currently ongoing "Shonan Bakusozoku First Flag," which tells the story of the original Shonan Bakusozoku. However, he is also a master of the short story. From his many works, we've carefully selected a selection of soul-stirring gems!

Highly acclaimed as a "hidden masterpiece," this collection features his first title story, "DUCK TAIL," depicting the overnight journey of two men. In "BLACK NIGHT HAWK," a supermarket employee encounters a legendary rider at a new workplace and embarks on a summer adventure. In "Letter," a salaryman who has been steadily making his way is tormented by the dreams of a mysterious young boy. Finally, there's the debut of "Dad Knows Everything," in which a widowed husband fights to show his son he's a fatherly father.

This collection includes four stories in total! The underlying theme of all his works is... yes, rock 'n' roll sung by adults!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: ＤＵＣＫ　ＴＡＩＬ　－吉田聡　大人のロックンロール短編集－
title.romaji: DUCK TAIL: Yoshida Satoshi Otona no Rock 'n' Roll Tanpenshuu

205066.description:
At first glance, Tatsuhiko and Haruko seem to be like your average ordinary old couple. However, in reality, they are the former madam queen of the cross-dressing bar, "Rose" and the former male-dressing girl "Haruhiko". A crazy dress-up comedy that makes you live an extraordinary life!!

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.native: 女装じいさんと男装ばあさん

205067.description:
In the past, animation was created by drawing each frame on cels and then filming each frame one by one... This story is set in the early 1980s, a time of the Showa era and before the bubble economy began, and depicts the youth of a boy who, by chance, decides to become an animator...

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

205069.description:
Jennie has a goal, and it's a simple one: enjoy all that life has to offer, no matter how dangerous it might be. Roller-coaster rides, drinking too much and even losing her virginity one night at a bar are all checkpoints on her way to her goal. The night she attempts to lose her virginity, she finds the love of her life, Travis Wilde. At least, she thinks she does, but then he chastises her for her dangerous ways and sends her packing. Fate reunites Travis and Jennie, but tragedy might steal them away from one another yet again. When they get to talking, Jennie has an intense migraine. She has them frequently, to the point where she keeps medicine on her at all times. The migraines are just a symptom of the reason Jennie's living life on the edge. Jennie doesn't have much time left, but Travis just can't accept that.

(Source: Renta!)

205070.description:
Leo Spencer is the CEO of a major London company, but that's not the story he tells the Irish pub owner he meets. Brianna believes Leo is a writer investigating the emerald hills of Ireland for his next novel. The truth is somewhere in the middle: Leo is a London CEO in Ireland to investigate, but not for a novel. Leo's looking for the mother who abandoned him when he was an infant. Brianna knows nothing of this and finds herself charmed by the man who tries so hard to help her out during a sudden snowstorm. He's nice, helpful, warm...and available. Brianna and Leo start up a romance while they're in each other's company, but Leo is still on a mission. He needs to find his birth mother-little does he know that Brianna is actually good friends with her!

(Source: Renta!)

205071.description:
Mallory took in her nephew, Matthew, after her brother and his wife died, and she vowed to raise the child with all the love she had. But Matthew's uncle, the wild Jordan, said that he was going to sell their house, and she had to get out. He was the owner, and he had been against his sister's marriage to Mallory's brother. When Jordan learned about little Matthew's existence, he started fighting for custody, but Mallory wouldn't give up on Matthew that easily. Maybe Jordan's surprising proposal of a loveless marriage of convenience is the answer all three of them need!

(Source: Renta!)

205072.description:
Elizabeth was speechless when she ran into Sir Richard again at a dinner party held at her sister's estate. She had been in love with Richard since she was a young girl. And though she should have been thrilled, Elizabeth was incredibly nervous. A year earlier, she had been caring for injured soldiers as a nurse when the two happened to cross paths. Since Richard had temporarily lost his sight, Elizabeth decided to keep her identity hidden from him. Feeling vulnerable, Richard had reached out for her, and she ended up spending one passionate night in his arms. Now she can only hope he'll never realize that Mary the nurse was actually her!

(Source: Renta!)

205073.description:
Now widowed, Ava faces a cruel reality-her late husband left her with crippling debt. To make matters worse, the creditor is Marc Castellano, her former lover. Five years ago Ava had no choice but to leave Marc and marry his business rival. Determined to take revenge, Marc has now invited Ava to his suite to give her two options: become his mistress or pay off her debts. Without the resources to do the latter, Ava has only one choice left...

(Source: Renta!)

205074.description:
Talented computer designer Dana bumped into her coolheaded and shrewd boss, Griffin, while she was carrying a large amount of alcohol. He believed the alcohol was actually hers, and seeing his mood, Dana quickly ran off. Both of them were left with bad first impressions, and each time they met, those impressions were only strengthened. But when Griffin learned about a particular secret, his impression of Dana completely changed, and her impression of him slowly began to change, as well. Maybe one can have a second chance at first impressions after all.

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: ブライダル・スイート

205075.description:
Ten years have passed since Charlene's parents died and her then-boyfriend, Brand, left her. She has no intention of forgiving him-without his support, she lost her little sister, Cissy, to their horrible relatives, and she blames it on Brand, who refused to marry her. Raised by her aunt and uncle, Cissy has grown up to be selfish and rebellious. And then one morning, Charlene wakes up to a baby on her couch with a letter from Cissy stating that Brand is the child's father!

(Source: Renta!)

205076.description:
Martha was betrayed by her boyfriend, so she's taken a trip to her ancestral home, an island in the Aegean Sea. She was planning to heal her broken heart in her family home, which was supposed to be vacant, but a pirate-like man named Theo has gotten his hands on this home so full of memories without her even knowing about it. Martha is fascinated by his charm, but he orders her to leave. She used up all her money on the flight there and she has nowhere to go, leaving her at a loss. But when some women show up and pursue Theo, he suddenly proclaims that Martha is his girlfriend and pulls her into a rough kiss. What is going on here?

(Source: Renta!)

title.romaji: Shakunetsu no Koi no Owari ni

205077.description:
Shy and timid Meg was engaged to the son of her company's CEO, but after he embezzled funds and blamed it on her, she was abruptly fired. Then one day a French businessman named Etienne appeared in front of her. The moment they met he told her he wants her to return to the company that fired her, but this time as its CEO! Meg swore to herself that she would never again be deceived by a man, but she eventually gives in and agrees to return on her own terms. Although, despite her determination to keep their relationship professional, the distance between her and Etienne seems to keep shrinking...

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 幸せになるためのリスト
title.romaji: Shiawase ni Naru Tame no List

205078.description:
The daughters of the Edelstein family are born with a special power: to take on the misfortune of others and share their happiness. Successive heads of the family have expanded their influence by marrying off their daughters to influential nobles.

All the nobles seek is their daughters' power. Therefore, these marriages are purely political and loveless. Kuchel, who was born into the Edelstein family, did not have any special powers. Because of this, she was called "pebbles" and was oppressed.

Kuchel married into the newly emerging noble family of Baron Eltz, and was prepared for his partner to be disappointed and even killed when he found out she had no powers. However, her husband, Jeremias, welcomed her warmly without mentioning her powers at all.

(Source: Gaugau, translated)

title.native: 政略結婚から始まる幸福もあると、信じてもいいですか？
title.romaji: Seiryaku Kekkon kara Hajimaru Koufuku mo Aru to, Shinjite mo Ii desu ka?

205080.description:
The "Demonic Invasion" lasted for hundreds of years, and countless heroes were cut down by the Demon Lord during their reign…! Until the hero Terios, known as The Last Hope, finally defeated the Demon Lord and brought peace to the land. But the hero Terios vanished, and the Demon Lord, thought to be dead, is miraculously reborn… as a dog!? This is the story of the last Demon Lord, now all soft and fluffy, desperately trying to live a peaceful life while protecting his granddaughter, now a fugitive targeted by all of creation.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: この犬ときたら孫のことしか考えていない～犬生魔王のやり遺し～
title.romaji: Kono Inu to Kitara Mago no Koto shika Kangaeteinai: Kensei Maou no Yarinokoshi

205082.description:
Belinda Kelly didn't have the most fun in high school. A little overweight and a lot bookish, Belinda was more interested in getting ready for law school than hitting the gym. Still, one boy saw through her glasses and peered into the sweet soul of the girl behind them. He always tried to help her out. Taking her to a dance turned disastrous, though, when his friends played a horrible prank on her. Ten years later, now going by Rachel, Belinda has transformed herself into a star lawyer who can turn anyone's head. Her goal: destroy her high school date and the two friends who pranked her by teasing them with what they could have had but never will. Problem is, time changes people, and she may have picked the wrong target: the first man she chooses is the kind brother of her former tormentor!

(Source: Renta!)

205083.description:
Chloe secretly carried and gave birth as the surrogate mother of her half sister, the queen of a desert country. However, as Chloe waited for her sister to pick up her baby, her sister and her husband perished in an accident. To Chloe, who is a dedicated researcher and has never given any thought to love or marriage, the child they left behind is her only blood relative. She's determined to raise the child with all her love, no matter how difficult it might be. But then Sayid, the younger brother of the late sheikh, who is now serving as regent, appears at her door. With a cold, stern expression, he informs her that he has come to collect his country's future ruler and is prepared to take the baby by force. Now the only way for Chloe to stay by her child's side is to marry Sayid! She will do anything for her child-even wed Sayid in a loveless marriage. But will her heart be able to withstand the charm hidden under Sayid's serious facade?

(Source: Renta!)

205084.description:
In sixteenth-century England, Lady Margaret was just eleven when her father died. He designated Christopher, a pirate, as her guardian, and decreed in his will that they were to marry. But Margaret, still young, was scared of Christopher, so he kept his distance. They lived a marriage in name only for years, which was never a problem for Margaret before. But now that she's eighteen, she desperately wants to consummate their marriage! Unfortunately, even though she's grown up, Christopher doesn't feel the same way...

(Source: Renta!)

205085.description:
The protagonist, having possessed a berserker character within the game, has finally slain the Great Demon and cleared the ending after many events. He believed that was the end. However, before his eyes was not an exit to the real world but a [New Game+] button to start another run.

(Source: Naver, translated)

205086.description:
It took Katrien's breath away when she saw mountaineer Zachary at the party. He looked just like that man from twelve years ago! The one who pulled her back into the light when she was falling into darkness... But she's already engaged to the sophisticated Callum. As a model, Katrien is skilled at keeping a poker face, but coincidence keeps bringing Zachary back into her life, leading her heart away from her fiance and toward a different love!

(Source: Renta!)

205087.description:
Lin Qingfeng, an ordinary college student, was once abandoned by Lin family as a nobody. In a supernatural event, he met Lin Zhaoxing, the top genius. When participating in the gatherings of heroes, Lin Zhaoxing accidentally died, and the soul was accidentally sucked into the body of Lin Qingfeng... In order to help Lin Zhaoxing reborn, he began an adventure in the foreign world...

(Source: WebComics)

205088.description:
1. Refrain (リフレイン)
2. Hirusagari (昼下がり)
3. Shabondama no Niwa (シャボン玉の庭)
4. Kaze no Naku (風の鳴く)
5. Atsui Natsu (暑い夏)

205089.description: A spoiled rich kid, Xiao Zhang, accidentally traveled to the otherworld and became the leader of a waning devil sect. In order to continue to enjoy his life, he transformed his stronghold into the birthplace for an online game’s players. All of a sudden, various people appeared. All together with the players in the otherworld, they made history and conquered the continent!

205090.description:
With striking beauty and terrifying power, are my five top Disciples actually an infamous harem of Demon Goddesses? And, when they find out that I’ve accidentally killed their true Master and been forced to assume his role, will their wrath be turned against me?

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: Villain Disciples, Let Your Master Go

title.native: 反派徒儿你就放过师尊吧
title.romaji: Fanpai Tu Er Ni Jiu Fangguo Shi Zun Ba

205091.description:
In the desperate struggle for survival in a post-apocalyptic world, all humans awakened a special ability known as “lexicon.” Zhao Cheng, who has been searching for his adopted sister by hiding himself from place to place, finally awakens the world's only diamond-rank growable lexicon on the day he turns sixteen! However, the reality of the hardships in this world begins to unveil before his eyes... Will Zhao Cheng be able to grow stronger and find his sister?

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: Becoming a God in Apocalypse Glossary

title.romaji: Wo Zai Moshi Citiao Cheng Shen

205093.description:
"But we swore we'd get married the next time we met, right?"

I had a touching reunion with my ex-boyfriend, but he seems a little too obsessed with me...!Honoka's stuck living an unfulfilling life as an office worker. Deep down, she's never quite gotten over the way Yusei, her middle school boyfriend, suddenly ghosted her. However, one night at a class reunion, their paths cross again! Overcome with a wave of nostalgia, Honoka is brought to tears. However, she also notices that Yusei seems strangely grim and is cold to everyone except her... Then, he presents her with a filled-out marriage registration form, saying, "We made a promise ten years ago." She can't run away from his earnest and determined love...!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: Between Hell and Happily Ever After

205094.description:
She's married to her job. Why would she need a partner? She wouldn't actually fall for this loser, would she...? Hoshika is the ace of the planning department for an online magazine, but after getting framed for an office scandal, she finds herself on the brink of a severe demotion, or worse. However, her boss gives her one last chance to prove herself, pairing her for a project with Waku, the useless office loser. Just as she's struggling to accept her current situation, he suddenly asks her to be his... fake fiancée?! As absurd as that is, maybe he's not as much of a failure as he portrays himself to be... "You're pretty cocky for a loser." "What about you? I thought you said you were married to your job." Can love really bloom from a fake engagement between a stubborn office worker and the office punching bag?

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: Temporarily Engaged to the Office Loser
title.native: 負け犬君とかりそめ婚。

205095.description:
"A shy woman, a lively grandma, and a smart but scary boy live in an old house in Beijing."

They each have their own issues and troubles when it comes to love, work, friends, and school life Romance and comedy happen in the big city as they face their day-to-day life in Beijing.

(Source: Comikey)
synonyms: A Replica of Empire State of Mind

205096.description:
1. Lion wa Nemutteiru (ライオンは眠っている)
2. Samson no Daisainan (サムソンの大災難)
3. No Gallery (ノー・ギャラリー)
4. Shinkaiden (神怪伝)
5. Super Sana (スーパー・サナ)
6. Nagaremono: Chinmitsu Seibu Eiyuuden (流れ者　珍説・西部英雄伝)

title.native: ライオンは眠っている

205097.description:
Lin Xueer is a widow who is being protected by a man named Qin Mo, a martial artist. In the face of danger, Lin Xueer and Qin Mo escaped to the Ten Thousand Beast Forest. As the two are in the forest, they attract dangerous demons and Lin Xueer awakens a power within her!

(Source: INKR)

205098.description:
1. Foras no Oriru Chi (フォラスの降りる地)
2. Yami e no Sasoi (闇への誘い)
3. Kyuuketsu (求血)
4. Tsugunai no Kokuin (償いの刻印)
5. Underdog (アンダー・ドッグ)

205099.description:
"Unbelievable". When I wake up, I realized that I've traveled into an embarrassing novel I wrote in my teenage years. Now I'm the infamous first miss in the house of Prime Minister. According to the plot I wrote, the female lead was a flirtatious girl who had only one interest in the world -- flirting with handsome guys. However, her ending wasn't a good one, or to say it is tragedy would be more accurate. But I'm not going to accept the ending as it is. Time for me to tame my lovers!

(Source: MangaToon)
synonyms: Handsome Men in the Country Entering in My Account
Pretty Boys of the Country Entering in My Harem

205100.description:
Meng Yao is a dream fairy that travels through dimensions to solve problems that may affect reality. After a few things go wrong, Avery is forced by a vampire named Ellie to sign a blood contract. Adventures ensue as they solve multiple mysteries and look for a way to dissolve the blood contract!

(Source: INKR)

205101.description:
When the Players from beyond the stars turned the peaceful Blue Star into their personal slaughterhouse, all hope seemed lost. But the system made a fatal error, unlocking the ultimate hidden class for Lin Yuan: the Necro Hunter. He's the glitch they never saw coming—an NPC who came back from death with the power to hunt the mighty Players. The game for Blue Star's survival is about to be rewritten, and he's leading the charge with vengeance.

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: Lord of Summoning When the World Changes

title.native: 召唤之主！当异变降临人间
title.romaji: Zhaohuan Zhi Zhu! Dang Yi Bian Jianglin Renjian

205102.description:
1. Akai Tanjoubi (あかい誕生日)
2. Mayonaka no Houmonsha (真夜中の訪問者)
3. Shiawase Shisuu (しあわせ指数)
4. Ooki na Kashi no Ki no Shita de(大きな樫の木の下で)
5. Tooki Hi no Koibito e... (遠き日の恋人へ…)

synonyms: Do Rabbits Dream of Cream Soda?

title.native: うさぎも夢見るクリームソーダ
ロストステラの滞在者たち

205106.description:
In search of the "wonderful" yet to be discovered, a high school girl takes a leisurely, carefree train journey.

Lin Xiaoling, who has both Taiwanese and Japanese parents, enjoys traveling by train. During spring break in her second year of high school, she travels alone to Kofu, where she meets Eleonora, a foreign student from Northern Europe who is having trouble at the station. The two end up traveling together to see Mount Fuji, but... Traveling is always full of unexpected events. Traveling alone is fun, but traveling with someone is also great. A group of high school girls take an exciting, carefree journey around Japan!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

205107.description:
Si Yan, once a fearsome powerhouse with dual abilities in the apocalypse, dies in an explosion, only to wake up in a primitive beast world. To her shock, she has become the notorious villainess and the mother of four little snake cubs! But this mother was so cruel that the moment Si Yan opens her eyes, her children are already plotting to assassinate her. Now, she has to find a way to win back the hearts of her villainous cubs, farm and survive in a strange new beast world.

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: Farming in Beast Word: My Villainous Snake Cubs Are Super Clingy

title.english: Beast World: I Became the Little Villain’s Mommy
title.native: 兽世种田：反派崽崽超粘人
title.romaji: Shou Shi Zhong Tian: Fan Pai Zai Zai Chao Zhan Ren

205108.description:
To fulfill her deepest wish, Su Yan enters the realm of beasts, only to wake up as a tiny white mouse, bound to a multi-pregnancy system. To level up, she must tame one beastman after another: a battle-scarred leopard warrior, a fierce rabbit beast, and more. Each is terrifyingly strong in beast form and impossibly handsome as a man, and each one hits her right in her soft spots. With a swelling harem and a system that keeps pushing her deeper into this wild love battlefield, Su Yan’s poor heart is about to explode. But she just might turn the tables, seize control of this savage game, and tame the entire realm of beasts for herself.

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: Binding With Multiple Pregnancy System, I Control the Danger Zone in the Beast World

title.english: Taming The Beasts With Multi-Pregnancy System
title.native: 绑定多胎系统，我拿捏兽世修罗场
title.romaji: Bang Ding Duotai Xitong, Wo Nanie Shou Shi Xiuluo Chang

205109.description:
Felicia was betrayed by her fiancé, the crown prince, and was on the verge of being executed. However, the scorn of the saint who tempted him triggers her to awaken the power of "rewinding time"... "I'll make sure I don't make the same mistake next time. If everyone calls me a villain, then I'll act just like them." A terrifying tale of revenge begins, traveling back in time.

(Source: Mangabox, translated)

title.native: 悪役令嬢になりましたが、何か？
title.romaji: Akuyaku Reijou ni Narimashita ga, Nani ka?

205110.description:
Please let me spend one night with a sexy, handsome, charismatic man.

Every Christmas, Lee An, the eldest son of the conservative Korean Lee family, would write down his secret sexual fantasy—one he could never share with anyone—in a wish, stuff it into his stocking, and then burn it away unseen. This Christmas returned without fail, and as usual, the only response to his lewd wish note was a sudden surge of work left for him to handle due to his boss's unexpected absence. Feeling restless and unsettled, Ian ended up attending a meeting in his place. There, dressed entirely in red, stood an overwhelmingly handsome man: Hakan Claus. Dragged along by this high-pressure, cold man, Ian barely finished the meeting and stood up. Suddenly, the man asked him what his Christmas wish was this year...

Last year's Christmas wish... what was it again? Hmm, it was ‘I want to be tied up all Christmas and have sex like an animal,’ right?

Was this man... really Santa Claus?!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

205111.description:
"I know I shouldn't do this to my friend's video..."

he knows, but he can't stop himself...

Makiya, a freshman university student with a complex about his feminine features, strives to be a manly man. One day, his grandfather asks him to deliver a package to Yoruta Rei, a suspicious resident of the apartment building owned by his grandfather. Rei is a classmate from university, intelligent and beautiful, and popular. However, he always wears a hat pulled down low, a black mask, and all-black clothing, keeping people at a distance. Makiya often talks to this eccentric Rei, who often stares at him, and Makiya doesn't want to get close to him. Nevertheless, he decides to be manly and go to Rei's house for his grandfather's sake. The door is open, and when he enters, he hears a mysterious "crunching" sound!?

It turns out Rei is a popular chewing ASMR streamer. As he listens to Rei's beautiful voice and chewing sounds coming from his exposed lips, Makiya is somehow overcome with a strong desire to be bitten...

A handsome ASMR streamer and a pure-hearted boy with a complicated feminine side.

"I want to bite" and "I want to be bitten!?" A mysterious and sweet BL story about college students!!

(Source: Spicy Whip, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: うるわしのASMRくんは噛みたがり

205112.description:
Kim Jae-Han, a brilliant and ambitious young magistrate newly appointed to the Sangju district, arrives with a hidden agenda that threatens the local status quo. Shortly after his arrival, he crosses paths with Choi Yeon-Ho, the eldest son of the powerful and influential Choi clan. Despite his lineage, Yeon-Ho lives a miserable existence as a social outcast held in utter contempt by his own family. Jae-Han finds himself strangely drawn to the innocent, suffering soul hidden beneath Yeon-Ho’s ragged exterior, and he begins to offer the young man a rare, genuine kindness.

For Yeon-Ho, this handsome magistrate is a beacon of light in a lifetime of darkness; he falls deeply in love with the first person to treat him with dignity. However, their burgeoning bond is built on a precarious foundation. Unknown to Yeon-Ho, Jae-Han is meticulously orchestrating a plan to dismantle the corrupt Choi family entirely, placing their hearts on a collision course with tragedy.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: The Flower Language of White Pine

205113.description:
Despite being hardened in combat sports and the field of espionage, Wan Ruoli had no skills to prepare her for her sudden transmigration into the body of a disgraced concubine's daughter. Set to be married off to a dying prince, the formerly frail girl uses her new-found martial arts and wisdom to exact revenge on those who would have her family's memory besmirched and lost to time.

(Source: Tapas)

205114.description:
Due to a conspiracy, the world's number one killer, Xia Yan betrayed the underworld overlord, Beiye Lingxuan who loved her deeply. Beiye Lingxuan was furious and ordered others to capture her alive. But what he didn't know was that Xia Yan was poisoned and her life was only 2 years left... While because Xia Yan loves him too much, she decides to conceal the truth and let him fall in love with her again.

(Source: WebComics)

title.english: Dark Love of Nine Tailed Fox

title.native: 勇者小湊あきらは世界を救いたくない
title.romaji: Yuusha Kominato Akira wa Sekai wo Sukuitakunai

title.native: 夜ごといとしい神様へ

205118.description:
Worried about his son Bi-Young living like a ne'er-do-well, Lord Bae asks Jin, the capital's top assassin and errand boy, to discipline his son. Sneaking into Bi-Young's bedroom for the mission, Jin unexpectedly witnesses him masturbating. His playful side kicks in, and he teases the terrified Bi-Young.

“I'll do anything you want...”

Young master, when you cry with such a pretty face, it makes me want to give you a proper scolding.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

205119.description:
She ended up reeling in a hot CEO from a complete lie?! Mina is a regular office worker, and every day she gets harassed by her haughty, rich coworker Kanemitsu. However, even after the worst torment, Mina manages to get by thanks to her amazing CEO, Mr. Ohno. One day, Mina's phone randomly starts blowing up with tons of texts from guys she doesn't know! When she looks into it, she finds out that someone's used her name and number to register for a dating app. She doesn't know what to do, but surprisingly ends up hitting it off with one of her matches, and they agree to meet in person. When they do, she's shocked to find out that it's none other than... Mr. Ohno?! Could this meeting on such false pretenses actually be a fateful encounter...?

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: From Fake to Fate: True Love Born From False Pretenses
title.native: たなぼた格差婚～偽物の私がくれた本物の恋愛
title.romaji: Tana Bota Kakusa Kon: Nisemono no Watashi ga Kureta Honmono no Renai

205120.description:
To clear a debt that isn't his, Han Seong-Eun enters a high-stakes contract marriage with Cha Jin-Wook, a blind billionaire and dominant alpha. The rules are humiliating: Seong-Eun must undergo a nightly "physical inspection" to prove his fidelity, yet sex is strictly forbidden outside of their cycles. With a pregnancy clause looming and his husband remaining ice-cold, Seong-Eun is trapped in a stalemate. That is, until his brother-in-law, Cha Jin-Hyeong, moves in. Jin-Hyeong is bold, dangerous, and more than willing to "help" Seong-Eun fulfill his marital duties. In a house full of secrets, Seong-Eun is about to learn that playing the brothers against each other is a very dangerous game.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

205121.description:
For nine long years, the dynamic between them remained completely unchanged: Choi Yeong-Hyeon was the ruthless, unpredictable delinquent, and Lee Min-Woo was his submissive, personal toy. No matter how volatile Yeong-Hyeon’s moods became or how cruelly he pushed boundaries, Min-Woo always obeyed with a gentle, compliant smile. This toxic game, which had steadily consumed their youth since middle school, finally reached its breaking point.

Deciding he had grown bored of the arrangement, Yeong-Hyeon abruptly declared an end to their twisted relationship. However, he gravely overlooked a crucial piece of the puzzle. The realization hits him too late when he wakes up bound and trapped inside a locked, unfamiliar room. Staring into the eyes of his supposedly docile captive, a terrified Yeong-Hyeon is forced to face a horrifying truth: he was never the master of this game. In reality, he was Min-Woo’s personal toy all along.

(Source: Lezhin US)

205122.description:
In a world where animal hybrids represent the ultimate elite, Kim Cheol-Su is content living vicariously through his favorite simulation game, "Wooly Woods". But his digital hobby becomes a chaotic reality when he finds an abandoned hybrid kitten on his doorstep that looks exactly like his in-game companion. Cheol-Su takes the little one in for temporary protection, but as Na-Bi starts calling him "Daddy" and hits an unexpected growth spurt, the responsibilities of a hybrid owner get a lot more hands-on.

(Source: Lezhin US)

205123.description:
Born seeing ghosts, Jong-Eon grew up in a world of shadows. His grim reality flips when he pairs up for a college project with Hye-Seong, a cheerful underclassman who somehow acts as a literal human ghost repellent. Desperate for a peaceful life, Jong-eon starts following Hye-Seong everywhere to keep the spirits at bay. But when he gets caught red-handed, Jong-Eon panics and blurts out the first excuse he can think of: he’s hopelessly in love.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

205124.description:
Shen Hanguang, a woman who loves games and animation, was hijacked by a Rolls Royce at the school gate. Her younger brother goes missing, her parents are involved in a big incident, and she was appointed interim president of the multinational conglomerate, GKG? The handsome assistant delivers this explosive news, but even more incredible is to come...

(Source: WebComics)

205126.description:
An unfortunate young lady blossoms with the love of a solitary prince! Sweet and frustrating, doting, and a Cinderella romance♡

Felicie, the daughter of a marquis, is blessed with the blessing of fertility. Despite being bullied by her younger sister, who has the blessing of controlling beauty, she works hard to fulfill her duties as the next lord of the domain. However, her sister's machinations take away her position as heir and her fiancé - so much for that, she decides to live on her own! Felicie studies hard at school to become a lady-in-waiting at the royal palace, but by chance she becomes the "favorite" of the brilliant third prince, Haruto! As she meets him again and again, Felicie discovers the happiness of being loved and the true value of the blessing of fertility.

(Source: Gaugau, translated)

title.native: 冴えない加護持ち令嬢、孤高の王子様に見初められる～美貌の妹に言いなりの家族を捨てたら、真の能力が開花しました～
title.romaji: Saenai Kagomochi Reijou, Kokou no Ouji-sama ni Misomerareru: Bibou no Imouto ni Iinari no Kazoku wo Sutetara, Shin no Nouryoku ga Kaika Shimashita

205127.description:
“Very well. Then try giving that so-called testimony of yours.”

This is the royal castle of the Kingdom of Draconia. Alice Chelsea, a reserved yet devoted harem maid known for her sincerity, is one day arrested under suspicion of stealing jewels belonging to the primary consort, Queen Nguyen.

Confused by an accusation she has no memory of committing, Alice finds herself trapped in a desperate situation. The time limit is only a few hours. If she cannot prove her innocence, she will be executed immediately.

Cornered with no escape in sight, a mysterious memory suddenly resurfaces within her mind—memories from before her reincarnation, when she was once a female detective.

Drawing upon the investigative skills she honed in her former life, Alice begins unraveling the threads of truth to uncover the real culprit who framed her.

—Now, let the proof of innocence begin.

(Source: Cmoa, translated)
synonyms: The Misfortune of the Inner Palace Maid

title.native: 後宮メイドの災難～人使いの荒い宮廷書記官と推理する～
title.romaji: Koukyuu Maid no Sainan: Hitozukai no Arai Kyuutei Shokikan to Suiri suru

205128.description:
Unemployed and penniless, Jun Bo gets a phone call from his grandfather who claims he will leave his billion-dollar fortune to Jun Bo. However, before that happens, Jun Bo must complete a special mission – receive signed approval from all six tenants who rent his grandfather's mansion. Upon arriving, Jun Bo is surprised to find that these tenants are six attractive women with markedly contrasting personalities.

(Source: WebComics)

205129.description: Yuuna, a university student, suddenly finds herself lost in another world and embarks on a life-risking journey as a saint. Worried about her adorable appearance, the priest forces her to wear a veil, which leads to the misunderstanding that "the saint (she) is ugly"...! While everyone else treats her coldly, only her guardian knight, Brigadier General Lang, understands her true nature and treats her kindly. However, Yuuna has completely lost her confidence and is unable to remove the veil... A journey full of twists and turns begins here!
synonyms: The Veiled Saint: Misjudged and Loved by a Knight

title.native: ヴェールの聖女 ～醜いと誤解された聖女、イケメン護衛騎士に溺愛される～
title.romaji: Veil no Seijo: Minikui to Gokai sareta Seijo, Ikemen Goei kishi ni Dekiai sareru

205131.description:
High school teacher Kei has never been in a relationship his entire life. Toma, his next-door neighbor and student, is like family to him, but they've grown distant over the years, much to Kei's secret disappointment. One day, Toma accidentally learns that Kei is actually interested in guys. All of a sudden, Toma's aloof attitude takes a 180 as he starts to put the moves on Kei... Toma even confesses that he's always been in love with him! There's no stopping Toma's advances! This is a naughty and heart-pounding romance between a handsome high school student living next door and a teacher who's a beginner in love!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 慧ちゃん、ダメって言わないで

205132.description:
Daichi Yamashiro transfers to a school in inner-city Tokyo with one goal in mind: to become the strongest delinquent in town. On his very first day at the new school, he hears about Sora Kaburaki, feared as the strongest fighter around. Daichi challenges Sora to a fight, hoping to defeat him and claim the title of Number One. Little does he know that Sora has a different kind of challenge in mind: one that will make Daichi feel things he's never felt before...!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: Wanna Be Number One? Then You Gotta Beat Me!
title.native: テッペン獲るなら俺を倒してイけ！
title.romaji: Teppen Toru nara Ore wo Taoshite Ike!

205133.description: Note: Includes the one-shot "Kawaiku Tabete Dakishimete (可愛く食べて抱きしめて)" and one extra chapter.
synonyms: 可愛く食べて抱きしめて

title.native: インコンプリート・ラブ
愛日と花嫁 四季折々

205135.hashtag: #この恋は神様だって知らない

title.native: この恋は神様だって知らない
title.romaji: Kono Koi wa Kamisama datte Shiranai

205136.description:
Shi Yuner, used to be a rich young lady, was forced by the creditor to take nude photos to mortgage the 260 million debts she could not repay after her father went bankrupt and went missing. In a moment of crisis, the heir of the richest family, Li Shuo appeared to save Shi Yunson. She thought she can escape from the abyss, but she didn't know that there was another vortex...

(Source: WebComics)

synonyms: I wanna be the number one who you love

title.native: いちばんになりたい恋

205138.description:
Waka is a 20-year-old university student when her grandfather sets up a first meeting with Keiji, a strikingly handsome older man who also happens to be the President of a huge company. Though she is filled with doubts at an arranged marriage at first, Keiji proves himself time again and again to be a true gentleman with his kindness, leaving her heart racing and bringing her to realize that she has completely fallen for him. But even though they are now officially a married couple, night after night passes without them having their "first time" together... This must mean Keiji has feelings for someone else, right? So, for his sake, Waka proposes they get divorced. But with this, the true feelings that Keiji has been hiding the whole time run wild in his desperation to make Waka his, and their relationship suddenly takes a sharp turn into a sweet but unfamiliar territory! The delicate timing of love is all too apparent in this story where everything starts with divorce!

(Source: Manga Plaza)
synonyms: 離婚才是戀情的起點～帥哥社長的甜蜜追妻生活就此展開～

title.english: Our Story Starts With Divorce: The Elite President Won't Give up on This Arranged Marriage
title.native: 婚からはじめましょうー極上社長はお見合い妻を逃さないー
title.romaji: Rikon kara Hajimemashou: Gokujou Shachou wa Omiaizuma wo Nigasanai

205139.description:
Takaya works at a design studio, and his best friend, Rio, is a popular magazine model. Even after Takaya came out as gay, Rio stayed by his side and now, as adults, they still spend every weekend together. But when Takaya mentions that he is ready to start dating again after putting romance on hold because of work, Rio suddenly becomes upset...!?

"I've known you longer than anyone else. Shouldn't I come first?"

Takaya always thought Rio had no interest in romance, but what is this possessiveness he keeps showing toward him—!?

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

title.native: 好きってバレたし覚悟して？

205141.description:
I'm...pregnant." Sawa, who works as a graphic designer at an advertising agency, discovers one morning that she's got a bun in the oven. Only one person could be the father, and it's her handsome, but strict supervisor at work, Director Ishiki. The incident happened a few months ago when she was celebrating a job well down with him after a huge project they worked on together. Perhaps they were feeling a bit too relaxed, but once a few drinks hit, they ended up sharing a kiss. The unexpected soft and gentle smooch with her drill sergeant of a supervisor leads to them spending the night together... However, it was only a one-time thing and they were never an item, so Sawa wavers about whether or not to tell him that she's pregnant. A romance that blossoms from an unexpected pregnancy is about to unfold!

(Source: Manga Plaza)

205142.description:
Makito Shindo, son of a powerful hospital director, dreamed of saving lives. But after his father’s sudden death, he discovers that he had many enemies simply because of his lineage. Betrayed by a fellow doctor, ruined professionally and financially, and forced into hiding, Makito’s life ends in a tragedy... until a mysterious “Game Over” message gives him a second chance. Now, armed with a mysterious power and the resolve to reclaim what he’s lost, Makito embarks on a journey of revenge and salvation, determined to protect the lives he couldn’t save before.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: ด็อกเตอร์เควสต์ ยอดคุณหมอหัตถ์เทวะ

title.native: ドクタークエスト 転落医師、転生して最強医師になる
title.romaji: Doctor Quest Tenraku Ishi, Tensei Shite Saikyou Ishi ni Naru

205143.description:
Mikoto, whose grandfather was a member of the former upper ranks of society, decides to get married at a young age for the sake of her family. Kazuki, who becomes her new husband, is the son of a distinguished family, as well. He also happens to be Mikoto's first love, and took care of her when her mother passed away when she was a kid. However, when she meets Kazuki again, there is no trace of his kindness from back then, and he treats her ruthlessly from their first day of marriage. Even if he doesn't love her, Mikoto still vows to be a good wife. But then, she hears a rumor about his relationship with another woman...!?

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 仮面夫婦～御曹司は今夜も妻を愛せない～
title.romaji: Kamen Fuufu: Onzoushi wa Konya mo Tsuma wo Aisenai

205144.description:
Kana's in love with her friend Takumi. They've known each other forever, and they're even coworkers now. Of course, he has no idea. Why would he? He's hot and competent, so he's got plenty of women to choose from. She, on the other hand, wears glasses, has a baby face, and has absolutely no experience with men. Desperate, she forms a plan with another colleague to ask Takumi to pop her cherry for her on the pretense that this is all to get with another guy. At first, he tries to dissuade her but soon realizes how adamant she is. And, as much as he thinks this is a bad idea, he can't stand the thought of her doing it with some other dude!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 同期の独占欲を煽ってしまったようです
title.romaji: Douki no Dokusenyoku wo Aotteshimatta you desu

title.native: むっつり叶羽くんの××激愛契約～俺にだけ、全部みせて
title.romaji: Muttsuri Towa-kun no XX Gekiai Keiyaku: Ore ni dake, Zenbu Misete

205146.description:
Notes:
- Chapters 1 to 4 and 6 to 9 were split into two parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume releases.
- Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: Witch of Rubeus and Ars Magna

title.native: ルベウスの魔女とアルスマグナ 〜最恐最悪のアンチヒロインに転生したので世界の滅亡を回避したい〜
title.romaji: Rubeus no Majo to Ars Magna: Saikyou Saiaku no Anti-Heroine ni Tensei Shita node Sekai no Metsubou wo Kaihi Shitai

205147.description:
The one who proposed to me is a mafia boss!? It is the age of Westernization during the Meiji era. Asuka Haruomi, the daughter of a trading merchant, is being attacked on the street, when she is rescued by Gil, a blonde-haired, blue-eyed foreigner. Suddenly, having fallen in love at first sight, he proposes to her, but believe it or not, he is a mafia boss...?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

Note:
- Includes the one-shot "Tsumetakute Attakai".
- Includes the one-shot "Kono En, Zannen Nagara".

title.native: ハイカラおとめ〜開花宣言〜

205148.description:
Kuro, a rebellious high school boy, has a crush on Nadeshiko, a beautiful girl at his school... But Nadeshiko's true identity is actually Kuro's father, Takohachi!Enjoy the laid-back daily life of this cute old man who loves his son so much that he transforms into the beautiful Nadeshiko, and the insensitive Kuro, who doesn't realize Nadeshiko's true identity ☆

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

205149.description:
Our protagonist, Yume, has a daily routine of keeping a diary without fail. But one day, she falls asleep while writing in her diary. The next morning, when she wakes up, she finds that her diary somehow contains entries that she didn't write down... This puzzles Yume. But by the end of the day, she realizes that everything written in the diary actually happened in real life.

"Does this diary have precognitive powers...?"

The diary predicts that her childhood friend, Saichi, will be involved in a traffic accident. "What should I do...?" Yume worries alone, but what action will she take to protect Saichi?!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

205151.description: Rinosuke fights to protect people from the "wind." He's hired by a village preparing for a festival, and there he meets a beast—-?

205153.description:
Mysterious things lurking in the mundane world come to life in this highly anticipated short story series from cutting-edge artist Chiba Midori.

(Source: Torch, translated)

205156.description:
This is a story about a young man, the only human being in a school of various different animals. His day-to-day life bursts with excitement as he hangs out with his quirky friends. Enjoy ordinary school life with a funny twist involving all kinds of animal-related traits!

(Source: INKR)
synonyms: I'm the Only Human in School

title.english: I'm The Only Human Being In My School
title.romaji: Wo Shi Xuexiao Weiyi De Renlei

205157.description:
A love comedy where the girls and the male gods work hard to gain fans!

(Source: INKR)

title.english: Even Gods Need Fans (Fans Are Real)

205158.description:
"Shenanigans and lively days ensue as Caicai works for her favorite company as a flower farmer!"

Caicai Luo is a young lady who got accepted to her dream company that makes her favorite plushies. But she didn't expect to work in the countryside where she meets interesting characters.

(Source: Comikey)

205159.description:
Saint Muriel has sacrificed her life and exerted all her strength to expel the miasma that harms the kingdom. However, a selfish prince falsely accuses her, breaks off her engagement, and then tells her to retire as a saint due to the depletion of her magical powers. Disgusted, she knows she only has a short time left to live. Determined to live the rest of her life without regrets, she is arranged to marry the ruthless duke and rumored Roy Calvert, but she decides that he is better than the prince! But! Contrary to her resolve, Roy begins to dote on her...!? The reversal of the beloved life of a fired saint!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 余命わずかの引退聖女は冷酷公爵との厄介払い婚を謳歌したい!
title.romaji: Yomei Wazuka no Intai Seijo wa Reikoku Koushaku to no Yakkaibarai Kon wo Ouka Shitai!

205160.description:
Kazuya finally became the strongest player in the VRMMORPG he devoted his life to and gained the title "Fist King." Just as he became number one, he was reborn in another world like the game, where monsters roam free! In this new world where firearms are favored over melee weapons, Kazuya takes up a club to once again pursue his ideal strength!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Chronicles of an Online Game Addict's Reincarnation in Another World: He Can't Use the Fighting Skill That Earned Him the Title of Fist King, so He Started Swinging a Club for Eight Hours a Day
title.native: ネトゲ廃人の異世界転生記 拳王とよばれた最強の拳が使えないので、1日8時間こん棒を振ることからはじめた
title.romaji: Netoge Haijin no Isekai Tenseiki: Ken Ou to Yobareta Saikyou no Kobunshi ga Tsukenai node, 1-nichi 8-jikan Konbou wo Furu Koto kara Hajimeta

205161.description:
After a bus accident, Lim Mari awakens to find herself in a novel as an odd-eyed cat named Marie. Mistaken for a spiritual animal, she's gifted to cold Emperor Klaus von Bismarck. While Klaus slowly warms up to Marie, she is focused on finding a way to turn human... until she stumbles upon an assassination plot targeting Klaus! Despite being powerless and unable to tell anyone what she knows, can this cute ball of fluff find a way to save her new owner? And will she ever become human again?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.
synonyms: ツンデレ皇帝の愛猫になりました

205163.description:
Thirteen years ago, a terrible monster called the Poison Queen attacked the Jade Kingdom. A brave party of adventurers defeated her, but in the process one of them was stricken with a curse. In order to survive, she had to pass it down to her own son. Scorned as a cursed child since birth, Caim Halsberg is hated by everyone except his late mother and Tea, a maid working for his family. While his father and twin sister reside in their mansion, Caim is forced to live alone in a forest hut. But everything changes when a certain doctor helps him to overcome the curse and claim its power. Having now become the Poison King, Caim goes on a journey to achieve his one wish—but he never imagined that his poison would have quite the peculiar effect on the beauties he meets!

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: The Poison King: Now that I've Gained Ultimate Power, the Bewitching Beauties in My Harem Can't Get Enough of Me

title.native: 毒の王 最強の力に覚醒した俺は美姫たちを従え、発情ハーレムの主となる
title.romaji: Doku no Ou: Saikyou no Chikara ni Kakusei Shita Ore wa Bikitachi wo Shitagae, Hatsujou Harem no Aruji to Naru

title.native: 癖あり彼女は我慢できない
title.romaji: Kuse Ari Kanojo wa Gaman Dekinai

205167.description:
Timid Elise is treated coldly by her noble family because she is an illegitimate child. When she is ordered to masquerade as the princess and marry General Wolfried, a ruthless military official who killed her fiance in the war, Elise has no choice but to obey. But to her surprise, the general not only knows her true identity but also tells her she can avemge her dead fiance if she wishes! Now it's up to Elise to decide what to do about her new husband, who wears a fierce wolf mask but turns out to be surprisingly kind...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: A Howling Sacrifice: The Wolf General's Bride
title.romaji: Ookami Shougun no Ikenie no Hanayome

205168.description:
Sofia Grancourt finds herself reincarnated with the doomed fate of a villainess and a young son. In order to save both their lives, she quickly divorces her insufferable husband, who was originally supposed to trigger her villain arc, and moves back in with her parents. Since Sofia’s previous life as an office worker was full of repression, she is determined to speak her mind and live freely in this life. And with a supportive family, an adorable son, and a handsome new man, her dreams just might come true...!

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: As a Reincarnated Villainess and a Single Mother, I've Secured the Love Route!

title.english: The Single Mother Villainess Finds Her Happily Ever After
title.native: シングルマザーの転生悪女ですが、溺愛ルートつかみました！
title.romaji: Single Mother no Tensei Akujo desu ka, Dekiai Route Tsukamimashita!

205169.description:
Vivian is rumored in high society to be a cold-blooded lady. And fitting of her reputation, she lets her engagement fall apart without a care even when her fiancé wrongly accuses her of infidelity. Then enters the dashing Duke Silvestre Brunell, who immediately kisses Vivian, saying he wishes to marry her instead. But their love story doesn't just come from nowhere. It all started with a notebook...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: Our Fate Starts With the Notebook
title.native: 虐げられた令嬢は美貌の公爵に溺愛される
title.romaji: Shiitagerareta Reijou wa Bibou no Koushaku ni Dekiaisareru

205170.description:
In her first life, Shelia was married off as repayment for a massive debt and ultimately killed for her magic. Now she’s back in the past and trapped in the same miserable marriage to the cold-hearted crown prince, Helios. This time, Shelia proposes a daring deal to buy her own freedom: she'll earn an impossible fortune to pay off her debt, and in exchange, he must grant her a divorce. But as she battles a court that fears the magic she sells, she finds that her husband's icy attitude might be hiding a warmth that she’d never expected…

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.
205170.hashtag: #旦那様稼いで離婚させていただきます
synonyms: 親愛的老公 ，等我賺夠了，就離婚吧！
Husband, I Will Earn Enough Money to Divorce You!

title.english: Dear Husband, I'm Going to Earn Enough to Divorce You!
title.native: 旦那様、稼いで離婚させていただきます！

205171.description:
Reincarnated into another world, but became the lowliest of all life... A slime mold! From decomposing wood to beasts to dragons, this slime mold shall one day rise and dominate!

(Source: WebComics)

205172.description:
When I realized I had transmigrated as the woman destined to marry my favorite character, Duke Euclid Ludion, I was over the moon. Only cloud on the horizon: I'm a villainess, and based on the storyline, we're headed straight for a divorce. But I won't let that happen! Time to undo all of my character's evil deeds, clear my reputation, use my generous dowry to save Euclid's house from ruin, and win over his beloved wards. Surely, this will be enough to guarantee our happily-ever-after... right?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Loving My Husband While Bracing for Divorce
It Feels Like I'm About to Be Divorced, but My Husband Is My Favorite
My Husband Is My Ultimate Bias, But I Feel Like I'm About to Be Divorced

title.english: My Favorite Character Wants a Divorce

205173.description:
Raiden Xu transmigrated into a world where anyone could awaken their own unique ability, yet he awakened the weakest E-Rank ability. But just as everyone thought he was destined for mediocrity, the system awakened! E-Rank Low Voltage has been upgraded to the S-Rank Celestial Fulgur! Take down monsters, farm Ability Points, and embark on an endless journey of growth and evolution! Once its limits were transcended, Raiden came to realize the bolt in his grasp was now the SSS-Rank Bolt of Chaos that could decimate the world! From an unknown E-Rank to an unparalleled powerhouse, Raiden’s legend begins here!

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: Global Superpowers: Awakening the Purple Heaven Divine Thunder at the Start

title.english: Global Awakening: I Awakened Celestial Lightning
title.native: 全球异能：开局觉醒紫霄神雷
title.romaji: Quan Qiu Yi Neng: Kaiju Juexing Zi Xiao Shen Lei

205174.description:
Just as Byun Gyeon eats and leaves in front of his house, I, the son of Seol San, eat and leave only in the snowy field. That's why I am the Seol King!! Do you like success? Do you like love? What will the Seol King choose?

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

205175.description:
In a world overrun by alien invasions, only one in a thousand can awaken as a Vanguard. Burdened by debt and left behind by society, Li Yi survives at the very bottom until a brutal attack leaves him on the verge of death. There, he awakens the Shadow System. With an endlessly evolving shadow at his command, Li Yi finally gains the strength to fight back and carve out a future in a world that never gave him a chance.

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: Tyrant of the Otherworldly Hell: My Shadow Can Evolve Infinitely
シャドウシステム～影の力で最強ハンターへ～

title.english: Shadow System: Harnessing Shadow Power Become the Ultimate Hunter
title.native: 异狱暴君：我的影子能无限进化
title.romaji: Yi Yo Baojun: Wo De Yingzi Neng Wuxian Jinhua

205176.description:
The Mangje (亡帝) who protects the Ihwa Mangbun (梨花亡墳), the eternal resting place and sanctuary of the previous leaders of the thousand-year-old Demonic Cult …! The qualifications of the Mangje are only given to the current Demonic Cult leader and his disciple in the absence of the Demonic Cult leader. However, with the removal of the Demonic Cult leader Cheonma due to the Hwanma Rebellion, an unprecedented situation has arisen where there are two Mangjes: Hwanma, who became the next Demonic Cult leader, and Cheonma’s disciple Lee Gun-Ak. So who will become the Mangje, the guardian deity of the Ihwa Mangbun…?

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

205177.description:
After his sister's death, Row, who was said to be a freeloader, becomes an explorer to investigate the cause of his sister's death. When he nearly loses his life in the dungeon, he acquires the ability to disassemble monster corpses, supplies, and skills. Row becomes stronger by disassembling various things. And the mystery of his sister's death slowly begins to unravel...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

205178.description:
Lee Gun-Ak, the leader of the bandits of Yeomwangsan Mountain. One day, his family in the mountain village is massacred by assassins who followed Seol-Ji into the mountain. Enraged, Lee Gun-Ak sets out into the world to seek revenge… The star-studded martial arts world is helpless against his unorthodox martial arts. Lee Gun-Ak is learning the martial arts of the Secret Teachings of Seojang, which are different from the martial arts of the Central Plains. The four great disciples of Shindo Sa-Baek, the supreme leader of the martial arts world, Taesanbukdoo Yongseong…

Hyo-ryong (俠龍) Yoo Jang-Jin, Muryong (武龍) Dokbul-Gun, Geom-Bong (劍鳳) Gyo-Yeon, and Sipjeolhwanbong (十絶環鳳) Hwa-Su… Even they cannot stop Lee Gun-Ak’s relentless march! Even the female warriors who terrify the martial arts world become mere women before him. The world is shaken by the actions of the fearsome bandit leader, Lee Gun-Ak.

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

title.native: りむと「ラムネ」と「27cm♥」(小夏りむ12歳)

205180.description:
The mighty hero died in a final battle with the Demon Emperor. Five years later, he awakens in the demon camp, reborn as the weakest of their kind. But his soul triggers the ancient Serpent God’s power hidden within his body. Once a hero feared by villains, he now walks the world in a demon’s body. And this time, the bloodbath he unleashes will shake both sides of the war.

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: A Mountain of Corpses, A Sea of Blood
Horizon macabre : la renaissance du héros

title.english: Bloodbath of the Fallen: The Reborn Hero Gron

205182.description: Note: Originally published as a doujinshi series

title.native: 十年の恋より一週間の性
title.romaji: Junen no Koi yori Isshukan no Sei

205183.description:
"It's you. The woman who ate me and ran away."

Isabel, who had been secretly chasing Agares, unconsciously drew closer to him. As if in a dream, as she had always hoped, Agares' tongue delved into her lips. After the miraculous night of their contact, I thought I would never recognize him again...

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

205184.description:
Office worker Charrion Zacarias suddenly transmigrates into a world of magic only to inherit a dying boy's staggering debt of billions! As if that weren't bad enough, the boy's failed attempt to summon the Dark God leaves Charrion bound by a soul contract which is to fulfill the Dark God's 999 wishes or face complete annihilation. His only hope is that mysterious talking notebook known as God's Notebook. A modern-day salaryman take on a ruthless, power-driven world, using workplace savvy, relentless hustle, and relentless training to defy fate. The servant of the Dark God refuses to give up!

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: I Owe Billions in Debt, So I Was Forced to Work for an Evil God
I Owe A Billion Dollars And I am Forced to Become A Worker For An Evil God

title.english: Soul Pact: Working for an Evil God to Pay Off My Debt
title.native: 欠债亿万，我被迫成为邪神打工人
title.romaji: Qian Zhai Yi Wan, Wo Bei Po Chengwei Xieshen Dagong Ren

205185.description:
Everyone has gone mad, except me. And I will sweep away the madness!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

205186.description:
"You are destined to be in my arms."

Asami, who works at an apparel shop, is in a relationship with her boss, Minohara. But one day, she finds out that Minohara is getting married to another woman in the company. Just as Asami is devastated, realizing that she was nothing more than a playmate, a handsome man named Riku appears before her... A shocking, doting love suspense story about being loved to the core by a yandere stalker ❤

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 僕はあなたを愛しすぎてる
title.romaji: Boku wa Anata wo Aishi Sugiteru

205187.description:
Three years ago, Su Xing transmigrated to a high-martial world. This world is home to extraordinary experts known as "Professionals," but Su Xing awakened the sole hidden class—a Cultivator. However, he soon discovered that it's impossible to cultivate and level up in this world! Finally, Su Xing obtained his "golden finger": the Life Simulator! On one hand, he secretly grows stronger within the simulator—planting spiritual herbs and refining elixirs! On the other, he brings the spoils from his simulations into reality, quietly increasing his power!

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: The Low-Key Path of a Cultivator to Grand Ascension

title.native: 别人练级我修仙，苟到大乘再出山
title.romaji: Bieren Lian Ji Wo Xiuxian, Gou Dao Dacheng Zai Chushan

title.native: 漫画 京佳お嬢様と奥田執事
title.romaji: Manga Kyouka Ojou-sama to Okuda Shitsuji

205190.description:
A castrati is a male singer who has had part of his genitals cut off to preserve his beautiful voice. Their heyday was during the 18th century, when Italian opera flourished. At the Pietà dei Turchini, a music school and monastery, the young castrato Nicola and the aspiring composer Patrick meet. They pledge an eternal friendship. However, their friendship is repeatedly tested...

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

205191.description:
Klein, who fell from the throne of the King of Knights, was betrayed by his comrades and sentenced to be burned at the stake. In his final moments, Klein scoffs at the foolishness of this world and his past self. Now, having returned from hell, Klein has gained unparalleled power. He will make those who betrayed him pay the price...

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: The Revenge of the Betrayed Strongest Knight
裏切られた最強騎士の復讐

title.native: 被背叛的我偏要向帝国复仇
title.romaji: Bei Beipan De Wo Pianyao Xiang Diguo Fuchou

205192.description:
Throughout history, legends have circulated of the existence of spiritual realms. This belief has been debated by numerous scholars throughout the dynasties, including one poem: "From the Qi to the Tang dynasties, this mountain was barren and desolate, the spiritual realm desolate and rarely visited. The spiritual realm is beyond description, and even the work of ghosts is hard to find."

(Source: Tencent, translated)

205193.description:
Su Ming was once the world’s number one assassin, a hero who saved billions of his fellow humans and was honored as one of the Ten Great Powerhouses of the Dragon Nation. Yet, he was betrayed by the woman he loved and the brother he trusted, dying with hatred in his heart and buried within the S-class dungeon known as the Death Cavern.

Unexpectedly, he is reborn, returned to his high school days, on the very day of the awakening ceremony. This time, he gains a myth-grade talent upon awakening!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)
synonyms: I Start with Mythical Talent, One Sword Slays Kings!
Starting With a Mythic Talent, I Cut Down Gods!

title.native: 我开局神话天赋，一剑斩神！
title.romaji: Wo Kaiju Shenhua Tianfu, Yi Jian Zhan Shen!

205194.description:
On her way to the Peveril residence, Minerva finds herself lost in the rain. Frozen on the spot, weighed down by gloom, she catches her breath in shock when a man on horseback suddenly appears right in front of her. She tells the mysterious man that she wants to see the owner of the Peveril mansion, and he answers, “I'm Nick Peveril. Welcome to nowhere." This captivating man is her sister's husband? Surrounded by the splendor of the estate, Minerva gets a glimpse into the life her sister led―and she's certain Nick knows the reason behind her sister's death!

(Source: Renta!)

205195.description:
Halina, a princess of the kingdom of Abkar, who has never known freedom. She sneaks into a party where she wants a once-in-a-lifetime moment to herself and meets Rico, a beautiful millionaire. She wants to live for herself just for tonight....Halina, who has been lured to him, offers her virginity to Rico. As a result, she becomes pregnant with Rico's child and is ordered by her furious father to live in a remote palace where no one comes. Two months later, Rico appears in front of Halina, who is living a lonely life. He asks her to marry him, but tells her that he will never love her. A loveless marriage...Is this the price for living freely for just one night?

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 天使と千切れた赤い糸

205196.description:
Rebecca makes a life-changing decision on her thirtieth birthday―to embark on an adventure in order to shake up her mundane life! Her sexy boss, Kent, is protective of her and tries to put a stop to her idea, but her mind is set. With the help of her sister, Rebecca starts off with a makeover and then lands a date with a coworker. But Kent tries to get in the way again! Does he feel obligated to look out for her as her boss…or is there more to his strange behavior?

(Source: Renta!)

205197.description:
19th Century, United Kingdom. After an assassination attempt on the Prince Regent, a vassel, Duke Gabriel, carries out a secret investigation. Meanwhile, Gabriel's wife Olivia is distressed, wondering whether her husband will show up for their son's celebration. They had spent a beautiful, loving year of marriage together when her husband decided to cheat on her the day she gave birth to their son. They haven't shared a bed since, but now, her mother-in-law wants her to have another son for the sake of the family. With zero hope of their love being reignited, now she has to share a bed with him again...

(Source: Renta!)

205198.description:
Elizabeth works at a café in order to protect her family's precious farm. One day, a customer offers to pay her ten thousand dollars to hire Henry, a herdsman who's in need of a job. Needing the help, Elizabeth agrees. But what she doesn't know is that Henry is keeping a secret and only taking the job as a challenge! As their strange life together begins, the distance between them grows smaller and smaller...

(Source: Renta!)

205199.description:
Jake and Rachel have been at war over the custody of baby Emma. But when they're ordered to raise the baby together, they decide that living with one another might make the task easier. As they spend time together, Rachel is surprised to learn that Jake has a soft heart hidden beneath his arrogance. She finds her heart overflowing with feelings as she learns more about Jake's past, and then a passionate kiss changes everything!

(Source: Renta!)

205200.description:
Is it the advent of luck or the beginning of bad luck when a genius cheater meets a koi girl? From today on, let's change our fate! Click to get your own lucky koi!

(Source: WebComics)

205201.description: He, like a bright shooting star, descend to this world, but will eventually perish. He comes to me to fulfill my wish, but I just want to seize his bright light and keep it for a longer time. I don't have any wish. I just want you.

205202.description:
I woke up to find myself as Duke Charis Fall, with a wife and daughter!? Charis seems to be a man who doesn't care about his family, and there's tension in the Fall household. When I came to this world, the first thing I remembered was a certain otome game... but my daughter, Laurie, is the villainess in that game...!! I'll make sure my beloved wife and daughter are happy and won't let her become a villainess!!! The story of a father who works hard to avoid the bad ending begins!!!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title.native: 悪役令嬢の父親に転生したので、妻と娘を溺愛します
title.romaji: Akuyaku Reijou no Chichioya ni Tensei Shita node, Tsuma to Musume wo Dekiai Shimasu

205203.description:
Ihae’s life is turned upside down when she wakes up in the dark underworld of her favorite dating sim. To survive as an unnoticed background character, she must stop Dokyeom, heir to a powerful crime family, from becoming the obsessive gang boss who destroys everyone in the original story. But the more time they spend together, the more his fixation falls on her. Between school life, hidden quests, and dangerous secrets, can Ihae reach a happy ending, or is she already on the path to tragedy?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Adjusting the Gangster Male Lead's Intensity
To Tone Down the Gangster Male Lead

205204.description:
The transmigrated Lilith La Noella does everything she can to avoid her fiancé, Duke Edrion La Arkshad, the cause of her death in the original story. She even chooses an unpopular job as a horticulturist in the rural South to get as far away from him as possible. But this choice backfires when the empress calls Lilith back to the capital to give her the nearly impossible task of flowering the World Tree. Otherwise, her entire family will be put to death. Can Lilith dodge another tragic end? And will she flower something more in the process?

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: 世界樹にこよなく愛される庭師になってしまった件

title.english: The Beloved Gardener of the World Tree

205205.description:
Another summer holiday has arrived, and the little girl Gu Li Li finally meets her uncle Song Qian again. Indeed she prefers to call him brother and has harbored a secret crush upon him. This year, Song Qian brings Li Li to the green mountain to collect specimens, and before long, Li Li discovers that it is a magical world where plants and animals all can become spirits and ghosts...

(Source: MangaToon)

205206.description:
If I don't have a child with my less-than-appealing childhood friend, my favorite character won't be born?! Richelle, a lady of a noble family, retains the memories of her past life. She realizes she was reincarnated into her favorite game's world and is ecstatic, but that feeling doesn't last long. If she doesn't have a child with her childhood friend Lucian, she won't be able to give birth to her favorite character in the game, Mikaril. To make matters worse, the key piece to her puzzle won't stop teasing her! On top of that, he's a heartthrob and a major hit with the ladies in town! Richelle is sure, without a doubt, that she doesn't stand a chance. However, one fateful day, she closes the distance with him at a party. She can't let this chance slip by, so she pushes him down the first chance she gets. What happened next wasn't what she'd expected though...!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: Convincing My Childhood Friend to Father My Favorite Character!
title.native: 脈ナシ幼馴染と子作りしないと、推しが生まれません！
title.romaji: Myaku Nashi Osananajimi to Kotsukuri Shinai to, Oshi ga Umare Masen!

205207.description:
"The one who saved me from being offered as a sacrificial bride resembled my first love..." Yu, a girl with burn scars on her face, has never had a place to belong. She worked tirelessly for the family that took her in, but everything changed the day she started menstruating. Overjoyed, her foster father delivered a cruel decree―she was to offer herself as a sacrificial bride to Lord Suiryu, the monster said to protect the local water source.
