Having accepted that at least she'll die so others can live, yet overcome by despair, Yu sank into a nearby lake, but was saved by a young man covered in dragon-like scales who resembled her first love. A Japanese-style pure romance story about a lonely girl and a young man, and the love that slowly blossoms between them, is about to unfold.

(Source: Coolmic)

title.native: 水龍様の花嫁は初恋を憂う
title.romaji: Mizu Ryuu-sama no Hanayome wa Hatsukoi wo Ureu

title.native: 魔法しか愛せない孤高令嬢ですが、覚醒した弟子に超魔力で求婚されました
title.romaji: Mahou Shika Aisenai Kokou Reijou desu ga, Kakusei Shita Deshi ni Chou Maryoku de Kyuukon Sare Mashita

205209.description:
After a monster attack kills her family, Nina is sold to House Louvoirennais, where she meets Adrian—a tragic secondary lead destined for abuse, betrayal, and death. Determined to rewrite his fate, Nina becomes his friend and protector. As she rises through the ranks of the Black Knights, her simple plan is to save the sub-lead. But when Nina accidentally summons a powerful elemental named Sol, she realizes her destiny may be greater than just saving Adrian... She might have to save the world.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Knight Commander of the Second Male Lead

title.english: I Am the Commander of the Second Male Lead's Knights

205210.description:
"You really know how to tease a man, my princess..."

The political and romantic battle between the world's most gorgeous guy and a tomboy has begun!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: Troublesome Love in a Political Marriage: He's Dangerously Beautiful, and I'm Not Interested!
title.native: 愛がうざい政略結婚～傾国の美男子なんて興味ありません！
title.romaji: Ai ga Uzai Seiryaku Kekkon: Keikoku no Binanshi Nante Kyoumi Arimasen!

205211.description:
You will fulfill your role as my wife... and make love until you bear my child.

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: We Married for Politics but We Fell in Love
title.native: 仮面結婚の侯爵夫妻は今夜も本音が言えません
title.romaji: Kamen Kekkon no Koushaku Fusai wa Konyaku mo Honne ga Iemasen

title.native: ズボラ姉(配信者)が誤爆エロバズしたから開き直って姉弟でエロ配信する枠
title.romaji: Zubora Ane (Haishinsha) ga Gobaku Ero Buzz Shitakara Hirakinaotte Kyoudai de Ero Haishin suru Waku

205213.description:
In a world full of dungeons, monsters, magic, and non-humans, Marron Glace is a surprisingly strong shield bearer whose past is as mysterious as his constantly covered face. But the most peculiar thing about him isn't how he looks or his lack of modern knowledge—it's his appetite! As much as everyone else is disgusted, Marron is just as shocked to find that he can only stomach food made from monsters. Now, aside from his face, his penchant for monster meals is just one more thing to uncover.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Reincarnated as the Strongest Monster Eater: Revenge on the Tyrant Dragon

title.native: 魔物捕食者・転生者の俺は最強になって全てを奪ったドラゴンに復讐する
title.romaji: Mamono Hoshokusha: Tenseisha no Ore wa Saikyou ni Natte Subete wo Ubatta Dragon ni Fukushuusuru

205214.description:
The clash of civilizations between ants and humans

Jonathan Wells inherits a house according to his uncle's will and moves in with his family. Desperate to get to know his uncle, Jonathan receives a note from his grandmother, warning him not to go down into his uncle's basement. A chance encounter leads Jonathan to enter the basement, and he continues to visit it as if possessed. Simultaneously, in the ant community, male ant 327 is the first to awaken from hibernation and goes on a patrol with his comrades. During this patrol, all the patrolling ants except 327 die without knowing what happened. Sensing that danger is approaching his people, 327 gathers like-minded comrades to warn them of the danger, but is chased by the threatening "ants that smell like rocks," and ends up uncovering the truth hidden by his people.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

synonyms: The Devilishness of a Small Room

title.native: おれの癒やしのぽっちゃりくん

205219.description:
Takuto has lost all his memories after he met with an accident. While he found himself without anything to depend on, that's when a man named Yuuki appeared claiming, "I am your lover." This is the start of an overly dangerous romance as Takuto begins his confinement-like cohabitation with Yuuki! Just what is Yuuki's true identity? And what is the truth behind Takuto's accident?

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

Note: All chapters were split into multiple parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume releases.

title.native: その記憶はありません

205220.description:
1. Ao wo Sagasu Bokura (青を探す僕ら)
2. Kimi to Tsunagu 100-nenme no Monogatari (君と繋ぐ100年目の物語)
3. Funade no Uta (船出ノ唄)
4. Sora Girl Ten (宙ガール 天)

title.native: 大宙晃作品集「青を探す僕ら」
title.romaji: Oosora Akira Sakuhinshuu "Ao wo Sagasu Bokura"

205221.description:
1. Himemiko no Oni (姫巫女の鬼)
2. Hisana no Ao Oni (緋真の青鬼)
3. Tsui no Kami, Kotonoha no Shoujo (終の神, 言ノ葉の少女)

title.native: 大宙晃作品集「姫巫女の鬼」

205222.description: Shini, a bird girl, and Karma, a human boy. The two meet in a world where birds and humans are at odds with each other. What will be the fate of these two people who yearn for the sky...?

205223.description: Note: Includes "Warui Koto Shitai Series: Bangai-hen (ワルイコトシタイシリーズ　番外編)" and one extra chapter.
synonyms: ワルイコトシタイシリーズ　番外編

205224.description: The story is set in the Sengoku period. A shrine maiden princess who exterminates demons falls in love with the demon she saves. If it's natural to persecute demons that eat humans, what should be done about the demons that don't...

205225.description:
Myorin, the daughter of the head of the Ko clan, who protects the country with special powers, is powerless and useless without a mate. Since birth, she has lived with her guardian beast, Yasutora, and has been searching for a "soul mate," but one never appears. However, Myorin continues to train, searching for "what she can do." One day, the Ko family mansion is burned down and her mother is killed by a demon. Yasutora takes the injured Myorin and flees into the mountains, where he finds General Ejiryu and forcibly makes him Myorin's mate! Their souls are united, and despite only just meeting, they naturally feel the desire to "become one." What will happen to the two?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: 溺愛は復讐のあとで 無能力巫女と運命のつがい
title.romaji: Dekiai wa Fukushuu no Ato de: Munouryoku Miko to Unmei no Tsugai

synonyms: It's fate, so don't give up on me!

205227.description:
Originally a pastry chef at a famous dessert shop, she tragically dies and is reincarnated into the world of an otome game, becoming Aegelia, the villainous heiress who rivals for the title of heroine. To survive in this world and to taste all her favorite desserts, she'll use her dessert knowledge and, incidentally, win over a marquis!?

(Source: Kadokawa Taiwan, translated)
synonyms: 反派千金甜點師的有效主推攻略

title.native: 悪役令嬢のショコラティエは推しの攻略に有効でした
title.romaji: Akuyaku Reijou no Chocolatier wa Oshi no Kouryaku ni Yuukou Deshita

205228.description:
The world is divided into zombies, humans, and creatures somewhere in between. The spread of a virus known as "wind death disease," which turns living things into zombies, has completely changed the world. Are those infected zombies or humans...? While the treatment of zombies remains uncertain, Togo, who works as a conservation officer collecting and containing zombies, meets a strange boy who is neither zombie nor human. He is the only case of recovery from the disease, which is supposed to be fatal once a zombie is turned. Are zombies people? Or corpses?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: ガーディアン・オブ・ザ・デッド

205229.description:
Mano Misaki is almost 29 years old and has never had a boyfriend. As a result of her persistent virginity, she ends up spending the night with the company's most handsome man, Kutsuna, while drunk, without even remembering what happened!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: わたしの処女をもらってもらったその後。
title.romaji: Watashi no Shojo wo Moratte Moratta Sonogo.

205230.description:
This is the story of the protagonist, Haruto, who lost his memories from his childhood, and his quest to regain his lost memories and the only thing he has left: a promise he made to a girl whose face and name he doesn't know.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

205231.description:
After being turned down by her boyfriend and losing her job, 30-year-old Erina is at rock bottom. After deciding to participate in a countryside bus tour aimed at young adults in search of marriage, she meets Yuuma, a handsome younger farmer, but ruins the situation with some callous, unthinking words. Determined to change Yuuma's opinion of her and lacking any remaining ties to the city, Erina moves to the country and embarks on her own farming journey.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 農業男子とマドモアゼル イチゴと恋の実らせ方
title.romaji: Nougyou Danshi to Mademoiselle Ichigo to Koi no Minorasekata

205233.description:
A free-spirited older sister and a serious younger sister. The two sisters go on a drive...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: ラン（アウェイ），シスターズ

205234.description:
When he was a child, Hideki Tahara had a chance encounter with "Bogiwan," a monster feared by his late grandfather. Now that he is a working adult with a family, a formless visitor appears... When he is confronted by a junior coworker who loses his arm, uncanny phenomena at home, and unseen horrors, what he clings to is...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

synonyms: If I don't rehabilitate this Gomikasu idol, I'll die.
Renew these scum idols, or die!

title.native: ゴミカスアイドル更生させないと私が死ぬ
title.romaji: Gomikasu Idol Kouseisasenai to Watashi ga Shinu

205236.description:
After their home planet is destroyed and they are tasked with ensuring the survival of their descendants, Rosa, Flem, and Liz come to the far-flung, remote planet of Earth, relying on an ancient contract. The Earthling they visit is a reclusive, eccentric boy named Kagejino Miri, who is prone to prejudice. Earth's "common sense" doesn't concern the three of them,

They enjoy life on Earth freely, carefree, and the way they want to!! A comedy about interstellar interactions between strong alien girls and eccentric, prejudiced Earthlings!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 俺の×××はいらないらしい
title.romaji: Ore no xxx wa Iranai Rashii

205237.description:
Cover Illustration: Ugonba
1. Hai Byouin no Tsuioku (廃病院の追憶) [Enmaru Adachi]
2. [Shinrei Spot] Hitori Kakurenpo Hai Tunnel de Namahaishin (【心霊スポット】ひとりかくれんぼ廃トンネルで生配信) [Chimpirafu]
3. Yomiji Mura (黄泉路村) [Dano Hogano]
4. Jikobukken to Osananajimi (事故物件と幼なじみ) [Yatsuhashi]
synonyms: The Haunting Encounters of Him and Me
【心霊スポット】ひとりかくれんぼ廃トンネルで生配信
[Shinrei Spot] Hitori Kakurenpo Hai Tunnel de Namahaishin

title.native: 僕と彼の怪異遭遇譚 ホラーアンソロジーコミック
title.romaji: Boku to Kare no Kaii Souguu-tan: Horror Anthology Comic

205238.hashtag: #典型的な政略結婚をした俺のその後

title.native: 典型的な政略結婚をした俺のその後。
title.romaji: Tenkeiteki na Seiryaku Kekkon wo Shita Ore no Sonogo.

205239.description: Note: Includes the one-shots "Yakepacchi no Ushimitsudoki (やけっぱちの丑三つ時)", and "Karamawari Escape (からまわりエスケープ)" and one extra chapter.
synonyms: やけっぱちの丑三つ時
からまわりエスケープ

title.native: ぴゅあキュンBL コミックアンソロジー

205242.description: Note: Chapters 1 to 3 were previously published in Dom/Sub Universe BL [Command play] Comic Anthology (Dom／SubユニバースＢＬ［Command play］コミックアンソロジー), Pure Kyun BL: Comic Anthology (ぴゅあキュンBL コミックアンソロジー), and Dom/Sub Universe BL [Kiss and Cum] Comic Anthology (Dom／SubユニバースBL[Kiss and Cum]コミックアンソロジー), respectively.
synonyms: Hug me, look at me, kiss me.

title.native: 抱きしめて、見つめて、キスして
クローゼットにお星さま

205244.description:
"Don't you want me to do it?"

The top host approached me and hugged me...I can't restrain myself around a professional...!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Simultaneously released in long-strip and traditional formats, with 18 episodes and 6 chapters respectively.

title.native: ホストに狂わず恋がしたい！

205245.description:
"Let me touch you even deeper."

His sweet whispers make my heart race… I want to marry him, even though I've decided to know my place in this world and lead a steady life…!

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Simultaneously released in long-strip and traditional formats, with 9 episodes and 3 chapters respectively.

title.english: The Perfect Boss Melts the Former Villainess's Heart
title.native: ほしがりません。今世は。～元悪役令嬢はスパダリ上司に溶かされる～
title.romaji: Hoshigaremasen. Konse wa.: Moto Akuyaku Reijou wa Supadari Joushi ni Tokasareru

205246.description:
"I'll take responsibility for your lascivious body."

An unstoppable craving… a lust that only a husband can satisfy.

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Simultaneously released in long-strip and traditional formats, with 18 episodes and 6 chapters respectively.

title.native: みだらな熱、旦那様のくちづけでほどける初夜
title.romaji: Midarana Netsu, Danna-sama no Kuchizuke de Hodokeru Shoya

205247.description:
"You're... a woman!?"

The evil prince of my favorite romance game is actually a crossdressing girl!? A love story between the game's hero and the (female) evil prince begins!

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Simultaneously released in long-strip and traditional formats, with 24 episodes and 8 chapters respectively.

title.english: Accidentally Reborn as an Evil Crossdressing Woman
title.native: 悪役王子に転生したはずが、実は男装悪役令嬢でした
title.romaji: Akuyaku Ouji ni Tensei Shita Hazu ga, Jitsu wa Dansou Akuyaku Reijou deshita

205248.description:
Share your passion with everyone and support your dreams! The story of the struggles of the VTuber agency Miripro!

Nonono Nono, who was scouted by the VTuber agency MilliPro, was visiting for a tour. Meanwhile, a VTuber affiliated with the agency, Amakami Konomi, had a malfunction with the equipment during her stream. What action did Nono take in response to the incident?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: Million Production: Aiming for a million connections

title.native: みりぷろ -無数の繋がりを目指して-
title.romaji: MilliPro: Million no Tsunagari wo Mezashite
B to L no Aida ni wa

205250.description:
Notes:
- All chapters were split into two parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume release.
- Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 大人の放課後～教師と教師のかくしごと
title.romaji: Otona no Houkago: Kyoushi to Kyoushi no Kakushigoto

205251.description:
You can beat anyone now. As a goddess, I can guarantee that ? The main character is Herque Kinesis, and he's been endowed with the skill of "telekinesis", which is considered to be the weakest skill possible. Even though Herque's the eldest son of a duke, because of his weak skill, everyone looks down on him. Then, one day, Herque's father and step-siblings denounce him, and while the maid, Ema, the only person in the entire world who understands him, looks on, Herque is pathetically killed. But, when Herque wakes up, he's with the goddess, Pipina. Despite offering Herque any special skill he wants, he says his wants to become strong using only "telekinesis", and this desire is what motivates Pipina into giving him special training over the next 2000 years. After this long training period, the goddess uses her powers to send Herque back to the real world where he reunites with Ema and vows vengeance upon the Kinesis family who abused him so much!

(Source: CLLENN)
synonyms: Unrivaled With the Useless Skill: Telekinesis (But It’s Max Level) – With Just a Wave of My Hand. No Chants, No Special Moves, Just Pure Willpower!

title.english: Dominating With an Useless Skill: Telekinesis(Level Max) -One Thought is All It Takes-
title.native: はずれスキル念動力(ただしレベルMAX)で無双する～手をかざすだけです。詠唱とか必殺技とかいりません。念じるだけで倒せます～
title.romaji: Hazure Skill Nendouryoku (Tadashi Level MAX) de Musou suru: Te wo Kazasu Dake desu. Eishou to ka Hissatsu Waza to ka Irimasen. Nenjiru Dake de Taosemasu

205252.description:
Gu Ning, a love novice and galgame loser, travels to a supposedly hardcore court intrigue game called "Above the Empress," becoming the perverted commander of the Jinwu Guard. She knows she must protect Empress Jiang Yuelin and conquer the lands to unify humanity. Despite possessing a system and knowledge beyond her time, she's still terrified because this wacky intrigue game actually has options, and whenever she chooses, she always picks the wrong one!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
synonyms: The Empress? I Only Date My Wife

title.native: 女帝？我只和娘子谈恋爱
title.romaji: Nüdi? Wo Zhi He Niangzi Tan Lianai

title.native: インビジブル・ワールド
呪いのせいにしておこう
title.romaji: Noroi no Sei ni Shite Okou

205255.description:
Monsters - strange creatures that were once called monsters. Mikurube Meguri, a member of the Monster Control Bureau, meets a young hunter named Oekiri Kanoka. The Matagi, who remains in the modern era, serves as a "monster hunter" for the Monster Control Bureau, turning his blade against strange disasters on a national scale. A modern Japanese tale of monster hunting, Kaiba.

(Source: Yanmaga, translated)

205256.description: Note: Chapter 1 was originally self-published under the title "Happy Encounter (ハッピーエンカウント)". It was then licensed by Akita Shoten for serialization.
synonyms: ハッピーエンカウント

title.native: ボーイミーツ異形さま

205258.description:
The daily story of Nokaze, a female college student and a lady of manners and customs.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: ノカゼのピンクなトリセツ

205259.description:
Riku, a university student who was left devastated after his long-term girlfriend was brutally stolen by another man, undergoes a total transformation under the guidance of a charismatic middle-aged man named Yuji! From a "loser dog" to the King of Beasts, Riku aims to become the ultimate lion! Witness the birth of a legendary playboy in the Reiwa era!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

synonyms: The Hitman's Meal of Ultimate Bliss

205262.description:
In a world where magic is commonplace, Chrom, the son of nobility, possesses no magical power whatsoever. Though unable to wield magic, he trained in swordsmanship, striving to be useful to the world. Yet his own father and brother branded him useless and banished him. His exile destination was a forest teeming with monsters. As Chrom lay crushed by despair, a monster appeared before him. Just as he resigned himself to certain defeat, the cursed sword discarded alongside him spoke to Chrom...

(Source: Coamix, translated)

title.native: 魔力ゼロの落ちこぼれ、呪殺の妖刀に選ばれる。
title.romaji: Maryoku Zero no Ochikobore, Jusatsu no Youtou ni Erabareru.

205263.description:
While a sensational serial murder case grips the public, the notorious killer himself shows up at the doorstep of Chihiro Yoshida, a college student who lives a life of absolute freedom and debauchery. To save his own skin, Yoshida makes a bizarre proposal: "Why don't you assume my identity and live here?" Can Yoshida really pull off this "impersonation cohabitation" with a serial killer (and maybe even have fun doing it)? The master artist renowned for drawing the ultimate handsome men, Hiromasa Okujima, brings you a twisted, chaotic comedy about a high-stakes charade where getting found out is absolutely not an option!

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

title.native: シリアルさんといっしょ

205265.description:
With her flawless career and dignified looks, Nozomi Tachibana (30) is a career-oriented female CEO who everyone admires. One day, she angers the sexually harassing president of a client company, putting the company she runs in a difficult situation. Her only chance to turn things around is to appear on a matchmaking survival show! However, Nozomi is a virgin who has not had a romantic relationship in 30 years...!?

(Source: Mangabox, translated)

title.native: クイーン、ビジネス恋愛のお時間です。～こじらせアラサー女社長vs10人のクセつよ男たち～
title.romaji: Queen, Business Renai no Ojikan Desu.: Kojirase Arasaa Onna Shachou vs 10-nin no Kuse Tsuyo Otoko-tachi

205268.description:
Meredy, a mob character who is killed at the beginning of a girls' game, has been reincarnated as the "Corpse Lady." Her goal is to prevent the encounter between the game's mastermind, the First Prince Jake, and the "Book of Demon Summoning," which holds the key to avoiding the bad ending! Meredy uses her memories from before her reincarnation to get in Jake's way, but for some reason, Jake asks her, "Would you like to make a deal with me?" and nominates her as his "playmate" instead! Set in the school of a girls' game, a love romance begins, featuring a chase between a mob lady and a yandere mastermind prince!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 死体役令嬢に転生したら黒幕王子に執着されちゃいました
title.romaji: Shitaiyaku Reijou ni Tensei Shitara Kuromaku Ouji no Shuuchakusare Chaimashita

205269.description:
Takuma Yumioka (28) is a former collegiate swimmer who now works repairing photocopiers. Ryohei Inuzuka (29) is a relay runner who got scouted to be on a supermarket's professional team. Though they never interacted much when they shared a class in college, a chance meeting has them drinking at a bar together for the first time in five years.

Though Takuma, ever popular with the ladies, has become disillusioned with relationships, Ryohei makes a drunken suggestion that he can't ignore... Since neither of them want to go all the way with a partner, they could try dating each other...

While friends to lovers isn't how they saw their relationship going down, surely two straight guys can make it work... right?

(Source: Junet)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: I Don't Want To Do The Dirty, So I'll Date A Friend
title.native: Hしたくないので友達とつきあいます
title.romaji: H Shitakunai node Tomodachi to Tsukiaimasu

205271.description:
“I’m saying, I’m okay with doing it with you…!”

The National Guard’s sole Omega is Kyouya. While he has a strong sense of justice, his “buddy” is the brilliant but disagreeable Alpha, Leo. The two of them would fight nonstop until one day, someone injected Kyouya with a heat-inducer. He didn’t want anyone to find out about this misstep, but when Leo comes looking for him, Kyouya demands Leo… to cum inside him? It was only supposed to be a temporary fix, but Leo’s gentle touch feels so good it totally throws Kyouya off his rhythm!

(Source: Brite Shuppan, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: Don't Fall in Love with Me, My Buddy
Don't fall for me, my buddy

title.native: 恋してくれるな、マイバディ

205272.description:
Tatsumaki tells the story of a novelist who is so much in a writing slump that he is actually thinking about selling his life and soul. He meets a mysterious man and discusses creative writing with him; how things such as reality and existing established conventions stop him from writing. A strange chain of events will draw in together a test knitter working under a harsh environment, a frivolous man on an online dating app, and a woman carrying a corpse.

(Source: Anime News Network, edited)

205273.description:
A surly man and a black-haired high school girl run a business that involves possessing the high school girl's body. The only men and women who come to borrow her body are those with twisted desires!

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)
synonyms: You Can Borrow Her Body for 24 Hours Only.

title.native: 24時間、彼女のカラダ貸します。

205274.description:
416 (aka Yong Im), a spy from a certain socialist country, is tasked with infiltrating Japan. In order to blend into Japanese society, he chooses to work at a convenience store, a capitalist den of evil. There, he meets Moriyama Nozomi, an otaku who is a shut-in and has a slightly strange sense of distance between people. This is a clumsy love comedy about a spy and an otaku, both of whom have a flawed sense of distance between people.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Note: Includes 13 extra chapters.
synonyms: Spy 416: The Spy Who Loved Otaku

title.native: 工作員４１６ オタクを愛したスパイ

205275.description:
"Paradon!" These are the words of praise shouted to the goalkeeper who made the biggest save of all time. This is the Toyosu Higashi High School soccer club. Harumi Yuusei, a sophomore, is the reserve second goalkeeper with no match experience since entering high school. With no responsibility for conceded goals and no pressure of being in the starting lineup, Yuusei was living a carefree life as a soccer player. However, when his younger brother, Harumi Arashi, a genius forward, quits a professional training organization and joins the Toyosu Higashi High School soccer club, Yuusei's fate begins to change drastically. "Kunitachi" is worth risking your entire youth for. The two brothers are going. Kunitachi. The goalkeeper is the star! The high school soccer story begins!!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

205276.description:
University student Miyata Yoa spends most of her time outside of school working part-time jobs to earn money for tuition and living expenses. When she gets home, she does housework for her spendthrift mother. However, she has no time, money, or friends for fun. She simply consumes her life, wearing down both her mind and her physical strength every day. However, her daily life, bound by the curse of her love for her mother, changes when she meets Enei Masa.

Love is not a magic spell that can erase everything. Toxic parents, abuse, poverty... This is a story about these women who live with the realities of modern society, finding hope for the present even without knowing what the future holds.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

205277.description:
At the age of 15, everyone is gifted with a talent - "skills." Chamber was a member of Akatsuki, a party made up entirely of young members that had distinguished itself in the city, but he was expelled from Akatsuki after obtaining a mysterious skill called "Level Up," whose effects are unclear...! Although abandoned by the other members who had obtained powerful skills, Chamber continues to work as a solo adventurer. It was during this time that he discovered the true value of the skill known as "Level Up." "The more enemies you defeat, the higher your level becomes and the stronger you become." After realizing that his skill was not just a "useless skill," Chamber has a fateful encounter with a certain girl and begins to spend his days pursuing strength...!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 外れスキル『レベルアップ』のせいでパーティーを追放された少年は、レベルを上げて物理で殴る
title.romaji: Hazure Skill "Level Up" no Sei de Party wo Tsuihou Sareta Shounen wa, Level wo Agete Butsuri de Naguru

205279.description:
The dawn of the 20th century, a difficult period for women to realize their dreams. At an art academy in London, Lili, a Japanese art student chasing her dreams, meets Kit, an artistic prodigy from a family of aristocrats. Their meeting, transcending social status and their home countries, will set their fates in motion...!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

205281.description:
Ascend in half a month, become a Saint in half a year. Speedrunning immortal cultivation, for limitless fun!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

205282.description:
Fang Li was marked incompletely by a beastman as a child, and has been troubled by his heat periods and pheromones. Years later, a wolf, Karnal, came forward to take responsibility. Fang Li immediately recognizes and fears Karnal as the culprit who often appears in his dreams. An evil ravenous beastman from his dreams or a fervently loyal doggo, which one is the real him?!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
synonyms: The Wolf Lord Wants to Take Responsibility for Me

title.romaji: Lang Jun Xiang Dui Wo Fu Ze

205283.description:
Chiara, the youngest Li, is the apple of her family's eye. When she first meets her ex-fiance's brother, Everett, who's rumored to be a harsh and ruthless mafia boss in Cidginia, she falls hard. And he falls harder.

(Source: WebComics)

205285.description:
The blind Duchess regained her sight—only to witness her fiancé cheating on her that very day. Determined to take revenge on the scumbag and reclaim her family title, she made a bold move at the wedding—swapping grooms and marrying the infamous, devilishly handsome fugitive instead! Thus begins the tale of a Duchess and a wanted man, where marriage comes first and love follows later.

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: The Duke's Daughter Married the Fugitive

title.native: 公爵小姐和逃犯闪婚了

205286.description:
In an apocalypse overrun by monsters, where everyone lives in fear… I possess a system that lets me capture them!” “A seductive spider demoness, a city-sized behemoth, even the legendary Black and White Wuchang—all have become my pets!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

205288.description:
How to survive in a chaotic world overrun by zombies? Let’s learn from Lin Fan: obey the law, work to earn money, strive to buy a car and house, and be an outstanding citizen who single-handedly flips the chaotic world!

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: I Single-Handedly Crush the Chaotic World

title.romaji: Wo Yige Ren Kan Fan Luanshi

205291.description:
Demon Lord Lin Tianhong has ruled the Demon Realm in solitude for over ten thousand years until fate finally grants him a chance at love. Just as he begins to savor his newfound happiness, a shocking revelation shakes his world: his beloved wife is the reincarnation of Empress Xihe, the Central Heavenly Empress he defeated in a legendary battle millennia ago! Now, he must conceal his true identity from her, all while navigating the delicate balance of love and past enmity. Will he be able to protect their love, or will the secrets of their past tear them apart?

(Source: Webnovel)

With no friends, the only classmate who keeps talking to her is Gaku Saiki, an impossibly-straightforward boy who's as mysterious as he is hard to figure out. As Natsume gets to know him, can she finally become the person she's always wanted to be?

At Omori High School, a school for delinquents, everyone is gunning for the 35th head, Meriken, and the days are filled with fighting. First-year student Kenny challenges Meriken, but is easily beaten up. He looks up at the sky and cries at his own powerlessness. However, when Meriken accidentally eats Kenny's lunch, he is shocked by how delicious it is, as if he's been hit with a heavy punch! Realizing that his cooking skills can be a weapon, Kenny vows to capture the stomachs of all the students and rise to the top of Omori High School!

205381.description:
Rei Takashiro, CEO of a pharmaceutical company specializing in secondary genders, decides to personally volunteer for the clinical trials of a new drug for alphas. Upon returning to his office, he is shocked to find his secretary Takashi in a powerful state of rut with no known cause. As they scramble for emergency suppressants, Takashi confesses that he's a "superior alpha" ― that is, a special secondary gender known as "sigma"... Sigmas are so rare that there's still no clear method of treating their rut. All out of options, Rei reluctantly offers up his alpha body as a remedy...
After the pair get intimate in an attempt to calm Takashi's heightened state, Rei's body somehow begins to change...!

In this omegaverse manga starring a secretary and his CEO, an alpha is turned into an omega!

(Source: Renta!)

"Sentinels" cannot live without their "Guides"— Koudai, an ordinary high school student, reunites after several years with his childhood friend Shiro, whom he once had feelings for. Their joyful reunion is short-lived when Koudai learns that Shiro is a "Sentinel" living in the underworld, and he himself is a "Guide," a person with supernatural abilities. As a price for their heightened senses, Sentinels face life-threatening danger unless they physically connect with their Guides. Shiro is no exception, and he demands sex from Koudai...?! "If it means letting others touch you, then I’ll—" As they give in to their physical desires, special feelings gradually begin to grow. Koudai starts to desperately wish to save Shiro from the underworld, but...

(Source: Overlap, translated)

Shunichi Izumi is an office worker who became somewhat sleep deprived because his boyfriend dumped him. During one of his sleepless nights, he comes across a rental boyfriend service that specializes in cuddling to help sleep! Wanting to sleep no matter what, he makes an order while drunk, causing a shallow-looking guy named Ren to show up. Plus, the cuddling was way more close-contact than he expected!! Getting held in Ren's muscular arms makes Izumi to react down there... On top of that, Ren asks if he wants help, and uses his large hands to make him cum in no time...!!

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

205389.description:
Obsessed lab hermit Han Woo-Jin has a scandalous secret: his passion for science is literal. When he hits a breakthrough, his body reacts with an uncontrollable, physical intensity that has earned him the nickname Mad Woo-Jin. Driven by cold logic, he treks to Deokmu Mountain to debunk rumors of a gold-granting goblin. Instead, he finds Baekbaek, a breathtaking god of wealth. Forget the gold, Woo-Jin has found the ultimate specimen...and he’s ready to experiment until they both reach their limit.

(Source: Lezhin US)

205390.description:
"What a cute little spy you are."
These unexpected words are shared between a straight-laced knight and a beautiful spy torn between love and duty in this fantasy rom-com!

Rishur, a spy blessed with extraordinary beauty, has infiltrated an enemy kingdom for a certain mission. The order given to him was this: make Syvil, the knight commander known as the "Devil of the Battlefield," betray his own country. An easy mission considering Rishur's devastating charm. Using his greatest weapon, his looks, Rishur tries to seduce him, but his tricks won't work on this rigid, no-nonsense knight... or so he thinks. Suddenly, Rishur feels Syvil's breath growing hotter and hotter. Then Syvil says, "You're the one who seduced me." Before he can even run, Syvil catches him by the waist...?!

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

205391.description:
"You're so cute, I want to devour you."
Get ready for a boys' love story about a lone wolf and a plain boy, set in the sweet world of the Pomegaverse!

Taiga, a college student, is obsessed with a celebrity pet Pomeranian named Pomerin. He led a loner life where he had no interest in anything besides Pomerin, until one day he ran into a lost... Pomerin?! He takes him home for the night and falls asleep in his fluffy fur. However, when Taiga wakes up the next morning, in his arms lies a plain boy he recognises as his classmate! With white hair and teary eyes, said plain boy started to look cute! "I took you in... Let me take care of you."

Loving the boy in both his Pomeranian form and human form, the lone wolf's fervent love story begins!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: Tail or Not, I'm Into You
title.native: しっぽがなくても、きみがすき
title.romaji: Shippo ga Nakute mo, Kimi ga Suki

205392.description:
In a world where yokai live among humans in disguise, there exists a shrine known as the Sakamori which is tasked with guarding the boundary between humans and spirits. Kotaro, a misanthropic demon, enters the service of the Sakamori on his twentieth birthday. His master, Yushin, is a human who looks frail and defenseless, and life with the gentle shrine keeper seems a little dull at first. However, after a certain incident, Kotaro suddenly goes into heat… "Your demon is suffering, you know. If you're Sakamori, you'll do something about it, won't you?" Trying to quell the smoldering heat inside his body, Kotaro throws these provocative words at Yushin…

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: The Burning Demon Serves the Azure
title.romaji: Mayuru Oni wa Ao ni Tsukafu

205393.description:
"If you're not leaving, I'll touch you more," blurts out a good-natured university student to an awkward salesman, kicking off this romantic comedy! Asahi has just moved to Tokyo when a door-to-door salesman named Fuji comes knocking. Feeling sorry for the expressionless Fuji, Asahi lets him into his home. Hoping to finally get rid of the persistent salesman, he buys a product and breathes a sigh of relief… only for Fuji to show up again. In the sweltering heat, Asahi loses his cool and, in a moment of flustered confusion, he asks, "Will this make you leave?" before kissing him. But Fuji's expression remains unchanged, driving Asahi crazier as he touches Fuji's warm, sweaty skin…

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: Teaching the Persistent Salesman a Lesson

205395.description:
Lee Seha lands a coveted dual role as a researcher and zookeeper at a highly secure, specialized facility. Upon her arrival, she is assigned to oversee five select Breeding Males kept within the Free-range Breeding Facility. Her primary, clinical objective is simple yet highly intimate: to successfully harvest their reproductive cells for research.

However, managing five physically imposing, genetically unique men proves far more complicated than any textbook prepared her for. As Seha conducts her daily rounds, the boundary between professional duty and raw temptation begins to blur. The wild, untamed men quickly grow attached to their new handler, viewing her as far more than just Ms. Keeper. What began as a sterile, scientific operation rapidly devolves into a series of highly charged, dangerous, and erotic encounters that threaten to consume her entirely.

(Source: Lezhin US)

205396.description:
Seduce a man you just met and marry him in a week?

On the eve of her sister's wedding, Princess Liët of Chalonne meets the imperial prince sent as a congratulatory envoy. But instead of gifts, this prince delivers a threat.

“Marry my cousin, Cain, and uncover his weakness.”

“If a princess about to marry were to pass away... wouldn't that be a tragedy?”

To protect her sister, Liët attempts to seduce Cain, the Iron Archduke known as an ice pick, an artificial being. But she hits a wall from the start.

“Please refrain from approaching me.”

Cain effortlessly deflects all of Liet's efforts. Eventually, Liet even proposes a contract marriage, determined to become his wife...

“You seemed quite exhausted last night, so I'll be gentle today.”

The impenetrable fortress that was Cain vanishes without a trace, and he begins to cling to Liet like a dog...?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
synonyms: My Sweet and Loyal Grand Duke
Le Cœur du Duc ne Bat que pour Moi

205397.description:
Adrina has lived as her dead twin brother since she was eighteen. Known as the Mad Dog of Palesa Palace, she's assigned to guard Duke Julius. One problem: he should be older than her. So why does he look like a child?

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: Perfectly Terrible Example of a Curse
A Bad Example of a Perfect Curse

205398.description:
The comedy manga centers on Kaede, a tough-looking yakuza, who is also very strong when it comes to fighting. But Kaede has another side that he dare not tell anyone... Kaede is also the famous Moe manga artist Maple. As he lives a two-faced life, it's a ruthless battle in the yakuza world and in the world of manga deadlines for Kaede.

(Source: Anime News Network)

205399.description:
Yuji and his university friends go camping in Hokkaido. What was supposed to be a fun and enjoyable finale before job hunting turns into hell when a bloodthirsty brown bear attacks! A terrifying panic horror story with brutal fangs and claws!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

205400.description:
The manga centers on high school student Meimei Kisaragi who likes to add a twist to her school meals. Her curiosity about food brings change not just to her meals, but also to the people around her.

(Source: Anime News Network)

205401.description:
Suiran, a girl who grew up strong in the mountains, is to enter the harem as one of the 18 concubines. Then, the handsome Emperor Yoshimune orders her to find out the true identity of the ghosts that appear in the harem...!? A Chinese harem fantasy with gender reversal and mystery solving!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

205402.description:
The novels, set in the Meiji era over a century ago, follow Shino Nakamura, a young girl who is tricked into becoming live bait for the fearsome Tengu creatures who dwell in the mountains. The white Tengu who appears before her, however, offers to save her instead of eating her.

(Source: Anime News Network, edited)

title.native: 白天狗の贄嫁～毒持ちの令嬢はかりそめの妻となる～
title.romaji: Shiro Tengu no Nieyome: Dokumochi no Reijou wa Kari Some no Tsuma to Naru

205403.description:
Kiki, a beautiful woman who always wears a bare belly button, is troubled by the fact that she can't have sex with men. The reason for this is that Nakaba, a junior from her middle school days, has left her with no other way to derive sexual pleasure than through her belly button! In order to purge Nakaba who has made her body like this, Kiki decides to visit him, who has since become a belly button researcher. However, while she wants to defeat Nakaba by making him cum miserably, she ends up having him pleasure her belly button instead...!? A new door opens in this romantic comedy about unusual fetishes!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: こんなの全然エロくない！

205404.description:
When she dies, she travels into liaozhai world (A famous Chinese legendary book) by accident. Bad guys are unexpectedly handsome and cool while good guys are weak and half-witted! Couples were supposed to be together don't know each other while friends were expected to support each other become enemies! What happened? Everything is in a mess! Can our heroine retrieve the situation and win her own love?

(Source: MangaToon)

title.romaji: Kuai Chuan Zhi Liao Zhai Qi Yuan

205405.description:
Aliche and Orland's engagement contract stipulated that he could have no more than two lovers... Aliche is the heir to the Briator Marquisate, and is engaged to the third prince, Orland. Aliche is disgusted with Orland's philandering nature, so she arranges a meeting to discuss changing his behavior. However, the prince has some unbelievable words for Aliche!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Seems His Highness Found True Love Again (lol)
title.native: 殿下は今日も真実の愛を見つけたらしいですね（笑）
title.romaji: Denka wa Kyou mo Shinjitsu no Ai wo Mitsuke Tarashii desu ne (Wara)

205406.description:
If a thousand-year-old fox demon is your sixteenth birthday gift, will you accept it? Ling Xiangnuan, the young lady of a magic family, was accidentally apprenticed to the self-proclaimed "Demon King" Bai Mo. Will her ordinary life turn into a magic journey (love)?

(Source: Webnovel)

205407.description:
The devil leader who lives on human desires accidentally tied his fate with the spy girl "Pearl", and the cold devil had his only weakness. In this sweet and dangerous love chase, the two opened up the most painful forbidden areas in each other's hearts and learned about each other's unknown past. At this time, a deeper conspiracy and danger are approaching them...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

205408.description:
After transmigrating into a cyberpunk world, she defeated the BOSS and rose to the top.

Kui Xin was one of the lucky few to be selected to become a beta tester for an upcoming game, 'Crimson Earth'. A futuristic game with a mix of cyberpunk and lovecraft elements.

However, things soon took a wild turn after she realised she got transported into a parallel world where hyper intelligent AI monitors everyone's movement while playing the virtual game.

Supernatural beings, Cyborgs, Secret Cults, and Abnormal humans took the spotlight in this new world.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)
synonyms: After Transmigrating into the Cyberpunk Game, I Defeated the BOSS and Successfully Rose to the Top

title.native: 穿进赛博游戏后干掉BOSS成功上位
title.romaji: Chuan Jin Sai Bo Youxi Hou Gandiao BOSS Chenggong Shangwei

205409.description:
After waking up from sleep, Ji Que finds himself in a bizarre, god-haunted world where immortal mountains have collapsed, temples lie in ruins, monsters wear human skins, and wild gods feast on marrow. At the same time, he gains a unique ability: insight can be accumulated and spent like money—the more he saves up, the more miraculous the revelations he can unlock.

Dragged into a series of grotesque and surreal events, Ji Que encounters a White-Bone Bodhisattva who spews lotus flowers to “purify” all things, and later Laojun, who refines hearts and concocts pills. Yet beneath the rampant demons and monsters lurks something even more terrifying—the human heart itself.

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: Divine and Mysterious World, I Have Unique Comprehension
I Possess Unique Insight in the Divine World

title.native: 神诡世界，我有特殊悟性
title.romaji: Shen Gui Shi Jie, Wo You Teshu Wuxing

205410.description:
All of the strongest have been raised by the "Mentor." A gentle young man named Haru is living in a run-down church in the outskirts of a frontier city, but his real identity is the legendary "mentor" whose pupils' names are famous throughout the entire continent. The next target of his guidance is Rebecca, a mid-rank adventurer whose progress had plateaued. How will Haru nurture the latent abilities of a girl who has given up on herself?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: The Mentor in a Frontier City

205411.description:
Betrayed by my stepsister, abandoned by my fiancé, slandered as a villainess by my beloved people and executed—me. But this lifetime, I won't make the same mistake. The thrilling reversal of the overly diligent “villainess” begins!!!

Duchess Belinda, as the fiancée of Crown Prince Raymond, had lived with an almost clumsy diligence. Yet he despised her earnestness, relying instead on his half-sister Margaret to intercede for him.

“I must thank Margaret. If I try hard enough, Prince Raymond will surely love me someday...!”

Believing this, Belinda was suddenly arrested one day on the completely unfounded charge of “murdering the Queen.” Dragged to the execution platform, she learned her final truth: Raymond and Margaret were lovers, and Margaret had killed the queen. She had been framed by them all along... Consumed by intense regret as the flames consumed her, Belinda awoke two years before her execution.

"I won't make the same mistake this time. I won't let them use me again. I'll walk the right path.“

With this resolve, she approaches ”a certain person“ who caused her execution in her past life—!? Belinda, slandered as a ”wicked woman" in her past life, uses superhuman diligence and her knowledge of the past to climb to the pinnacle of aristocratic society!! The duchess's thrilling revenge begins now.

(Source: Futabasha, translated)
synonyms: The Diligent Villainess Gets Her Revenge in This Life
きんべんなあくじょはこんせでやりかえすたてよみ
성실한 악녀는 이번 생에 복수를 꿈꾼다

title.native: 勤勉な悪女は今世でやり返す
title.romaji: Kinbenna Akujo wa Konse de Yarikaesu

205412.description:
Felciana, a girl who loves to read, is saved from falling down the stairs by a young man. He is Yuto Historia, the eldest son of a prominent family whom she last met when she was a child, and for some reason, he later proposes to her. Although the reason for his proposal is a mystery, she accepts his proposal. After their engagement, the two gradually begin to interact, and Yuto, a cool government official, keeps making her heart flutter. However, it seems that Yuto has a secret...

In fact, this is the world of the game "Utopia," and Yuto is a reincarnated person! Yuto has been in love with Felciana since before his reincarnation, and he uses all his knowledge of the game to try to get her to like him...!? A devoted and clumsy love fantasy!!

(Source: Nihon Bungeisha, translated)

title.native: 恋する転生政務官はハッピーエンドの夢を見る
title.romaji: Koisuru Tensei Seimukan wa Happy End no Yume wo Miru

205413.description:
Se-Cheong, a returning student living alone and a homebody, is plagued by noise pollution from his upstairs neighbor. She tried leaving notes and even visiting, but to no avail. Furious at the handsome, unassuming upstairs neighbor, Se-Cheong embarks on a series of cute(?) revenge plots, never knowing how they'll resonate.

"Hey, you're the same age as me."

There's no such thing as too much bad blood, and to think they'll end up running into each other during a group project! The upstairs nuisance is Seo Kang-Hyun, a famous, popular, and gossipy Western painting major. He's someone from another world with whom he'd never normally associate, but what's his ulterior motive? Kang-Hyun slowly begins to penetrate Se-Cheong's wary heart... What will happen if we, who are polar opposites in every way, meet? A full-fledged single-person romance, Introduction to Living Alone.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

205414.description:
"Get down on all fours like a dog. I'm gonna fuck you good."

Web novels were her life and her truth. And among them, love was the most corrupting. It was only natural that Maeng Hae-Eun was bewitched by Nam Ju-Kang, who bore an uncanny resemblance to the male lead in her novel. A gangster organization disguised as a corporation. Tall, broad shoulders, thick muscles. A cold tone and charisma to boot. To capture the ideal man she'd longed for in her dreams, Hae-Eun decides to become the female lead in a tragic romance.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
synonyms: Delusional Romance Is a Bad Idea
Be Careful When You Use Hypnosis
白雪姫を俺のモノにする方法

205417.description:
Seo-Woo Yoon, the secret daughter of a politician, hides a bold nature beneath her obedient facade. Eun-Hyuk Kim, heir to WM Group, tries to control her—but her quiet rebellion draws him in. Their clash deepens into love, and when she breaks free, they begin a strange yet sweet married life.

(Source: Manta)

205418.description: Note: Part of Metatoon's Office Danpyeonseon (오피스 단편선) Collection.

synonyms: I can't help it! It's first love

205421.description:
Notes:
- Originally self-published as part of the BOYxBOY COLLECTION! anthology, was then compiled by Libre for commercial release.
- Chapter 1 contains newly drawn content exclusive to the volume release.
synonyms: ゆるみつ BLアイドルになろう！編
ゆるみつ BLアイドルデビュー編

205422.description:
"From today, we're adding a 'lover contract' to the mix." After discovering her boyfriend's infidelity and facing harassment at work, Hoshino Rin, nearing 30, found herself single and jobless, on the brink of despair. Her attempts at finding a partner through matchmaking were ruined by the intrusion of a mysterious, insensitive man. Then, one day, Rin agrees to do housework for a "brilliant programmer who lived abroad," at her brother's request. She assumes it will be fine since he's her brother's friend, but the person who shows up is completely unexpected...! A doting love story begins between a solitary genius programmer and a kind but unfortunate woman, starting with a contractual relationship!

(Source: BookLive, translated)

title.native: その天才様は偽装彼女に執着する
title.romaji: Sono Tensai-sama wa Gisou Kanojo ni Shuuchaku Suru

205423.description:
"Even a god like me wants to try acting all lovey-dovey...!"
Make way for the purest sex fiend in all of BL―A matchmaking god that wants nothing more than to have sex!

Meet Hinatsu, a sweet and innocent guy who has spent the last fifteen years of his life praying at his family's shrine in hopes of one day meeting his soulmate. While on cleaning duty one day, he runs into a guy claiming to be the shrine's matchmaking god! After listening to him complain about Hinatsu's constant praying, and watching him nibble on offerings and get drunk off sake before proclaiming loudly that he wants to have sex, Hinatsu can't take any more and is ready to leave when a moment of unexpected vulnerability brings him back! Despite the alleged god's bravado and overly annoying personality, there's a cuteness about him that Hinatsu just can't deny...!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.romaji: Kami wa Chigiri wo Shomou Suru!

205424.description:
The words "You're kind of a natural bottom, huh?" and the reply of "And you're practically overflowing with top energy!" are the catalyst for this coming-of-age story between two curious BL superfans.

Tokita is a student who enjoys BL in secret. One day, while people-watching and privately imagining who's a top and who's a bottom, he slips up, and his classmate Mizusawa catches on to his hobby. Tokita thinks his peaceful school life is over, but it turns out Mizusawa, who gives off pure top energy, is also into BL. Bonding instantly over their shared hobby, the two get close fast. They've both read about how butt stuff can feel seriously good, and, unable to fight their curiosity, decide to try it for themselves. And so begins their story, a natural-born top and a natural-born bottom learning more about BL by experiencing it firsthand!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.native: 水澤くんは超最強に「攻め」すぎる！
title.romaji: Mizusawa-kun wa Chou Saikyou ni "Seme" Sugiru!

205425.description:
"Fill me up... nice and full..."

Deep in the mountains lies a mysterious village bound by this commandment. And the only way to escape the village is to sleep with "him." Inui visits the secluded village for a university seminar research project. At first glance it seems quiet and peaceful, but something about the whole place feels off. As Inui becomes more shaken by the village's unsettling atmosphere, he is approached by a beautiful man the locals call Master Akiyama. That night, after a welcoming dinner and too much to drink, Inui's consciousness begins to fade. Through the haze, he hears a chilling voice: "A child will finally be born. I will finally be impregnated." And in the room Inui is taken to, "he" is waiting, clad in a pure white traditional bridal dress, watching him quietly...

(Source: Coolmic)

205426.description:
"Momojiri, let me borrow your butt for a bit, okay?"

The class delinquent is completely obsessed with... the uptight honor student?! The always-serious class president, Momojiri, is at his wits' end with the class troublemaker, Osaka. He's always late, never turns in assignments, and every time he's scolded, he teases, "Come on, don't be so angry. You're ruining that cute face..." Determined to finally teach him a lesson, Momojiri chases after Osaka... only to get his butt stuck in a window?! Self-conscious about his big butt, Momojiri panics in embarrassment. But Osaka, seemingly turned on, starts teasing and massaging him anyway. "It's your fault for getting your butt stuck in front of a guy with bad intentions."

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: It's All Your Fault, Big Momojiri!
title.native: おっきい桃尻くんがぜんぶ悪い

205427.description:
Our well-endowed protagonist is having the worst day. His girlfriend dumped him, he got mugged, and to top it off, it sounds like his neighbors are having some seriously kinky sex in the next room. Driven by morbid curiosity, he takes a peek through a hole in the wall. Just a peek won’t hurt, right?

(Source: Irodori Comics)

Note: Chapter 2 was released at J.GARDEN 57.
synonyms: 穴があったら挿入したい～デカちん強○結腸攻めされてバチイキしたい!!～
Ana ga Attara Sounyuu Shitai: Dekachin Kyousei Kecchou Seme Sarete Bachiiki Shitai!!
Ana ga Attara Sounyuu Shitai: Dekachin Kyou○ Kecchou Seme Sarete Bachiiki Shitai!!
This Hole was Made for Me!: Dicked Down Deep

205428.description:
The new manga is an essay comic about Nagata's recovery after a mental and emotional breakdown.

(Source: Anime News Network)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.native: 僕のアップル色エイリアン

205442.description:
The original story is set a few years after dungeons began appearing in the modern world. Karin Yamada is a "dungeon streamer," a new kind of streamer who live streams their expeditions in the dungeon. Though she has adopted the character of a classy rich lady, with zero views and three subscribers, she is decidedly obscure, and depressed about it. One day, she stumbles on an adventurer trying to stir up trouble for views by causing an explosion in a dungeon. Karin immediately leaps into action and stops it by beating up the adventurer. Little did she know that the adventurer was also streaming to a wide audience, who all saw her beating up and lecturing the adventurer. The incident propels her to overnight popularity.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: お嬢様系底辺ダンジョン配信者、迷惑系をボコったらバズって伝説になってますわ！？
title.romaji: Ojousama-kei Teihen Dungeon Haishinsha, Meiwaku-kei wo Bokottara Bazutte Densetsu ni Nattemasu wa!?

205443.description:
College freshman Akira is absolutely obsessed with the latest hit video game. After spending two months maxing out his character he finally beats the final boss... and wakes up inside the video game as Adele, the main character!

Meanwhile, Karina Russel, a student at the Tweede Academy of Magical Arts, is struggling to find an apprenticeship willing to take her in since she is helpless when it comes to magic. When she finds a sorcerer wandering the streets, she desperately asks to be his apprentice and he accepts. This man turns out to be Adele, the greatest sorcerer in the world! But since he is actually just a normal college student, can he really teach Karina magic?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Training Plan of the Strongest Brave Hero's Apprentice
title.native: 最強勇者の弟子育成計画
title.romaji: Saikyou Yuusha no Deshi Ikusei Keikaku

205445.description:
Fifteen years ago, his father, fighting against unfair dismissal, took his own life amidst the indifference of a conglomerate. Before the shock had even subsided, his younger brother vanished without a trace. Faced with a series of tragedies, his parents ultimately passed away, leaving Do-jun alone. Since that day, when everything was taken from him, Do-jun has lived for revenge and truth. Realizing that he could not change anything without standing at the center of power, He endured his lonely days with the sole goal of becoming a politician. And on the day he finally received his diploma, he swore before his parents' urns:

"I will find Yu-ri and bring her here to this very place."

"And those bastards...I will make them shed tears of blood."

That night, Do-jun had his first "dream of the future." A vision too vivid to be a coincidence. And that dream foreshadowed the brutal path he would take in politics.

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: The Politician Who Can See the Future
The Politician Who Sees the Future

205446.description:
The strongest man of the Murim, “Asura,” got transported to another world. Having reached the pinnacle through his martial capabilities alone, he smashes the status window and the tower with his own hands—rejecting participation as a player outright.

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: To Hell With the Status Window

205447.description:
I barely ‘escaped’ from my crazy master and made it out into the world of martial arts. But from the start, I get entangled with the Demonic Cult… I won’t be used by them; instead, I’ll use them. That crazy master. Until the day I can give that old monster a taste of his own medicine!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

205448.description:
Reborn into another life, the apocalypse looms! In his previous life, not a single family member survived. This time, Zhou Zhuo refuses to let tragedy strike again! Leading his family, he battles relentless zombies, shelters survivors, expands the Zhou family estate, and builds a self-sufficient stronghold. Together, they fight the undead and help survivors awaken extraordinary powers!

(Source BiliBili, translated)
synonyms: The Calamity of the End Times
The Catastrophe Of The Apocalypse, I Made My Whole Family Into Bigshot

title.native: 末日灾变，重生的我让全家变成了大佬！
title.romaji: Mori Zaibian, Chongsheng De Wo Rang Quanjia Bian Chengle Da Lao!

205449.description:
The human world is on the verge of destruction after the attack of the Demon King Erodin. After the fight against the Demon King, the Gold Dragon Exigar is reincarnated as Kain Logdel, a human who is a lout that knows nothing about magic. While trying to escape from his sword-crazed family’s duties to stay at the training camp by hiding his sword skills, Kain is on the verge of being exiled because of the unexpected message from his Family Head... Amidst all of this, the Demon King, with her new appearance, is also looking forward to reuniting with him?!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: The 10th Class Lout of the Knight Family
The Rebirth of the Violent Dragon King
騎士一族のバカ息子は10クラス

205450.description:
Hans, a vassal who managed everything for the lazy Count Adrian, dies in an ambush and awakens 15 years in the past in Adrian von Kallista’s body. In this timeline, Hans no longer exists, and Adrian is a 15-year-old who once ruined his house through mismanagement. Determined to change that fate, Hans, now living as Adrian, sets out to properly rebuild and guide House Kallista through proper leadership and magic.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: 魔法君主～ドラゴンに選ばれし者～

205451.description:
The "nonstop suspense" story follows a disillusioned high school student whose life gets turned upside down after he saves an older man from committing suicide.

(Source: Anime News Network)

205452.description:
Waking up as their favorite character's wife is every fangirl's dream, and that's exactly what happened to Rowena Hadelus! Does it matter that she's a villainess destined to get divorced and die a horrible death? Not at all! Her task is simple—make her husband fall in love with her. However, what she thinks will be an easy mission is quickly turned upside down as events not mentioned in the original story begin unfolding. Will Rowena be able to secure the happy ending she dreams of?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Life as the Grand Duke’s Daughter-in-Law Is Too Easy
Life in the Duke’s Household Is Too Easy
The Marriage Life in the Grand Duke Family Is Surprisingly Easy

205453.description:
The "occult horror" manga's story begins when Susumu Sakane is attacked by a supernatural creature during a shrine visit with a friend. There he is saved by an organization called "With U," that tracks and resolves supernatural incidents.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: ウィズ・ユー ～傍らに幽かに潜むもの～
title.romaji: With U: Katawara ni Kasuka ni Hisomu Mono

205454.description:
The very fact that such a work circulated in general bookstores is bizarre. From start to finish, you can't take your eyes off it, thinking deeply and carefully, following the images and the dialogue, but no matter how many times you read it, you understand absolutely nothing from beginning to end.

(Source: Mandarake, translated)

205455.description:
The original 1989 novel centers on Stevens, a butler long in the service of an English aristocrat named Lord Darlington. He recounts his years of service in his employer's estate, first with a romantic nostalgia, and then with slow admission of his employer's true colors.

(Source: Anime News Network)

205457.description:
Set in a hospital where stuffed animals come and go, Kuroneko-sensei solves difficult cases and problems with one stroke -- a cute yet terrifying dark fairy tale fantasy!

(Source: Hayakawa, translated)

title.native: くろねこ先生とほつれた患者たち

205458.description:
The Sacred Artifact, a weapon embodying one's soul. Born into the prestigious Catastrophe Duke family of holy knights, the protagonist Bell was the only one unable to manifest a Sacred Artifact and was exiled from his clan. However, Bell later inherited the legendary Sacred Artifact ‘Avalon’ and attained the strength of an S-rank holy knight. Returning to the ducal house to save his sister, Bell is killed by an unknown assailant. Yet, together with Avalon, he returns to his childhood. Now wielding the legendary Sacred Artifact, Bell's true life begins.

(Source: SORAJIMA, translated)
205458.hashtag: #公爵家のSランク神器使いの回帰
synonyms: The Return of the S-Rank Holy Weapon User From the Duke's Family
重生成公爵家的S級神器使

title.native: 公爵家のSランク神器使いの回帰
title.romaji: Koushakuka no S-Rank Jingi Tsukai no Kaiki

205459.description:
A lovey-dovey tamer life for a newlywed couple who love animals♪

Hayato and Rina are a newlywed couple who have purchased the full-dive VR game "Free Frontier Online." Their goal in playing is to pet as many monsters as they want!!! Nobunaga, the demon king who ruled the Sengoku period, has somehow become a detective in Reiwa Japan! Illegal part-time jobs, tailgating, streamers... he's ready to use his power as a conqueror to punish the poison that is rampant in modern Japan ! A Sengoku hero who defeats evil! Detective Nobunaga is born!

(Source: Nihon Bungeisha, translated)

205463.description:
The protagonist of "Seirei Meikyuu no Shinen wo Koete" is a slave boy named Alva. Due to certain circumstances, Alva is hated by the townspeople and is wanted dead, so he is forced to hunt monsters every day in harsh conditions. However, Alva steadily grows stronger as he fights, hovering close to death. The kingdom is desperate to kill Alva, who continues to survive no matter how cornered he is, but then he has an encounter that changes his fate.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

205465.description:
The world is infested by Kaigyo: fish that walk on land, eat concrete, and destroy buildings.

Their typical behavior is bizarre enough, but ten years ago, Jaytle Nish witnessed these pests become murderers while under the command of a mystery person clad in black, and eat his parents whole. He takes on a job exterminating the fish while looking for leads, but instead finds a strange woman eating poisonous kaigyo flesh.

From deadly fish to mysterious cultists, the odd duo will take on it all in this pop art-inspired revenge action series!

(Source: Manga Mavericks)

Born with incredible luck, Jeong-Yeon always has good things happening to him. Then, the most perfect-looking guy, Lee Yun-Seong, appears before him. Yun-Seong, who had always received attention for his good looks since birth, didn't like people who only approached him for his face. So, he wasn't thrilled when Jeong-Yeon expressed his interest right after meeting him.

"Can I call you hyung? Yun-Seong: “Heeeey~ I hope we see each other often from now on.”

After their awkward first encounter, Yun-Seong gets annoyed whenever he keeps bumping into Jeong-Yeon wherever he goes. But Jeong-Yeon, completely unfazed by his irritation, keeps pestering him. Before he knows it, Yun-Seong finds himself quietly falling for him...

205471.description: There was a time when elves were thought to be nothing but fantasy creatures… but those days are long gone! Together with her classmate Kyuu-chan, a 450-year-old vampire, she struggles (and sometimes totally fails) to fit into human society.

205472.description:
At the edge of a distant continent, a land perpetually blanketed in snow lies Oldenland, ruled by Archduke Giesel Zvendard. His cold demeanor, overwhelming magical prowess, and even the bizarre rumor that he carries the blood of monsters make everyone fear him. Yet few know that what Giesel truly desires is simply a peaceful daily life, immersed in magical research with a warm cup of tea in his quiet study. What shattered this modest wish was an unexpected bride from the southernmost tip of Cornia. Rensley Mallosen, the bastard son of Cornia, appeared wearing a bride's crown in place of his runaway sister. His brief attempt to hide, fearing discovery, was short-lived. This cheerful, chatty knight, his sun-like golden hair flowing as he roamed the castle, kept stirring up small disturbances in the ice castle that seemed destined for eternal silence. Even though he should have been driven out immediately for this fraudulent marriage, Giesel found himself increasingly unable to look away from Rensley, who beamed brightly and chattered away at even the smallest kindness. Rensley, who had been rejected from the moment he was born and ultimately abandoned, arriving in Oldenland, began to harbor affection for Giesel's seemingly indifferent yet kind demeanor. But the moment he became aware of his feelings, the time for parting drew near...

To Oldenland, the coldest land on the continent, yet where the warmest things gather, will Rensley ever be able to return?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

After years of biding her time as her aunt and uncle ran her family's duchy into the ground, Grace is now ready for revenge, and her plan begins with helping the prince reclaim his usurped title. Hokkaido, Sapporo. High school student Ruka is living her life in bliss in the house of lilac. 205491.description: Europa, daughter of the Phoenician King Agenor, is abducted by Zeus as part of a ploy to take down the Python. Fate has more in store, for him, however, as the interests of gods and men intertwine throughout his family, until it reaches his ill-fated grandson, Pentheus - who threatens to go against what his lineage has built up, and stood for.

Waya, an aspiring voice actor who only gets modeling jobs for his good looks, fails his favorite of all-time audition… Not giving up his dream to be a voice actor, he shuts himself in the sound-proof room to train in secret! 205502.description:
Do-Yun Maeng, a local civil servant in a provincial new town, just wants to quietly serve out his full term without incident. But right after a near-fatal accident, he gets a hypnosis app-and suddenly, his dull little town starts turning into a playground!

(Source: TOPTOON, edited)

205504.description:
Jay, a legendary hitman in America's underworld, is hired by Union, North America's largest assassin corporation, to destroy the assassin company founded by his friend Johnny with his own hands. The condition for accepting the job was sparing Johnny's life, but due to Union's betrayal, both Johnny and Jay are killed. However, resurrected by a mysterious power into the body of an ordinary young man in Korea, Jay meets Johnny, who has been resurrected in the body of a young woman. The two decide to join forces once more to create a powerful ‘company’ and exact revenge on Union, the organization that killed them.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

205505.description:
It seems my brother’s fiancée is having an affair with a coworker. Determined to stop the wedding within two months, Ian goes undercover, taking a job as the personal secretary to the CEO of the company where her future sister-in-law works.

"Do you think boundaries exist just to be crossed?"

Unfortunately for her, that CEO is Cha Jeonghan, a man as strikingly handsome as he is utterly unbearable. With his cutting remarks and infuriating composure, he makes it his personal mission to provoke Ian at every turn.

"Yes. Boundaries exist to be crossed."

With nothing to lose, not even her job, Ian decides to trample over Jeonghan’s carefully drawn lines whenever she pleases. And slowly, the once-arrogant man who never deigned to look down from his lofty pedestal begins to falter.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: A Romance That Goes Too Far

205506.description:
One night after work, Yuuya's colleagues treat him to an evening of drinks for a job well done on a difficult project. On the way home, while it's obvious that Yuuya's drunken a bit too much... he is in a really great mood. Not wanting the night to end, he heads over to Kurose's place with a present of booze in hand. With Yuuya high in spirits, and Kurose finding his inebriated state so very cute, Kurose also ends up drinking too much. As per usual for the two, they get nice and intimate and... you can guess what happens next!

(Source: DLsite)

Kanon ends up forming a band with Dan-senpai, a third-year student she admires, and while she finds herself increasingly drawn to him, she has some issues with the instrument!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: キスしてキラーチューン

205508.description:
The manga is based on famous Japanese classic mystery writer Rampo Edogawa's Kogoro Akechi character, and reimagines the character's wife Fumiyo. The erotic suspense manga's story begins with the disappearance of Kogoro Akechi, and the beginning of a series of serial murders of women. On the case is Akechi's wife Fumiyo, who hides a past of having been raised by a serial killer called the "Magician."

(Source: Anime News Network)

205509.description:
The occult sword battle manga centers on a gloomy, introverted middle school girl named Bakko Shinno. One usual day at school, after Bakko finishes cleaning the classroom that her classmates have left her to do, she secretly goes to a shrine to pray for a peaceful life and the misfortune of extroverts. Suddenly, a demon(?) calls out to her and targets her, putting her life in danger.

(Source: Anime News Network)

205510.description:
The series follows middle-schooler Mamiko Maeno who finds herself lost in her new school. She decides to pick up her late grandfather's old camera: a monster-sized Pentax camera nicknamed Bakepen.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: バケペンのマミコちゃん

205511.description:
When she starts to investigate the infidelity of her best friend's boyfriend, what will she find…?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

Note: Originally published in Margaret 2026 No. 3 & 4 combined issue.

205512.description:
The manga follows a leader of the Sadorigumi family of the yakuza Jouichirou Hashiya, who has lost his memory after being shot. His subordinate Kurume feeds him homemade meals to restore his memories.

(Source: Anime News Network, edited)

205513.description:
The story of the novel is set during the Peace Preservation Law of 1925, which targets those who believe in "Marxist" ideology. Proletarian writer Takiji Kobayashi chooses the harsh working conditions of a crab cannery ship as the subject of his next novel, which draws the attention of the special police task force charged with monitoring ideological threats. Two spies are sent to monitor his activities.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: アンブレイカブル〜敗れざる者たち〜

205514.description:
Hino Komako is a marriage counselor who'd given up on her own happiness, until she was suddenly transported to another world! “Could it be... me with this hottie!?” Komako's heart soared at the sight of the handsome Demon Lord waiting for her, until he asked her to help with matchmaking instead!? But the Demon Lord seems to have a secret he won't tell Komako…? A fresh take of an isekai romantic comedy.

(Source: ShuCream, translated)

205515.description:
Yuki and Asaka are best friends who’ve known each other since childhood. One day, after a boy confesses his feelings to her, Asaka announces, “I’ll give it a try just for the experience.” Yuki isn’t happy about her best friend being snatched up by some random guy…?

Low self-esteem, timidity, and severe decision-making difficulties make Ye Xiaomu's life unhappy. After a failed confession to her crush, Xiaomu is shocked to discover she has the ability to travel to parallel worlds. For ten years, Seo-Jun has harbored a silent, unrequited crush on his best friend, Jae-Yun. But when Jae-Yun asks for a favor, Seo-Jun finds himself sharing a roof with his friend’s younger brother, Do-Yun. Living together reveals a different side of the family: while Do-Yun is quiet and unexpectedly tender, Jae-Yun’s perfect facade begins to crumble. Caught between a decade of devotion and a new, grounding confession, Seo-Jun must finally decide which brother holds the key to his heart.

(Source: Lezhin US)

205523.description:
Doh Min-Hyeok is living a nightmare disguised as a fantasy. Forced to play the role of a cold-blooded tyrant by a relentless System, he’s one skipped "brooding session" away from a death sentence. But the icy exterior starts to crack when he crosses paths with Lee Wu-Yeon. Wu-Yeon is the perfect "clumsy darling" trope, and more importantly, he’s a walking dead zone for the System’s influence. Min-Hyeok begins to pursue Wu-Heon with a desperate intensity, but as the lines between survival and genuine attraction blur, he has to wonder if he’s chasing a lifeline or a life sentence.
