But Gemis, who still believes in love, is transformed! His appearance changes and he gains superhuman powers. Carrying his destiny, Gemis fights against the world for what he believes in. This is the start of an incredibly intense transformation battle fantasy!

(Source: Starts Shuppan, translated)

205525.description:
At the end of his first year of high school, Tsumugu, who has been spending his time without any close relationships with anyone, meets Satoko, a girl drawing pictures in the park.

"I was glad to hear your words."

Her straightforward words cause the time that had been standing still to quietly begin to move again - a boy who has shut himself off from words and a girl who can no longer dream. The story of the awkward yet straightforward coming-of-age tale woven by these two who have been unable to take the first step begins.

(Source: Starts Shuppan, translated)

title.native: 呪われたテニスクラブ

205529.description:
Pastor Moriyama was sent from the mainland to the remote island of Koiso to work, along with his wife and daughters, Youko and Kasumi. During summer vacation, the Hayasaka family, friends of Pastor Moriyama, visit the island for a vacation. Around that time, Pastor Moriyama is troubled by a lump in his side and decides to see a doctor. An X-ray revealed a fetus that appeared to be an underdeveloped identical twin. Without revealing the details to Pastor Moriyama, the doctor removed the fetus and preserved it as a specimen, but the fetus was alive and managed to escape from the specimen jar. That night, Kasumi had a dream in which a woman dressed in black was breastfeeding a monster-like baby. In the dream, the woman was blowing into a Miyashiro shell—the very one Yoko and she had found while searching for fossils the other day. After the surgery, Pastor Moriyama recovered well and was able to lead Sunday services. However, in the middle of the service, he suddenly started acting like a different person...

It seems this island has a history of devil worship, and now the devil’s messenger has been resurrected. The curtain rises on a tragedy…

(Source: Kaiki Manga no Anagura, translated)

205530.description:
A female teacher, Hide, moves into the home of a high school boy named Iori who lives alone! What will the presence of Hide, who is a total failure as an adult - a drinker, a gambling addict, and always broke - bring...? An exciting, twisted, and secretive cohabitation comedy begins!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

205531.description:
Do you fear the amusement park's Thriller House? Or, can you go in with no problem?

This is the story of a group of girls who enter it to see fearsome sights despite their fears, but...?! So, do you think you can still go inside the Thriller House after reading this story?

(Source: Lemon Comics, translated)

205532.description:
A man works in an exploitative company, and his only joy in life is playing the hack-and-slash game "Brave of Kingdom" when he gets home from work. But one day, when playing the game, he sees something strange, and the next thing he knows, he is inside the world of the game, with the familiar adjutant character Selina before him in her familiar uniform. He has transformed into the game's evil general Zeorg, with his muscular build and full beard, along with his doomed destiny to be mowed down by the game's hero, along with the rest of the game's mooks. Using his survival skills in his exploitative workplace, and his knowledge of the game, Zeorg is determined to avoid a bad ending.

(Source: Anime News Network, edited)
synonyms: That Time I Got Reincarnated as an Evil General in a Hack-and-Slash Game: Destroy the Bad Ending

title.native: 気づいたら無双ゲームの悪役将軍だった件。〜破滅ルートはぶっ壊す〜
title.romaji: Kizuitara Musou Game no Akuyaku Shogun Datta Ken. Hametsu Route wa Buttsubusu

205533.description:
Once every 100 years, the cursed labyrinth "Naraku" corrodes the world. Helmut, the great monster who reigns at its deepest reaches the dungeon, receives news that the king has been imprisoned. The kingdom is engulfed in deep despair, and everyone senses its end. Meanwhile, one man quietly arrives at the Guild Tavern. His name is Allen. To carve his own existence and resist the despair that has overflowed the world, he ventures into the depths of "Naraku." This is the story of a new adventurer woven in "Naraku of Beginnings."

(Source: Drecom, translated)
synonyms: Wizardry Variants Daphne: The Nameless Last Adventure

title.native: Wizardry Variants Daphne ～名もなき最後の冒険～
title.romaji: Wizardry Variants Daphne: Namonaki Saigo no Bouken

205534.description:
Parahumans. Nectar. Aetherol. These things have changed the world in short order, none more so than parahumans. Their unimaginable power makes them the top priority of every organization, legitimate or otherwise, all over the world. Even so, Geon Yoo couldn’t have predicted the situation he was coming home to. Having killed his parents in pursuit of his sister, it’s clear the Seven Star Syndicate will stop at nothing to get what they want from her. It’s their bad luck that they made it personal.

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: Rise of the God of War

205535.description:
Hoseon has suffered from the war Jang started for far too long, and hope has grown scarce, but pharmacist Do-Ha Shin is determined to save as many lives as he can until the very end. Except, he wasn’t expecting to manifest as an omega at his age, and he wasn’t expecting to wake up surrounded by Hoseon’s army. He can’t remember the face of the alpha who found and brought him here, and he never got his name. Now, saving the lives of these soldiers could mean saving the life of his love.

(Source: Tapas)

205537.description:
This hard-boiled action film follows the exploits of detective Soga Kenji, an elite career detective nicknamed "The Great Horse" who takes on violent criminals on the scene. A mysterious man corners a fleeing bank robber in his beloved Ferrari, fires a gun at him, and pushes him into the sea. This mysterious man is none other than Soga Kenji, an elite career detective who has just returned from New York, but is now assigned to the Okonomiyaki as a mere lieutenant. Soga is tasked with investigating a gun smuggling case...!?

(Source: Third Line, translated)

205538.description:
The story centers on Kairu Mitsushima, a middle-aged man who has been good at playing fighting games since he was in middle school. 30 years ago, he had a life-changing moment when he met Daigo Umehara, a living legend in the fighting game world. After a traffic accident, Kairu gets reincarnated in another world, where people battle it out using their knowledge and skills in fighting games.

(Source: Anime News Network)

Tsubaki and Kajiro have been trapped inside a mysterious room that will only free them if they have sex.
They've grown ears and tails, and though Kajiro is not too upset about the situation, they're both feeling something from these animal ears...

Kajiro gets himself abducted on purpose for attention. Tsubaki rescues him, but is very displeased with Kajiro's actions...
Unexpectedly, he takes Kajiro to a love hotel instead of going home. Kajiro anticipates that the fuming Tsubaki will take out his frustration on him with some rough sex... But even more unexpectedly, his punishment involves a barrage of restraints and sex toys!

205545.description:
"Yes, today is your first day of amnesia."

For Shiota Umi, who repeatedly loses his memories, a new day begins once again. Through encounters with his lover and friends, he struggles to reclaim his lost memories and daily life. But what awaits him beyond that—?

A love story of rebirth and destruction, where past, secrets, and intertwined emotions collide.

205546.description:
It's been a week since my ex-boyfriend, who I was living with, moved out. He was a jerk and irresponsible with money... But I just don't have the will to do anything.

Just then, Shiga came to visit...

(Source: DLsite)

205553.description:
Madoka, who suffers from a phobia of dirt, hates going to the pool with other people or sharing fruit juice. Her best friend, Ku-chan, decides to remedy this and hands her an ice cream that she has licked...

Note: Published in Tsubomi Vol.1.

205554.description:
Ibuki, a professional home cook (personal chef) who supports daily dietary needs, receives a request from Wanibuchi, a surgeon, to "make dinner for his son." From that day on, Ibuki begins visiting the Wanibuchi household, but there seems to be a deep rift between the expressionless and unreadable Wanibuchi and his son Riku, a high school student model and arrogant man, and it is a father-son household where the two barely exchange words. Nevertheless, Ibuki gradually becomes attracted to Wanibuchi's kindness, who cares for his son despite his clumsiness. Then, Riku forcefully kisses Ibuki and makes a sincere advance...

(Source: Gentosha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: どうぞ美味しく召し上がれ

205555.description:
This is the Televi Land serialization of Kamen Rider X.

Jin Keisuke tries to save his father Keitaro from an attack by G.O.D., but he is shot and killed in the process. However, Keitaro resurrects Keisuke as the cyborg Kaizorg, in exchange of his own life. Learning of his mission from Keitaro's last words, Keisuke becomes Kamen Rider X and battles G.O.D.

title.native: テレビマガジン版　仮面ライダーX

205557.description:
The Soaring Heaven Demonic Cult achieved unification after 300 years thanks to Sama Geon. He had one wish: to live an ordinary life with his family. Returning to his hometown, he learned butchery and began a small business, but his younger sister's illness forced him to wield a sword once again—and the Soaring Heaven Demonic Cult is threatening his serene life. For the sake of peace, he must wield his sword once more.

(Source: Naver, translated)

205558.description:
A serial killer is staging corpses as “self-destruction art” and selling them to the ultra-wealthy for tens of millions. When failed artist Suchan Kim recognizes the concept as his own—stolen from an exhibition the world laughed into oblivion—his obsession with proving this mutates into something darker: a hunger for the recognition he never received. In a world where spectacle is worth more than life, will Suchan expose the killer, or become part of the masterpiece?

(Source: WEBTOON)

205559.description:
How does he expect me to continue when he's acting so carelessly? I can't keep my voice down, and now the whole school is gonna hear us!

(Source: Coolmic)

- All chapters were split into three parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume release.
- Includes one extra chapter.

205560.description:
In the near future, society has sunk into corruption, stripped of all hopes and dreams. In this world, the illegal, no-rules underground fighting event "Yaoyorozu" has reached the peak of its popularity.
Brutal street fights break out anywhere and everywhere, driven by money and desires. Matsuriya Jin, a delinquent boy who has been surviving by stealing on the streets, gets caught up in this violence. But his potential as a fighter is overwhelming...
A hard-hitting battle action series begins as an abnormal monster smashes everything in his path.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: Jin: Legend of the Dipper Style Destruction King
Jin: Legend of the Fighting Kingbreaker

205561.description:
Nakagawa Yuki, a popular boy at school, lives a fulfilling life, always assuring his friends Shinichi and Midori that he is happy. However, on his 17th birthday, his father tells him, "You're an alien," and he discovers that he has awakened to the ability to transform into other people. Then, by chance, Shinichi and Midori see Yuki transformed into a girl, and Shinichi falls in love with him at first sight...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

205562.description:
He found a baby. To a man who had lived under the world's scorn, that baby became his daughter, raised in captivity for twenty years... and eventually, his woman. And now, hyenas who caught the scent of money have begun to show up at the place he had kept so carefully hidden.

"Hey, old man. I hear you're loaded as hell. Why don't you slip us a little pocket money?"

(Source: TOPTOON)

205563.description:
The violent horror manga is set in an old western-style mansion rumored to be haunted, on the outskirts of a town. A group of elementary school students gather at the mansion for a test of courage. One of the students, a girl who has been overcome with a terrible premonition, tells the group, "One of us will never come back."

(Source: Anime News Network)

205565.description:
The manga centers on an airheaded rich girl and her reliable butler named Kamishiro, who travel a world where people can get infected by a zombie virus, but it is not yet the end of the world, and people can still live normal lives.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: お紅茶・オブ・ザ・リビングデッド

205566.description:
The story follows a high school student who is allowed to move out under the condition he avoids relations with the opposite sex. After saving a flashy girl at his school, she becomes fixated on seducing him.

(Source: Anime News Network)

205571.description:
A strange "real" world appears before the eyes of a boy who has cleared a VR game and returned! The best Musou strategy story, with mysteries and beautiful girls looming, begins here!

While testing his brand new VRMMO, Kanzaki Reito was trapped inside the game for three years. He defeated the final boss of the game and was finally freed, but what he returned to was something odd happened the real world. A "little sister" of his out of nowhere, Reito can still use the same ability as in the game, and monsters appear. Will Reito make use of his overwhelming power and become the savior of this world??

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

A sealed girl is freed by a handsome monk who happens to be passing by! A story that has inspired countless classic manga is now given new life. A new interpretation of "Journey to the West" begins! A battle action and "love" comedy brought to you by ippatu.

During the Edo period, Dejima was a place created to isolate the Dutch in Nagasaki, Japan's only international trading port. Suzu, who lost her chef parents in a fire, works as a kabuki (a girl around 10 years old who serves high-ranking courtesans such as tayu) for Kotoo Tayu of the Maruyama brothel, and also works as an assistant to the kuzuneri (Japanese chefs at Dejima) for Fons Claassen, the chef at the Dutch trading post. A historical gourmet story.

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

Despite only being in high school, Fuji also works as a manga artist publishing a series. But one day, after a certain incident, he finds himself demanded by his classmate Nazuna to advise her on "showmanship" for her dance performance…?!

205599.description:
Office worker Sumire Shinonome's unquenchable lust has caused her to give on dating completely. Now she spends her days getting herself off to the delivery guy who's just her type. She simply can't help but dream of their naughty escapades, but a turn of fate brings them intimately together! She can feel herself melting from his hot kiss and her tongue on his monster down below. As his love fills her up deep inside, she can't help but hold him tight. Sumire hopes that this physical relationship of theirs will continue forever, but what's this?! He's turned up at her office as her new trainee?! Whatever will have to the two of them now...?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

205600.description:
100 years after the devastation of a nuclear World War III, a small group of humanity managed to survive and unite to form a “world government.” This organization brings together the greatest minds to rebuild society, establish order, and create safe zones called “Domes” where humans can live without fear of radiation or crime. As the population grows, the government sets its sights on constructing a Dome in District 12, located in Seoul, the Korean peninsula. However, powerful criminal organizations that have long dominated the area are determined to prevent the government’s project from encroaching on their territory. To thwart these criminal organizations and ensure the successful construction of the new Dome, the Korean Division of the world government deploys their top law enforcer, code-named “Alpha,” and the newly appointed government administrator of the Seoul Division, “Amber.”

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

205604.description:
Saint Seraphina, born to pray and protect her country, follows her destiny and marries the hero Dominic in a loveless marriage. Treated with contempt by those around her and exploited for her holy powers, on her wedding night, she defeats her arrogant, worthless husband, flees the country, and decides to live freely under the Demon King Welhart! A strong and beautiful saint and a lonely, kind-hearted demon king. A reversal love story of two people who give up their destinies and choose to fulfill their dreams!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 夜逃げ聖女の二度目の結婚

205605.description:
The manga is set in a certain hidden ninja village. Two elite ninja, Goroumaru and Murasaki, compete fiercely to become the village's next village chief. But when Murasaki uses Goroumaru's virginity as a reason to remove him from candidacy, Goroumaru proudly rises to the challenge to lose his virginity. Yet the challenge only plays into the secret plan of the current village chief.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: ヴァージン・キラー忍法帖

205606.description:
The manga centers on Nene Oyamada, a 40-year-old single woman, happy in her life supporting her favorite idol RENJI, with her same-age otaku friends. But news about RENJI's eight-timing affair has come out and caused an online uproar. RENJI has disappeared and has essentially retired from the entertainment industry. Nene and her friends suddenly lose their purpose in life and do not know what to do anymore. But in this era in which people live almost until 100 years, they try to restart and explore other things in life.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: セカンドハーフガールズ

205607.description:
Yifan activates a system by chance with a pop-up telling him that everyone in this world will lose 1,000,000% in purchasing power except for him. The following day, the market crashes. Luxury cars only cost 1 yaro each and mansions 5 yaros each. With hundreds of thousands in his account, Yifan suddenly becomes a rich man with enough money to buy everything on Earth!

(Source: WebComics)

205626.description:
After his death, college student Xingye gained the ability to fully possess others. Yet he unexpectedly possessed a corpse that had been reanimated. This reanimated corpse had once been the holder of a system. Its death and transformation into a reanimated corpse were entirely caused by its own system. This system would assign suicidal missions regardless of the host's level. But Xingye discovered that, as a reanimated corpse, he and this death-defying system actually worked surprisingly well together?

Hahaha, I'm already dead. What's there to fear about courting death?

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: 転生したら最凶システムを手に入れた件
I Took Over the System Players

205627.description:
“In the name of the Federation Command, I order you to withdraw. Otherwise, all-out war awaits you.”

“War?”

Gujin took a step forward. His form swelled against the wind, transforming in an instant from less than two meters tall into a chaotic demon god thousands of meters high. A white dwarf-like radiance emanated from him. His gravitational pull alone unleashed thunder and lightning, tidal waves, and storms across a thousand-mile radius. He reached out, and a hydrogen bomb fell into his hand.

“I think you should choose peace.”

(Source: Tencent, translated)

205628.description:
Shocking! Top-Tier Powerhouse Defeated by a Set of Broadcast Calisthenics! Today's Immortal News Fists strike the mighty, feet kick the immortal cultivators. Without spiritual roots, unable to wield spiritual energy yet he ascends to the pinnacle of immortal cultivation through sheer muscle alone.

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: I Use My Muscles to Dominate the World of Cultivating Immortals
Dominating the Cultivation Realm with Muscles

title.romaji: Wo Yong Jirou Chengba Xiu Xianjie

205629.description:
A week later, I died. When I used the system to alter the future, I discovered that terror had returned to the world!!!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
synonyms: Strange Descends: I Can Control the Eerie

title.native: 神秘降临：我能主宰诡异
title.romaji: Shenmi Jianglin: Wo Neng Zhuzai Guiyi

205630.description:
Chen Xiao is an ordinary high school student, yet his true identity is the guardian of “Will” and “Desire,” protecting the secrets of the night. He is Yagami, revered by all spirits. But when this role is inherited by a high schooler who hates trouble, how will he choose to live each day as he endures the constant harassment from ‘Will’ and “Desire”?

(Source: KuaiKan, translated)

205631.description:
Such a magnificent and terrifying being we call the Demon King. Possessing supreme power, the ruler who reigned over the demon realm, fell in the annals of legend...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Note: Include one extra chapter.

205632.description:
Here lies the ultimate horror! A mysterious app, a series of eerie properties. I'm a real estate agent—what I sell are haunted houses where all manner of strange occurrences have taken place.

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: I Am The Cunning Real Estate Agent

205640.description: 300 years have passed since the destruction of the Earth. In search of a new planet, humanity continues to fight and compete for it, and in the process, they encounter the "Earthlings" who were thought to be extinct.

205641.description: The long-awaited sequel to BOYS RUN THE RIOT! The story of FTM transgender Ryo's challenge to start a fashion brand!

205642.description:
"Even though I'm the one being pushed, it feels like it's unrequited love."

Naano (real name: Nagumo Hinano), a member of the streaming idol group Animal Miman, is actually extremely uncomfortable with people's gazes! When she was Hinano, she would look down and avoid people even at school. One day, it turns out that the super scary art teacher, Kashinoki, is actually a hardcore otaku of Naano! He looks so scary on the outside, but inside he's super kind and a super otaku of mine...?

An idol's growth story, with the push of an otaku's love!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

Note:
- Originally published as a one-shot in The Hana to Yume March 2024 issue, was then picked up for serialization.
- Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 樫木先生は私を推している！？

205643.description: Hunt monsters, even if it means heading towards despair. A new Japanese-style battle fantasy from the creator of Kokuma Musou!

title.english: GOUMA The Blade that Slaughters Gods

205644.description: A master of horror manga appears! A cursed Edo horror tale drawn by Masaaki Nakayama, the creator of Seeds of Anxiety and Aftereffects Radio!

205645.description: A reminiscent essay about Bob Dylan and his father by the author of Flowers of Evil and Blood on the Tracks.

title.english: ME AND BOB DYLAN (AND MY FATHER)
title.native: ぼくとボブ・ディラン（と父）

205646.description:
The Astelides. The Dornafahli. These are the two religions that rule and divide the world, each cloaked in their own brand of “righteousness.” Gerard Bydeford has seen the brutal acts committed in the names of their gods firsthand. A young would-be knight, he resolves to forge a third path—even if it means bearing the title of blasphemer for the rest of his life—and show the world what true righteousness really means.

(Source: K MANGA)

Note: Originally published as a one-shot, was then picked up for serialization in Monthly Young Magazine.

205647.description: Fight for the "jewel" that has been sealed for 2000 years! A new translation of the monster war by Yamada Goura, author of AI's Legacy Electron!

205648.description: That casual kiss that day changed everything for us - a refreshing story of love in youth.

205649.description: A battle between land-based humans and undersea humans in a world trapped in ice - whoever can obtain a UFO will become the ruler of the Earth.

title.native: プロトコル・リュウグウ

205650.description: A pregnant woman comes to kill her husband! A shocking horror that sends her from the height of happiness to hell!

title.native: プレグナントー妊婦ー

synonyms: Would you like to order with me?

title.native: ふたり暮らしのおとりよせ日和

205655.description:
A ceremony joins two people from different classes in marriage.

Ao is a lonely young man who grew up with wealth. Shion is a boy who grew up surrounded by a loving family. As children, Ao and Shion believed they could stay together despite their different backgrounds... but as they grew up into adults, Ao became the lord of the land, and they grew apart. As fate would have it, it turns out their ancestors were bound through a "binding ceremony," and now it's their turn. The ceremony is only for show, or at least that's what Shion initially thinks. Even though he won't admit it, his heart races on their first night as a wedded couple. And the ceremony won't end until they consummate the marriage. Shion tries to resist, but in the end, he lets Ao have his way with him...!

They come from different classes and backgrounds, but their love begins with a ceremony that started way back with their ancestors. Perhaps someday Shion will understand why Ao chose him.

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

205656.description:
In so much anguish that he couldn't sleep, Uta thought in desperation that it might be better to end it all. Just as he was about to cast himself off, an angel suddenly dove from the sky and collided with his head. And so began the heartwarming life of a young man named Uta and his self-proclaimed angel named Nini.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: いびつなシュガーモンスター

205668.description: Defy fate. A despised "witch" and a young girl journey through the world in this uncharted dark fantasy!

205669.description:
Marquis Charlotte has lost all of her family, including her parents, older sister, and grandmother, and is left with an indelible wound. Dubbed the "cursed and unfortunate young lady," one day she makes a deal with the devil and uses her body as a vessel to revive her supposedly dead sister, Lieselotte. Together with Lieselotte, the "other soul" residing within her, Charlotte begins to exact revenge on the murderers of her family, one after the other...

(Source: Jump Toon, translated)

title.native: 殺人令嬢シャルロット

205670.description: We will guide three people, two people and one dog, into a dark world where demons lurk.

205672.description:
Yoichi, the older brother, is quick to fight but has excellent athletic ability, while Shinji, the younger brother, is a genius boy who can speak seven languages. The two polar opposite brothers go on a trip with their family on a yacht, but an unfortunate accident occurs and the yacht capsizes... Separated from their family, the brothers end up washed up on a certain sandy beach, but...!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

Note:
- Includes the one-shot "Nagare Genshi"
- Includes the one-shot "Saraba! Kita no Ookami (Farewell! Wolves of the North)"

205673.description:
Working in human resources at a major pachinko manufacturer, Misaki comes off as a serious and inflexible person while on the job. However, in his off time, he lets loose and enjoys himself by spending time at pachinko parlors. While out and about, he meets an inexperienced-looking young man named Iori and is interested in the rare brand of cigarettes he possesses. Influenced by Iori's sense of distance and the smell of cigarettes, Misaki invites him to spend the night at a hotel and "do things that real adults do". But what happens when the next day, a new employee is late to the company's welcoming ceremony!?

(Source: Gentosha, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

205674.description:
In a world where power and prophecy dictate fate, Imperial Princess Sveta is sent to a fragile kingdom to marry its crown prince, Claris. However, Claris is enamored with another woman and disregards Sveta entirely, allowing his faction to torment her. But Sveta is no ordinary princess—beneath her delicate façade lies a sharp strategist determined to take control of her destiny. Disgusted by Claris’s incompetence, she sets her sights on the second prince, Sarges, a peace-loving royal with no desire for the throne—or marriage. When Sveta boldly proposes a union, Sarges finds himself unwillingly swept into a treacherous game of power, deception, and unexpected romance. Will this unlikely pair defy expectations and seize the crown, or will their opposing ambitions tear them apart?

(Source: Piccoma, translated)

title.native: 皇女スヴェータの政略結婚

205675.description: Note: Published in Weekly Shounen Jump 1981 no. 24

synonyms: You Can’t Run from Being the Hero

title.native: 勇者からは逃げられない

205679.description:
Unemployed 19-year-old Kazuma has been summoned to Asagiri Island, rumored to be home to long lost pirate treasure. He ends up working as an odd-job man at Umine Inn, a traditional Japanese café with women-only lodgings and a host of eccentric yet beautiful women. The stuff of dreams for any man - a romantic comedy about island life and treasure hunting, where the surroundings are beautiful in more ways than one!

(Source: K MANGA)

205680.description:
The story follows Destination Management Company, which offers any lost foodie a one-on-one, personalized guided tour to the world's finest cuisine.

(Source: Anime News Network)

205681.description:
The spinoff will follow the conflicts and reconciliation of a different couple, specifically that of Ichiko's friend Godai.

(Source: Anime News Network)

205682.description:
The story follows Sousaku Kamifuda, an otaku around his 30s, who is fully indulging in his trading card game hobby. In the midst of his mother selling the entirety of his precious card collection, the man is transported to another world. Using his card game skills, he attempts to find a way back home.

(Source: Anime News Network, edited)

title.native: 最強召喚士はアラサーおっさん 〜カードを親に処分されたカードゲーマーの異世界無双〜
title.romaji: Saikyou Shoukanshi wa Arasa Ossan: Card wo Oya ni Shobun sareta Card Gamer no Isekai Musou

205683.description:
6th century, Frankish Kingdom. Sister Basina, a nun of Neustrian royal blood, is bullied and oppressed by her two step-sisters. No one can defy her two step-sisters, who control the convent, so Basina endures her suffering alone, guided by the teaching, "Forgive your enemies." One day, Princess Clotilda of the Kingdom of Paris is on her way to the convent. Her encounter with Basina leads to a major rebellion that engulfs the nuns.

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

205684.description:
One day Kaoru Aoyama is working as a normal office worker in Japan and the next she's waking up to find that she's become Patience Granger, the daughter of a viscount! She isn't sure if she's been reincarnated into this world or if she's just possessing this body, but one thing is for sure: This isn't a simple magical adventure in another world. Despite being nobles, the Granger family is destitute! Patience is desperate to figure out how to help her family, including her adorable younger brothers, but her magic proficiency lies in household magic—a type relating to domestic chores. Not only does she have her family to worry about but Patience is also ten years old. She'll be enrolling in the Royal Academy, where she'll have to navigate relationships with other nobles while trying to grow her skills. Using her knowledge from her past life and the memories she has from the original Patience, this young noble is determined to use her talents to protect her angelic little brothers!

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: In Another World with Household Spells
Reborn in another world, all I know is daily-life spells.

title.native: 異世界に来たけど、生活魔法しか使えません THE COMIC
title.romaji: Isekai ni Kita kedo, Seikatsu Mahou shika Tsukaemasen: THE COMIC

205685.description:
When a human and a unicorn combine, they become a fake centaur! A boy who has been transformed into an unwanted form and a unicorn beast embark on a journey of adventure together! A human-horse oneness fantasy from Yasushi Baba, creator of "Rideon King," is now on the road!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

205686.description:
Ji-Won just wants to enjoy a steamy one-night stand, but the neighbor from hell keeps killing the mood. After nights of listening to a heartbroken stranger wail breakup anthems through the walls, Ji-Won finally storms next door to demand silence. Instead of a typical nuisance, he finds Hyeon watching a cringey, viral video of Ji-Won’s most cringe college memory. Now that his secret "black history" is out, things are about to get a lot more sour - and a little bit spicy.

(Source: Lezhin US)

205687.description:
Once sorta passionate lovers, Ha-Sol and Jin-Yul are now nothing more than each other's "exes." After completing his mandatory military service and returning to university, Jin-Yul unexpectedly crosses paths with Ha-Sol on campus. Uncomfortable with the awkward baggage of their shared history, Jin-Yul does everything in his power to avoid his former flame. However, destiny takes a bizarre and terrifying turn when a malicious ghost—one that had been relentlessly stalking Jin-Yul—takes complete possession of Ha-Sol's body.

Driven by the spirit's dark, uninhibited desires, the boundary between the supernatural and the carnal quickly dissolves. Trapped together by this paranormal anomaly, the former couple finds themselves pushed into an intense, feverish intimacy, crossing boundaries and indulging in raw, physical acts they never even dared to attempt back when they were actually dating. Their unresolved past colliding with possession sparks an uncontrollable, forbidden fire between them.

(Source: Lezhin US)

205688.description:
After a brutal war between humans and merfolk, a dark curse settled deep within the royal bloodline. Plagued by agonizing phantoms, Crown Prince Wook flees to a remote coastal temple, only to be lured over the cliff’s edge by the relentless voices. Against all odds, he survives the fall - only to wake up facing an impossible reality, and a mysterious savior who promises to break the royal curse. Can this stranger truly save him, or is Wook simply diving into a deeper deception?

(Source: Lezhin US)

205689.description:
Hint: Please give it your all, as if you are prepared to throw your life away. Once you see this dream, you will never wake up—the curtain rises on a "Nightmare" game that never ends.

"The participants for the Nightmare Game have all assembled." Haruto, an ordinary high school student, wakes up to find himself trapped inside a nightmare. An eerie announcement echoes through the building: if he cannot escape this unfamiliar shopping mall by dawn, he will experience a physical agony more terrifying than death. While Haruto is still half-doubting the reality of the situation, a blood-stained pursuer appears before him. To survive this irrational nightmare alongside the eight other participants present, he must find the only loophole hidden within the rules—but will he succeed?

You have been chosen as a participant in the nightmare. Now, please give it your all... as if you truly intend to throw your life away.

(Source: SB Creative, translated)

Note: Winner of the Silver Prize at the 17th GA Bunko Award.
synonyms: You have been chosen as a participant in the NIGHTMARE.

title.native: あなたは悪夢の参加者に選ばれました。
title.romaji: Anata wa Akumu no Sankasha ni Erabaremashita.

205690.description:
Hiroto fell in love at first sight with Shu, his older brother's friend. By the time he was finally honest with himself about his feelings, he no longer had a way to contact Shu. When he went to his brother's place hoping to get to Shu through him, the very person he longed for was right there.

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Released at J.GARDEN 56, 57 and 58.

205691.description: This story is about the romance between a young man traumatized by falling in love and a young man who absolutely hates being disliked by others.

205694.description:
Gekiba, known for his aggressive sales style, is in his fifth year as a host and is facing sluggish sales and is in danger of being fired. To avoid being fired, Gekiba is given the command by his owner, Nanae, to "master the 'Love Pillow'." To practice the pillow technique, Gekiba meets up with Hotaru, the No. 1 Love Pillow host from his time at the club, at a hotel. However, Hotaru suddenly changes from his usual cold attitude and starts to indulge him like crazy!!?

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

title.native: 負け犬のアイラブユー

205695.description:
Masaru and the Hayase family move from the city center to the suburbs, surrounded by abundant nature. Two fishing hooks are found inside a black sea bream delivered as a housewarming gift. The hooks tell the story of a fierce battle between a fisherman and a black sea bream. Fascinated by the fierce battle between man and fish, Masaru makes his own fishing equipment and heads out to a nearby river, but...!?

This is a story of fishing and friendship full of adventure for young Masaru and his friends.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

Note:
- Includes the one-shot "Wild Adventure"

205700.description: Ito Nagisa, who has been quietly creating a doujinshi yuri novel, reunites with her old friend Aoto Kaoru at a class reunion. Nagisa, who still draws illustrations, gets drunk and asks Aoto Kaoru to draw the cover of the doujinshi. Kaoru readily agrees, as long as her illustrations are needed. However, Nagisa has made various mistakes in the community and has been ostracized...!?

205703.description:
Wolves, mummies, and a haunted café, oh my!

College student Ryousuke Akaishi is desperately seeking work and housing when he manages to land an interview with a quaint café near his campus. Rumors abound that the place is haunted, but undaunted, Ryousuke agrees to take the job. There, he meets the Kurono siblings, and learns that there's a lot more to the café, and them, than meets the eye! Will they be able to dispel the rumors surrounding the café? And why was a mummy spotted in their window!?

(Source: Renta!)

205717.description:
This salaryman is a former underworld hitman!

Food company salesman Tokichi Inaba was once a feared hitman nicknamed "Nidō." Just when he thought he had completely cut ties with the underworld, one day he finds himself strapped to a bomb, forced to carry a gun, and forced to take on a life-threatening, shady part-time job!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 今日からヒットマン RISING
家に居た亡霊?がオレに懐いてメス♀憑れてきた件EX

205719.description:
After his mother dies, Tenma Miyamoto, a lonely boy, is sent home to a strange but adorable creature called "Chikucchi." He builds a friendship with the creature to fill the void in his heart, but one day, his father, who is after his mother's insurance money, shows up to his house and bullies the creature. A bloody, soothing, killer suspense story about a mysterious creature!

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

205720.description:
Kaguya, the protagonist of "Moongazer," is a striking beauty, but behind her back she is referred to as a "doll" due to her lack of emotional stability. She has a twin brother, Kosumi, who is a successful ballet dancer, and has decided to go overseas to meet him after graduating from high school. When her parents remarried, Gyoji became Kaguya's stepbrother, but he doesn't believe that she wants to go abroad and is worried about her. This is the story of a girl who has suppressed her feelings in despair about her future, and the 10 men who surround her.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

205721.description:
The students of Class 2B, who were living ordinary lives, are suddenly transported to another world by an angel who changes their classes into characters from another world, such as heroes and wizards. There, the students are forced to participate in an "extracurricular activity" called an "Otherworldly Massacre Battle," where they must kill each other until only one remains. The students, who have become enemies in the other world, each use their sword and magical abilities to engage in a life-or-death battle filled with friendship, betrayal, and despair.

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

205722.description:
A collection of early works from Ryoko Yamagishi.

3. 3, 2, 1, 0! (３・２・１・０！)

5. Botan Dourou (牡丹灯籠) [Tomo Kazuhashi - Original Story: Sanyutei Encho]

アイラブユー・アイラフユー
title.romaji: I Love you, I Laugh you

205725.description:
Yashiro Hachiya and Mitsuhiko Sanda are childhood friends and partners in the fledgling manzai comedy duo Katakuri. Playing the straight man to Mitsuhiko’s relentless funny man both onstage and off, Yashiro can’t help but groan at the endless stream of eye-rolling puns. And yet, no matter how much he complains, he never quite manages to pull away. If anything, he finds himself doing everything he can to remain by Mitsuhiko’s side...

(Source: Red String)

Note: Released at J.GARDEN 54 to 59.

205726.description:
Housekeeper Hasumi’s new workplace was an artist’s home that doubles as an atelier. There he was met with a bad-tempered client notorious for shooing away all the previous housekeepers — the private but popular ceramist who shows his real face, Kurose. While in a slump, Kurose began immersing himself in his creations until he pushed his body to the limit. However, touched by Hasumi’s gentle way of work, even his unsociable attitude slowly oozed out a soft sweetness…

“If you touch me like that with those palms-…”

A taciturn, handsome ceramist X A younger pure puppy-dog housekeeper. A BL that quenches your deepest thirst, a salvation to slow burn!

(Source: ShuCream, translated)
synonyms: Gathering Broken Shards in His Gentle Hands

title.native: 欠片をこの手にあつめて
title.romaji: Kakera wo Kono Te ni Atsumete

205728.description:
Ex is ridiculed by his peers as a failure of a hero, whose sacred light has yet to manifest. But it turns out to have manifested in his dick! How is he supposed to defeat anything with that?! Even when his town is attacked, all he can manage to do is have his crotch glow. While bearing the weight of these worries, a mysterious shrine appears before him...

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: Holy Pilgrimage Ecstasy: Defeat Demons in a Room You can't Get Out of Unless You do XXX

title.native: 聖巡エクスタシー－××しないと出られない部屋で魔族をブッ倒します－
title.romaji: Seijun Ecstasy: XXX Shinai to Derarenai Heya de Mazoku wo Buttaoshimasu

205729.description:
It is said that Liefes are only capable of conjuring the most difficult and least useful of spells... but that won’t stop Yui from doing what she loves! Despite being born a Liefe, Yui adores magic and learning all she can about it no matter the challenge. The more difficult spells, the better! If only her noble father approved. Deemed a failure to the family name, young Yui and her mother are banished from their own home... but she won’t let that stop her either! After years of struggle and devotion to her studies, Yui is accepted into one of the most prestigious magic academies in the kingdom. Here she will learn from the best magical practitioners in the world—if she can survive amongst all the pompous nobles with more bluster than brains. Constantly ridiculed and undermined by her privileged peers for being a Liefe, will Yui be able to study in peace and prove them wrong? And what ancient mysteries will her research uncover? That is, if the academy doesn’t stop her first...

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: The Blessing of Liefe: Leave This Magical Letdown Alone!

title.native: リーフェの祝福 ～無属性魔法しか使えない落ちこぼれとしてほっといてください～
title.romaji: Liefe no Shukufuku: Muzokusei Mahoushika Tsukaenai Ochikobore toshite Hottoite Kudasai

205730.description:
Hagiwara Shou, a young boy, lived happily with his father, a strong sailor, and his dog-fighter, Daichi, who aspires to become a Yokozuna. However, while trying to save his friends, his father was swept away by a storm and disappeared into the northern seas. Now without any family to call his own, Shou goes to live with Hatayama, who runs a boxing gym. There, he begins training hard in boxing with friends in similar circumstances...!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

205731.description: Legendary Samurai Tokugawa Ieyasu united Japan, in the 16th century. At the time, he said that if it wasn't for him, there would be only one man who'd have been the ruler of Japan… This is the story of a genius strategist, Kuroda Kanbee Yoshitaka, who used his smart tactics and wits to overcome every enemy in his way!

title.native: 義風堂々!! 疾風の軍師 -黒田官兵衛-
title.romaji: Gifuu Doudou!!: Kaze no Gunshi - Kuroda Kanbei

205732.description: Note: Originally self-published on Pixiv, was later licensed by Kadokawa for commercial release.

title.native: 嗚呼、たぬきはもうだめです
title.romaji: Ah, Tanuki wa Mou Dame desu

205733.description: A oneshot celebrating Gakuen Idolmaster 1.5 anniversary.

205735.description: Meet Matakichi, the new transfer student. He often gets misunderstood for a no-good delinquent because of his hot-temper but he's actually a kindhearted cat.
synonyms: 〜なめねこ又吉最強伝説〜なめんなよ!

title.native: なめんなよ! ―なめねこ又吉最強伝説
title.romaji: Namenna yo! Nameneko Matakichi Saikyou Densetsu

205736.description:
A no-good angel is tasked with raising talented people, but the person she puts in charge of is a devilish girl...! A laid-back and cheerful school comedy filled with silly gags and common misfortunes of no-good people!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

205737.description:
"I never intend to let you go for the rest of my life."

In a world where humans and ayakashi coexist, Sumire, whose parents were once killed by a fallen ayakashi, was passed around among her relatives, but her only dream was to become a shrine maiden. However, for some reason, her spiritual powers have diminished, and now she is treated as a failure and bullied by those around her, putting her dream in jeopardy. One day, Sumire takes care of a weakened ayakashi and makes a blood pact to share her spiritual powers with him to help him recover. He turns out to be a Karasu Tengu, a man of the highest rank and beauty!

A classic Japanese Cinderella story begins, where sharing life and trust forge bonds!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 鴉天狗様と最愛の契り～落ちこぼれの私が、最強のあやかしに執着されるまで～
title.romaji: Karasu Tengu-sama to Saiai no Chigiri: Ochikobore no Watashi ga, Saikyou no Ayakashi ni Shuuchaku Sareru Made

205738.description: 17-year-old Lina lives in the kingdom of Wamonal. She’s a positive girl searching for a job to become independent. But one day, she suddenly regains memories of her past life as a preschool teacher. By chance, she grows close to a young girl named Alice, turning her life upside down! Because of Alice’s attachment to her, her guardian—the knight Lucas—asks Lina to work as a live-in housekeeper with them…?!
synonyms: The Child and the Knight Are Both in Love With Me

title.native: 子供に懐かれたら家政婦になりました。 あれ？騎士様にも溺愛されてるようです!?
title.romaji: Kodomo ni Natsukaretara Kaseifu ni Narimashita. Are? Kishi-sama ni mo Dekiaisareteru you desu?!

title.native: ハーレムバンディット

synonyms: Take it easy, cause the sky is so blue

title.native: らしくいこーよ、空はキレイだよ
title.romaji: Rashiku Ikouyo, Sora wa Kirei da yo

205741.description:
Eun-Seom is the transfer student everyone is talking about. With his striking blonde hair and the dangerous rumors that follow him, he’s impossible to miss. But Iseo, with a gentle nature, doesn’t judge people by their looks or rumors, and finds Eun-Seom rather interesting. When they are assigned seats next to each other, Iseo tries to be friendly, but Eun-Seom remains on high alert. However, between shared desks and stolen glances, a quiet bond begins to form.

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: タンポポ観察日記～愛するオメガくん～

205742.description:
Ever since being disowned by his religious parents for being gay, Kwon Yi-Hyeon has been all alone. After nine years, he believes he has gotten used to this life until he runs into Gu Seung-Hyeok, an old wound from high school. Now a ruthless gangster, Seung-Hyeok is just as cold to Yi-Hyeon as the winter they have reunited in. But when Yi-Hyeon enters a contract deal with Seung-Hyeok due to his financial troubles, perhaps their frosty relationship could turn into hope of a spring to come...

(Source: Tappytoon)

205743.description:
“How are you supposed to handle two of them? Just stay put.”

Yun Ju-Won, a job seeker about to graduate from college, ends up going on a hot spring trip at the urging of his twin friends Cha Cha-Hyeon and Cha Cha-Yun, whom he's known for ten years. But this trip feels strangely off. The pension they booked by chance is eerily quiet, and instead of taking the bath they were told to, the twins become fixated on Ju-Won's inverted nipples...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Part of Daiwon's Neungyonk BL Danpyeon (능욕BL단편) Collection.
synonyms: [Neungyok BL Danpyeon] Chingudeulgwa Hamkkehaneun Oncheon Yeohaeng

205744.description:
“I... know the boss's secret.”

As punishment for refusing to attend to the young master at night, Jeong Tae-Seok was forced to take a drug that made milk flow from his chest. Even as he endured the humiliating punishment of having a stranger suckle his milk, new employee Kang Ha-Ru discovered that secret.

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

205745.description:
"I want to build this together. Within the time we share."

Six young people still clumsy at love. Within the relationship of lovers, they understand each other, share their thoughts, and finally learn to truly see themselves.

(Source: Naver, translated)

205746.description:
Kang Yi-Chae, a second-year master's student in a notoriously tense graduate lab. Overwhelmed by work and her single-minded personality, every day is a constant strain. The only thing keeping her going is her boyfriend, Seong Ju-Won. She feels increasingly burdened by the thought that she might be becoming too dependent on him—a man who seems perfect to anyone who sees him. But with nowhere to confide these feelings, her only solace comes from the shaman So-Yul. Then one day, circumstances reveal that the very person who cornered Yi-Chae is none other than Ju-Won...

As Ju-Won begins to shed his mask and actively seeks to dominate Yi-Chae, and So-Yul fights to protect her from him, what will become of Yi-Chae's future...?

(Source: Naver, translated)

205748.description:
I have a friend. My night friend, whom I only meet at night. I don't know his name, age, or contact information. All I know is his sculpted, handsome face, his intense gaze that leaves me frozen, and his fierce movements that carried me to a pleasure I'd never experienced before. One day, a month into our relationship, I saw him by chance. During the day. At work.

(Source: Naver, translated)

205749.description:
A spin-off of the nationally popular manga "Tsuri Baka Nisshi"!

They're good at their jobs and popular. But for some reason, they're people who don't get the spotlight... Those are the Shadowmen! This is an anthology comedy spin-off of "Tsuri Baka Nisshi" by Yamasaki Juzo and Kitami Kenichi!

(Source: Big Comics, translated)

title.native: 釣りバカ日誌番外編 シャドーマン

synonyms: Live Broadcast, I Roam Freely in the Other World

Yi Li Po Zhu Tian Wan Jie

205753.description:
Kanamachi Kazuki has just moved into his dream high-rise apartment, and he's finally managed to get the married women who have been making fun of those living on the lower floors to submit to him. There's no way he can stop enjoying this kind of pleasure! Kazuki has now decided to bring down the hammer on the nasty rich wives and rise to the top...

(Source: Young Animal, translated)

title.native: タワマン・リベンジ～最下層からのヤり上がり～
title.romaji: Tower Man Revenge: Sai Kasou no Yari Agari

205754.description:
Nakayama Itsuki, who grew up on a horse farm, prides himself on knowing everything about horses, and hates horse racing, where horses are treated like tools. One day, Ishii, who had fallen off a horse while jockeying one of the horses he raised on the farm and had his racing career cut short, visits him. Ishii, seeing itsuki's natural talent for handling horses, offers to enroll Itsuki in the jockey school where he teaches. Itsuki is reluctant, but he takes him to the racing school on the condition that he listens to the winner of the race, and he immediately begins racing. Itsuki was confident he could win, but he lost to a first-year student, and the frustration of that experience led him to enroll in the jockey school.

A horse racing manga by a master of animal manga.

Note:
- Includes the one-shot "Bear Hunter Fubuki-gou (Bear Hunter Fubuki)"
- Includes the one-shot "Hakugin no Teiou (Silver Emperors)"
- Includes the one-shot "Black Cobra"

205755.description: Note: Published in Monthly Shonen Jump Zoukan 1983-02

205756.description: Note: Published in Weekly Young Magazine September 2014, Issue 29.

205757.description:
In order to change himself from being shy and friendless, Hatsutou makes his debut at university as a gal boy. One day, drunk, he approaches a virgin on the street and asks if he'll suck him off, but for some reason, a scary-looking guy says, "That would be nice," and takes him to a hotel. Even though it's his first time doing anything naughty, the guy ends up making him melt with pleasure!!?

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
205757.hashtag: #ワモテお兄さんとうぶギャルくん
synonyms: The Scary-Looking Guy and the Innocent Flashy Dude.

title.native: コワモテお兄さんとうぶギャルくん

205758.description:
Continuation of Hajimete no Volume 1.

Notes:
- Original serialization ran for seven chapters under the title "Danshi Koukousei, Hajimete no: Date H-hen (男子校生、はじめての デートH編)". In the volume release, Chapters 1 and 2 were combined as Chapter 1, Chapters 3 and 4 as Chapter 2, and Chapters 5 and 6 as Chapter 3.
- Includes two extra chapters.
synonyms: 男子校生、はじめての デートH編
Danshi Koukousei, Hajimete no: Date H-hen

title.native: はじめての デートH編

205759.description:
Kabuki Suzu is abducted and thrown from a building. As she lies on the brink of death, her mind is occupied with a desire for revenge against the woman who hit and killed her husband.

When she wakes up, she finds herself with a different face. She has been transformed into the woman's daughter, Midorikawa Reika, and begins to take action in this body to exact revenge.

(Source: Micro Magazine Inc., translated)
synonyms: I'll do it again and again until I kill you.

title.native: お前を殺るまで何度でも
title.romaji: Omae wo Yaru Made Nando Demo

205760.description:
Louis spent his childhood doing whatever he could to get by in the little village he calls home. He must leave the orphanage now that he’s come of age, and there’s one thing he wants above all else: freedom from poverty. His best shot at making a stable life for himself lies in graduating from Arneval Academy. If only the tuition weren’t so expensive. In need of work, Louis registers with the Adventurer’s Guild where he meets Bolt, a seasoned adventurer who insists they form a party together and even helps Louis save up for his school fees. But life at the academy still comes at a price, and Louis finds staying in the party with Bolt might not be so bad, especially as feelings begin to bloom with every new adventure. However, all is not as it seems. Bolt may not be who he claims, and the mysteries of Louis’s own past might very well upend everything he thought he knew about himself. Will the truth break their bond, or will it draw them closer than ever?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.native: それは無謀というものだ。
title.romaji: Sore wa Mubou to Iu Mono da.

205763.description:
"I want to be a strong man!" To make his dream come true, Miyazaki Miyao tries all kinds of martial arts, but quits after two weeks. He's short, skinny, and not very strong, and he's always told, "You have no talent!" One day, a student at his school invites Miyao to try Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu. Anyone can become strong! The story of a Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu "beginner" begins!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

205764.description:
Kreis, the son of a powerful marquess, is actually a modern-day Japanese man who’s been reincarnated into the world of a BL novel...that he wrote! Unfortunately, his memories don’t return until after he’s been branded a villain, executed as a lackey of the final boss, and sent back in time. Now that he has a second chance at life, Kreis swears revenge on the family that mistreated him and vengeance for the story’s stunningly beautiful final boss: King Siegfried. For some reason, Kreis is overwhelmed with a desire to protect him, no matter the cost. Kreis knows that all the main characters of the story, including his younger brother—the story’s original protagonist—will soon gather for his birthday party. With Siegfried’s support, will Kreis finally break free from the story’s predetermined path?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.english: Romance Revived: An NPC Was the Final Boss's Love
title.native: 死に戻ったモブはラスボスの最愛でした
title.romaji: Shi ni Modotta Mob wa Last Boss no Saiai deshita

title.romaji: Tick! Tack!: Thunder Kick na Koi Monogatari

205769.description:
1. Aki no Hana (秋の華)
2. Wedding Dress (ウェディング·ドレス)
3. Zakuro Zansou (柘榴残照)
4. Kaze no Kioku (風の記憶)

title.romaji: Ikeda Riyoko THE BEST: Ai to Tatakau Onna-tachi

title.native: SCP財団コミックアンソロジー　娘

205773.description:
Bearing the traitor’s brand, Se-un Tang spent a lifetime creating the tools of the Murim's destruction, waiting for a single moment to strike. But when the decisive moment comes, he is instead thrust back in time, carrying the weight of a future that hasn't happened. Let the furnace roar, let the hammer sing, and let their blood quench the steel. The Demon Smith stands before the anvil once more to forge a path tempered in vengeance.

(Source: WEBTOON)

205774.description:
This is a story of bonds and memories, of a man who believed in bonds and continued to care for his comrades.

Kazuto, a boy transported to Fernad, a world of swords and magic. As a price for the power bestowed upon him by the Goddess of Bonds, he acts as a "Lost Namer," disappearing from the memories of those he comes into contact with when he leaves his party.

Kazuto survives countless adventures and becomes a member of the S-rank Saint Brave Maiden Party. But just before the final battle with the Demon King, he is expelled from the party by the Saint Brave Maiden Romina, and disappears from their memories.

Six months later, he hears the good news that the Demon King has been successfully defeated by Romina and her friends.

Kazuto, who had been traveling alone as a mere adventurer, returns to town after the battle. His heart is always with them.

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title.native: 忘れられ師の英雄譚　聖勇女パーティーに優しき追放をされた男は、記憶に残らずとも彼女達を救う
title.romaji: Wasurerareshi no Eiyuutan: Seiyuujo Party ni Yasashiki Tsuihou wo Sareta Otoko wa, Kioku ni Nokorazutomo Kanojo-tachi wo Sukuu

205775.description:
Sahashi-kun, an ordinary elementary school student, encounters strange things, events, and people as if it were a normal thing. This is the start of a tale of everyday life!

(Source: Mato Grosso, translated)

title.native: 佐橋くんのあやかし日和

205776.description:
Disowned, disgraced, and doomed to be a farmer. Being “blessed” with a farmer affinity is practically a death sentence for Chris Sparring. It’s nothing close to the sword-wielding class he’d been raised to inherit, that’s for sure. To make matters worse, his twin brother receives the affinity of a sword god instead, and wastes no time funneling years of jealousy into an attempt on Chris’s life. With nothing left to lose, Chris must find a way to make it on his own and avenge his name. And this “useless” poison resistance of his may be just what he needs to turn the tables!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.english: Sowing Vengeance: The Eldest Son’s Disgraceful Green Thumb
title.native: 追放された名家の長男 ～馬鹿にされたハズレスキルで最強へと昇り詰める～
title.romaji: Tsuihou Sareta Meika no Chounan: Baka ni Sareta Hazure Skill de Saikyou e to Noboritsumeru

205777.description:
Pit-a-Pat’s fans ship everyone together except Tae-Joon and Min-Jae. Which should be a good thing, because they’re already dating! But the group’s youngest member, Tae-Joon, can’t help feeling insecure when everyone adores his leader so damn much. Can their love story overcome the struggles of fame and fandom?

(Source: Tapas)

205779.description:
Felik was born into a rice farming family in a world where rice tastes bad. On his eighth birthday, he was given the skill [Breeding - Rice] and remembered his past life when he loved rice. Although those around him laugh at him for using the skill, the dishes he makes with the delicious rice he has improved, such as porridge, rice balls, unique burnt rice sandwiches, and rice pizza, are a big hit with the people of the other world! A former Japanese man begins rice reform with a divine beast who has become his rice friend!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 異世界ごはん無双 ～スキルと前世の知識を使って、お米改革はじめます！～
title.romaji: Isekai Gohan Musou: Skill to Zense no Chishiki wo Tsukatte, Okome Kaikaku Hajimemasu!

205780.description:
"I've lost my memory, I'm estimated to be 13 years old, and I might be the last surviving member of the human race - but it's okay. I have everyone with me. I have Spike, Angela, Cleric, Reeves, and Trigger. So it's okay." One day, Haruka, a girl who lives in an abandoned building with robots that are like family to her, sees a girl who looks just like her. - Could it be that there is another human being alive besides her? After an extensive search, she finally meets the girl who introduces herself as Eva, but her true identity is...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 鉄コミュニケイション

205781.description:
Hades and Kore have successfully been wed! Sure, they’ve got a complicated prenup, but the two are living a peaceful life as newlyweds... or at least, that’s how things were supposed to go, until the realm of Hades literally froze over!?

(Source: Yen Press)

title.native: ハデスさまの春めく蜜月

synonyms: My Porn Actress Activities Were Discovered

title.native: ジュニアポルノに出演しているのをクラスの男の子に知られてしまいました
title.romaji: Junior Porn ni Shutsuen Shiteiru no wo Class no Otokonoko ni Shirarete Shimaimashita

205784.description:
"Tsugiboshi" (The Splicing of a Book), in which a reader buys a book that doesn't exist; "21g's Adventure," in which the reader enjoys a walk in the air; "Interference," in which the reader begins to hear radio from a foreign country; and "Underground Library Exploration," in which the reader gets lost in the basement of a library.

This book contains four exquisite low fantasy stories that invite the reader into a "mysterious world" that is connected to everyday life.

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title.native: 室外機室 ちょめ短編集

205785.description:
A unique buddy team of a space girl and a middle-aged detective takes on a full-scale sci-fi monster battle action!

Detective Yasaka, who retired from the front lines after a certain incident, is approached by a girl named Joshua who calls herself a "space police officer." She tells Yasaka that a space monster has escaped from a transport ship that fell as a meteorite, and asks for Yasaka's help. Yasaka is skeptical, but decides to accompany the search, when suddenly a giant mechanical monster appears...!?

A full-scale sci-fi monster battle action story featuring a space girl and an older detective!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 大宇宙怪獣大防衛大戦
title.romaji: Dai Uchuu Kaijuu Dai Bouei Taisen

205786.description:
"Tailor no Yuuutsu" is a Victorian British horror tale about an odd couple who run a tailor's shop: Luke, a tall young man who is skilled but shy around strangers, and Joseph, a small but sociable vampire who lives with them. One day, a vampire appears before the two and makes a "request."

(Source: Natalie, translated)
synonyms: The uninvited guest for the tailor.

205787.description:
The series sees mathematician Gakuto Mikoshiba, from Kaminaga's other series Kakuritsu Sōsa-ka (Probability Investigator), battle wits with Yakumo Saito from the Psychic Detective Yakumo series.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: 心霊探偵八雲 INITIAL FILE 思考のバイアス
title.romaji: Shinrei Tantei Yakumo: INITIAL FILE Shikou no Bias

205789.description:
Ten years in the making. The author's first manga work, self-published last year and sold out in an instant, now makes its commercial debut with substantial additions!!

A sudden natural disaster struck. Five-year-old En-chan's time had reverted to infancy. Drooling freely and driven by curiosity, En-chan moves, En-chan eats. With the immense power of her tiny body, she creates a new world—.

This work is a story that summons back from the depths of memory the “origin” of life that everyone once touched. Amidst the daily challenges of childcare, the author took up a pencil and captured, one after another, the unknown vistas unfolding through growth and the mysteries that precede words. With each turn of the page, the ebb and flow of “creation” and “destruction,” brimming with unseen freshness, transcends the boundaries of our vision and emotion through the artist's touch, reversing how we perceive the world. Into the gaps of loosened consciousness, a soft, nostalgic sense of return will flow, tracing each reader's own memories.

(Source: Torch, translated)

Note: Originally published as a web manga with the full volume self-published in 2025. This edition is new and heavily revised with over 60 new pages more than the previous edition and more than double the pages of the original web release. The English release is based on the web edition.

205790.description:
Cecilia, the duke's daughter, has been given a critical mission to maintain peace between humanity and the Demon King. To do this, she must win over the Demon King's heart and avert her people's destruction. But when she arrives to meet her betrothed, the Demon King isn't at all what she anticipated! Rather than a terrifying beast, Cecilia is engaged to a beautiful and innocent-looking young woman!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: The Duke's Daughter's Mission to Seduce the Demon King, Humanity's Final Gambit: A Political Marriage with the Demon King! ...Hang On, But What am I Supposed to Do If the Demon King is a Girl!?

title.english: The Duke’s Daughter Must Seduce the Demon King… But the Demon King’s a Girl?!
title.native: 公爵令嬢の籠絡ミッション～魔王との政略結婚が、人類最後の切り札です！…って、魔王が女の子の場合はどうすればいいのですか！？～
title.romaji: Koushaku Reijou no Rouraku Mission: Maou to no Seiryaku Kekkon ga, Jinrui Saigo no Kirifuda desu!... tte, Maou ga Onnanoko no Baai wa Dou Sureba Ii no desu ka!?

205792.description:
Eiji, who aims to be a "God-tier artist" at an arts high school, felt daily anxiety and impatience due to the high skill level of those around him. For him, the only one who can put his mind at ease is his classmate Reona, who is terrible at drawing!

A slapstick art-school romantic comedy about looking down to feel secure and looking up to dream!!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

205793.description: A manga about artists who fight with their paintings.

title.native: 芸術家が絵で戦うマンガ
title.romaji: Geijutsuka ga E de Tatakau Manga

205795.description:
After finishing his residency, Seol-Won opens an eye clinic in his hometown and plans a getaway at his friend's mountain villa to celebrate. Because his friends are running late, he ends up spending the night alone... and hears someone enter the premises. Thankfully, it's just Hae-Joo, his friend's mysterious brother who came to get something from the villa. But when a massive blizzard traps the two of them inside the villa, Seol-Won can't help feeling self-conscious around the alpha who looks intimidating but seems kind. Will the unlikely pair get to know each other before the snow lets up?

(Source: Tappytoon)

205796.description:
Kwon Hyun-Seo, top student in the school, well-liked by peers, trusted by teachers. He has a father who frequently resorts to violence and a troublesome younger brother. One day, while enduring life solely for the thought of escaping home, he hears news that his brother has been bullied at school. The perpetrator is Lee Si-Hyun, a classmate of his younger brother. Enraged by the perpetrator's attitude, showing no sign of remorse and trying to settle it with money, he ultimately lets it go, powerless. After that, his future becomes uncertain when he coincidentally encounters Lee Si-Hyun again and gets entangled with him...

“Since my life's already a sewer, come to me.”

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

205797.description:
Goh Wun is back from the brink of death, but the man who loved him is gone. Waking up with total amnesia, Wun finds that his only lifeline is Kwon Hui-Jae: a guide who looks at him with equal parts longing and loathing. As they navigate a dangerous web of secrets and supernatural stakes, Wun realizes that forgetting the past didn't make the pain go away. He still has his powers, and he still wants Huijae. But in this game of redemption, the truth might be more dangerous than the loss of memory itself.

(Source: Lezhin US)

205798.description:
In a world overrun with deathwalkers, the factotum disciple, Chen Yuan, accidentally awakens a Universal Extraction System after getting attacked by some lowlifes. The System can extract cultivation, cultivation methods, spirit energy and so on from all non-living things. With the aid of the System, Chen Yuan begins to level up by killing monsters. But unbeknownst to him, hidden behind his ordeals is a giant conspiracy targeted at him...

(Source: WebComics)

title.native: 我在末日玄幻世界无敌了
title.romaji: Wo Zai Mori Xuanhuan Shijie Wudile

205799.description:
Doh I-Hyeon is the ultimate corporate workaholic, but he hides two secrets: he’s a somewhat defective omega and he suffers from prosopagnosia—the inability to recognize faces. After a blurry, drunken one-night stand leads to an unexpected pregnancy, I-Hyeon decides to keep the baby and brave single parenthood in secret. But his carefully constructed walls start to crumble when his superior, Seo Jeong-Un, begins a relentless pursuit. Jeong-Un is charming, persistent, and strangely familiar, but to a man who can’t recognize a face, his flirtations are just another workplace distraction. Can Jeong-Un break through I-Hyeon’s "iron wall," or will I-Hyeon’s condition keep the father of his child a mystery forever?

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: アクシデンタル・ベイビー
A Story About Stepping on a Penis.

2. Habanera: L'amour est un oiseau rebelle

205811.description:
Almost touching, yet passing by. A love that still isn't equal begins to move.

Amagi Tsuzuri was dumped by his ex-boyfriend for having “strong sexual desires.” Traumatized, he avoided people and threw himself into his work. Then, for others facing similar struggles, he developed ‘Yorisooo’, a virtual space game with matching features, connecting people without real-world contact. One day, to confront his suppressed desires, Tsuzuri tries matching in Yorisooo for the first time. There, he encounters a stranger who looks exactly like Naruse, a junior colleague at his company.

If it's someone else, maybe I can tell them what I want.

Thinking this, Tsuzuri becomes just a little bold...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

205819.description:
Oomori High School is a one-of-a-kind high school for delinquents. Leo, a first-year student, spends his days fighting in his quest to reach the top, but Kenny, the leader of the second-year class, stands in his way. Kenny's weapon isn't his fists, but his "bento" lunchbox...?! A gourmet comedy about the strongest delinquent who rises through the ranks of the delinquent school through the power of food!

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

205820.description:
A collection of full-color short stories and illustrations.

Note: released at COMITIA 138

205830.description:
As an apprentice adventurer, Serk was nothing more than his party's errand boy. After being constantly ridiculed and called useless, he was eventually kicked to the curb by the very comrades he served.

But his former party had no idea what they’d just thrown away. They had no idea that Serk's long, thankless life of running errands had caused an incredible, new talent to blossom within him.

He now wields the "SSS-Rank Shopping Skill", a unique power that makes him stronger with every single purchase. By buying and massively enhancing items, Serk is ready to become an unstoppable force on his quest to become the most powerful adventurer in the world!

title.native: 追放されたパシリ、買い物スキルSSSで装備無双　～買ったモノを超強化して最強パーティー目指します～
title.romaji: Tsuihou Sareta Pashiri, Kaimono Skill SSS de Soubi Musou: Katta Mono wo Chou Kyouka Shite Saikyou Party Mezashimasu

205831.description:
Siblings with personalities and tastes as different as night and day: Cheon-Jae and Man-Jae. Unlike Cheon-Jae, whose social skills are maxed out, Man-Jae's only friend is the youngest cat, Baek-Jae.

“With no one to meet but books, I can't help but study well!”

Cheon-Jae schemes to find Man-Jae a friend, while Baek-Jae watches it all with disdain...

One cat, two humans. The chaotic and delightful daily life of three siblings!

(Source: Naver, translated)

205836.description:
Duke Aden de Biffleten is feared across the empire—a terrifying monster whose gaze is said to have killed people. Any woman would dread becoming his bride, yet Elyn de Arlen steps forward, compelled by a prophetic dream in which they are wed. Shunned and mistreated by her house, she sees this marriage as her escape. But that escape leads to a frozen, perilous land, where she must avoid the duke’s eyes. Can she truly survive as his wife, or has she doomed herself to live with this monster?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: How to Survive as the Monster Duke’s Wife
Living to Survive as the Monster Duke’s Wife

title.english: Fated to Become the Monster Duke's Wife

205847.description:
Mary is an orphan who has been blessed with the special ability to copy other people's hair color. As a body double for Leonora, the youngest princess of the Granberg Kingdom, she is subjected to a strict lady's education, and before she knows it, Leonora is dumping most of her work on her. One day, the eldest son of the Marquis, Alberto, is chosen as Leonora's potential fiancé. However, Leonora is dissatisfied with the engagement and orders Mary to find some flaws in Alberto in order to break it off...!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: The Marriage of the Third Princess

title.native: 末王女の輿入れ～その陰で嵌められ、使い捨てられた王女の影武者の少女が自分の幸せを掴むまで～
title.romaji: Sue Oujo no Koshi Ire: Sono Kage de Hamerare, Tsukai Suterareta Oujo no Kagemusha no Shoujo ga Jibun no Shiawase wo Tsukamu Made

205848.description:
The protagonist is shocked by the announcement of her favorite idol's disbandment and dies in an accident. She misses her long-awaited Budokan concert, and as her consciousness fades, a strange sight unfolds before her.

She wakes up to find herself in an alternate world where demons and humans coexist. She's reincarnated as Yuria, the daughter of a theater owner drowning in debt! If things continue as they are, the theater will go bankrupt and she herself will be sold into slavery...?!

Just then, a beastman named Cain, who looks just like her idol from her previous life, appears and asks her to help out with any chores she can to protect the theater. After meeting him, Yuria decides to produce a demon idol and change her future as a slave!

She aims to repay her debt with the help of her non-human companions—vampires, elves, slimes, and beastmen—but a powerful rival group also appears. Will Yuria be able to repay her debt safely?!

A demon x idol x alternate world fantasy begins!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 異世界は魔族アイドルであふれてる！
title.romaji: Isekai wa Mazoku Idol de Afureteru!

205849.description:
Misano Neko is a 25-year-old unemployed aspiring manga artist. After another disappointing meeting, he returns home to find a man with a murderous appearance standing there. The man calls Neko "God" and, for some reason, is relentlessly kind to him - but who is he?! A thrilling coming-of-age comedy about a negative manga artist and a mysterious long-time fan!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

205851.description:
The manga centers on Ritsu, an office lady who worries too much about other people. She finds out the Mo and Rune, two people she met through an online game, are also her "lonely meal comrades." Boldly, she decides to go on a buffet trip with them.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: ぼっちが集まってバイキング行ってみた
おっパラダイスは診療中

205853.description:
You probably have friends around you who try to outdo each other, who like to hang out with others, or who are addicted to social media... You may have gotten along well at first, but before you know it, these toxic friends are causing you headaches.

"It's painful to be around them, but we still have to get along, and it's better to have lots of friends..."

Arima Ado from the Graduate School of Human Studies will teach you how to break free from this curse! This is a friendship detox comic for everyone who is troubled by their friends! It also includes a column analyzing toxic friends.

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

205856.description:
1-2. Nyoin no Kairaku: Waka Oku-sama no Mitsu Tsubo (女陰の快楽一若奥様の蜜壺一); ANGEL Club 2020-09, 2022-08
