205857.description: Deep within the mountains. The swordsman Miyamoto Musashi saved people fleeing from attackers. On his journey toward Edo, he encountered another man who also claimed to be Miyamoto Musashi. A mysterious wanted poster issued for “Miyamoto Musashi,” and self-proclaimed “Miyamoto Musashis” gathering from across the nation. This marked the beginning of a conspiracy threatening to shake the very foundations of the shogunate. A grand entertainment, reinterpreting history, now begins.

title.native: 異説 剣豪伝奇 武蔵伝

205859.description:
Okazono Suzu is a sixth-grader at the age where she dreams of kissing. One day, she learns that her favorite idol is going on hiatus, and becomes deeply depressed. Her mischievous and bratty classmate, Hanai So, encourages her. With her dream of kissing her idol shattered, Suzu laments that she will never be able to kiss him again, when Hanai makes an unexpected suggestion...

The story depicts the love lives of adolescent boys and girls.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

205860.description:
"Don't worry, I'm here." Why is my boss doing this for me?

Haruka, an office worker, suddenly finds herself 29 years old, with none of the life plans she had envisioned coming true. Then, to make matters worse, she witnesses her live-in boyfriend cheating on her! While holding back tears in the hallway, her boss, Director Takagi, sees her. Director Takagi is a talented young man who everyone looks up to, and I don't want him to see me like this... Unaware of my feelings, Director Takagi sincerely listens to my concerns until late at night...and even ends up staying at his house!? Why is he being so kind to me, a mere subordinate? I can't stop my heart beating fast as my boss, the perfect boss, makes a bold advance on me!

(Source: CLLENN, translated)

title.native: 高嶺の上司の熱視線～同情のはずが、甘く切望されてしまいました～
title.romaji: Takane no Joushi no Nesshisen: Doujou no Hazu ga, Amaku Setsubou sarete Shimaimashita

205862.description:
Natsuko Takamiya (33) is in despair after being dumped by the man she was planning to marry. She commutes between the apartment she bought and her workplace, and her only joy is a nightly drink. But her dreary daily life is turned upside down by a surly, handsome clerk who recently joined her favorite convenience store...!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)
synonyms: How Two Unfortunate Hearts Find Love

title.native: 不遇なふたりの愛し方

205869.description:
Set in the near future, where the female population has decreased, the title story "I Love Doll" depicts the trajectory of pure love between an elementary school boy, Takumi, and a love doll named "Arika" that was abandoned in a junkyard.

"Morning Beauty - The Awakening Beauty of the Forest" is a coming-of-age drama that begins with the transfer of a beautiful and noble cross-dressing boy, Hiiragi Satsuki. "Utsusemi no Tamago" depicts the forbidden relationship between a female teacher who experiences setbacks and a genius boy.

"Proposal" depicts the brave and powerful love between a university student couple.

There is poison in beautiful things - a long-awaited collection of works by Stellagi Suzuka, who captivates readers with her unique worldview!!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: I love doll 星樹スズカ作品集
title.romaji: I love doll: Stellagi Suzuka Sakuhinshuu

205870.description:
Born into a prestigious family of shamans who exorcise ghosts and protect the dynasty, Feng Lingyao lacks talent for shamanism and harbors complicated feelings for his childhood friend and fiancé, Dong Yueji, a rare shaman. Meanwhile, Lingyao is tasked with supervising Yueli and accompanies her to Yangliu Island to exorcise ghosts...! An occult Chinese demon-exorcising fantasy about a beautiful shaman and a strict young prince begins!

(Source: KADOKAWA, translated)

205871.description:
Mamajin, the mother robot who gathers together orphans and raises them as a family, is kind, but has no heart.

She's a good cook, but has no sense of taste. The children bond with Mamajin, who is a little clumsy but powerful and cute... A heartwarming and delicious story of a family.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 機械仕掛けの愛　ママジン

205872.description:
After her father dies in a political battle, Countess Giselle is on the verge of becoming homeless. But she is saved by Duke Bertram, who is rumored to be cruel and misanthropic. Thanks to a bet between her father and Bertram, Giselle becomes his wife...!? A love story with an age gap!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: 棘公爵の花嫁 賭けをしましょう、旦那様
title.romaji: Ibara Koushaku no Hanayome Kake wo Shimashou, Danna-sama

205876.description: The main character, Mizuki Sato, is nearsighted with a visual acuity of 0.05 and severe astigmatism. She humorously depicts her nearsightedness.

205877.description:
Prince Ousu of Yamato is at the mercy of the divine power that resides within him and burdened with a great sin. Leaving his hometown with nothing but the clothes on his back, he sets out in the west to pacify the Kumaso. What will he find?

(Source: Kobunsha, translated)

title.native: 無用の皇子は西に向き
title.romaji: Muyou no Ouji wa Nishi ni Muki

205879.description:
Misa Kasuga is a 34-year-old single female office worker. As she watches the younger staff at her company quit left and right to get married, Misa discovers that her boyfriend has been cheating on her, and their relationship comes to an abrupt end. Approaching her 40s, Misa worries about being labeled as "unwanted leftovers" at the company, but she is then invited out for a drink with her handsome boss, Noguchi. Getting drunk, she ends up impulsively proposing to him, but this unexpectedly results in the two becoming close! However, there are rumors floating around that there is some reason behind why the 40 year-old Noguchi is still single...!

(Source: Manga Plaza)

title.english: 34 and Counting:My Reverse Proposal to Find Love

205888.description: First published as a doujin in 2008, next in the yuri anthology magazine Tsubomi in 2009.

205889.description:
Two sisters lose their parents in a sudden accident. Unable to make the right choice in the face of the reality they are faced with, the older sister sacrifices "someone's" life once again to protect her younger sister. A suspense story about sisters in the underworld begins!

(Source: Gentosha, translated)

205890.description: Note: Published in Weekly Young Jump 2026 No.6&7.

205901.description:
The protagonist, Joe Shimamura, was confined in a juvenile detention center. As he attempted to escape with his fellow inmates, they were captured by a suspicious group dressed in black suits: the Black Ghosts. He lost consciousness and woke up restrained on an operating table. Beside him stood a figure wearing an eerie mask, calling himself Skull. The mysterious figure declared: “The next time you wake up, you'll be a cyborg...”

What on earth happened to Joe? Nine cyborg warriors wield their ultimate skills to challenge evil and fight like gods!

Shotaro Ishinomori's masterpiece “Cyborg 009” finally gets its long-awaited first full-color vertical-reading comic adaptation!

(Source: Futami Shobo, translated)

205902.description:
A new queen was born in the bee kingdom. And the worker bees born at the same time would also come to serve her. But a crisis looms over the bee kingdom they built!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

205908.description:
Everyone has a childhood dream of martial arts, leaping across rooftops, controlling Internal energy, and being immune to all poisons. Is it just a fictional legend, or is it true? This story will take you into the modern world of martial arts.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

205910.description:
An unpredictable suspense drama between a killer and a bird.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 夫妻は互いの知らぬ間に -誰が一番悪いでしょうか-
title.romaji: Futari wa Tagai no Shiranuma ni: Dare ga Ichiban Warui Deshou ka

205914.description:
Vivian awakens as a terminally ill heroine destined for a tragic end. Her only hope is to win over Rachel, the story's most feared villainess. The plan works perfectly — until she discovers the cold beauty she calls her best friend is actually a man… and friendship is the last thing on his mind!

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: I’m the Only One Who Didn’t Know the Villainess Was a Male

205916.description:
High schooler Kiki lived a quiet life alone with her beloved mother. That ordinary daily life collapsed entirely with her mother’s death. Driven by rage, Kiki kills the man responsible—but that was merely the beginning of the "Story"! The curtains now open on a blood-soaked, non-stop revenge drama...!!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

Our Easygoing Friend GO Rani's Independence Diary★

The mundane days of Rani the Hamster, a story of her daily life and growth as she somehow manages to survive. Even in this meaningless world, we're together!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

205924.description:
In my third life, just before becoming the empire's top councilor and returning to my original world... I was deceived by the emperor, lost my life, and reset back to age three. I refuse to reincarnate again! In my past life, my abilities blossomed, but the problem was I had no one to protect me. My trump card was my uncle, the greatest warrior, who was exiled to the East after contracting an incurable disease...

...my father. Treating him would give me a powerful ally! I hate it with a passion, but it's my last resort. I have no choice but to meet that despicable father who never once came looking for me.

“Father, this is a contract and a deal. I'll cure you if you become my guardian.”

Me... will I be able to return this time?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

205926.description:
Detective Kim Seah is finally about to arrest her parents' killer, the man she's spent a lifetime chasing, when an accident causes her to be reborn as Lady Cersia Emblem. She thinks she'll finally have an easy life, until she is betrothed to Enoch Gray, son of the house that's rivaled hers for generations. Cersia just can't bring herself to like Enoch and keeps seeing her old nemesis in him. Is she bound to this marital pact, or can she find a way to escape her mortal enemy?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Met My Enemy at the Engagement Party
Enemies Meet at the Engagement Ceremony

title.native: 雨と木漏れ日とメゾネット

205928.description:
Qin Feng travels to a parallel universe and finds that the Earth has changed and elementalists have become the masters of humanity. Relying on the awakened system, Qin Feng embarks on the path of escalating from the bottom to becoming a god!

(Source: KuaiKan, translated)

205929.description:
Reeling from the shock of waking up in labor, a woman realizes that she is in the body of Princess Etricia Lette, the anti-heroine of a novel she never finished. The only thing she recalls is that Etricia had countless suitors, so the father of her baby girl, Loustina, is a mystery, but he could be one of four powerful men. Is it the captain of the imperial knights, the prince of a neighboring country, the master of the mage tower, or a descendant of dragons? Who will Loustina call father?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: この子のパパは誰ですか？

205930.description:
Will was once the world’s greatest healer, but he could not use offensive magic and always had to rely on his comrades in battle. Even though he healed their wounds, their spirits eventually broke, humanity lost its way to fight, and the human side was defeated by the Demon King’s army. Just as Will is prepared to die, he regresses to just before the entrance ceremony of a magic academy. “This time, I’ll fight with my own hands.” With that vow, he chooses not the healing academy he once attended, but the prestigious offensive‑magic school, Schwarz Academy. Although he still cannot use normal attack magic, he discovers a way to convert healing magic into offensive techniques and gradually distinguishes himself as a prodigy. Thus begins a healer’s overpowered comeback story, starting from regression and turning the tables at an offensive magic academy.

(Source: Piccoma, translated)
synonyms: The Top Healer of the Offensive Magic Academy

title.native: 攻撃魔法学園の首席ヒーラー

205931.description:
Somewhere in the far, far away universe. In a floating castle there lives a queen and many residents who protect her. Kurukuru, who works as a corpse disposal officer in the castle, one day becomes friends with the queen, a person he never expected to meet...!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

205934.description:
Sakura-chan is a reliable girl who easily gets depressed, and Rakuraku-chan is a carefree girl who seems carefree. More than friends, less than lovers. Two girls living together in a relaxed atmosphere.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

205935.description:
The truth exposed in the twilight between dream and reality... Hana, high in the class hierarchy, is suddenly transported to a mysterious world by Kaburaya's dark magic...!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

205936.description:
Overnight, the world is plunged into an apocalyptic Ice Age. In his past life, Gavin Clark perished from the cold and starvation. But reborn one month before the catastrophe, he stockpiles supplies, unlocks abilities, and builds a survival fortress. As the frost descends and chaos erupts, Gavin rests in warmth and comfort, his safe house a paradise in a frozen hell.

(Source: Webnovel)

205939.description:
Zhuang Nainai has returned to the Gu Group. However, her new family demands that she woos and wins the heart of the Dihao Group's CEO, Si Zhengting, with her adoptive mother at stake. Yet, not only was Si Zhengting promised to her in an arranged marriage when they were young, but he was also her first love, five years ago. How will Zhuang Nainai solve Si Zhengting, given their history, while under pressure from her family? Can she see where her heart is leading her?

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: 推倒总裁的一千种姿势
A Thousand Postures of Knocking Down the President

205940.description:
Orphaned and alone, she thought she'd hit the jackpot when a wealthy family claimed her as their long-lost daughter. Instead, she walked into a nightmare. Her parents ignored her, her brother tormented her, and when push came to shove, they threw her in prison to save their beloved adopted daughter. Big mistake. She's back with deadly new skills and zero patience for their games. Her so-called family is about to learn what happens when they mess with the wrong girl.

(Source: WebComics)

205950.description:
"I want to see more of your facial expressions."

At the request of her brother, an editor, unemployed Matsukita Karan (24) is tasked with looking after Sakurada Mone, a very popular handsome BL author. Mone is said to be a difficult genius, and although he lacks common sense, he has an incredible passion for his work. But... he never knew that all this and that was part of the job! As he touches her all over, the professor's heat flows into her... what should she do? If this keeps up, she'll be at Mone's mercy...?!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

205951.description:
Hibiki, 28 years old, was dumped by her boyfriend she'd been going out with for five years, but Yusa, her junior at the office makes a fierce move on her saying that he had his sights on her for a long time. He's usually cute, but he's sexually aggressive between the sheets. A secret office romance with a wicked handsome junior begins.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

205952.description:
Fluffy attire, idol-like features, and just how darn good they look in the color pink. These are the things Karen loves in girls — something the woman waiting for her at home is lacking. What gives? A short and sweet heartwarming story about the unpredictability of love.

(Source: Yuri Hub)

205960.description:
After his grandparents—the last of his family—pass away, Kariya finds himself free to discover what awaits outside the harsh confines of his remote mountain village. However, beyond its borders lies a world embroiled in the fires of war, and Kariya is conscripted into the army before he can take his first step toward freedom. It doesn’t take him long to realize the truth: this world is a near carbon copy of a game he played in his previous life. When his identity as a reincarnated player comes to light, Kariya is tasked with a perilous mission to escort Wald, a handsome prince disguised as his twin sister the princess, safely through enemy territory and back to the royal capital. But Kariya isn’t the only one who knows the secret of this world—and having the combat proficiency of a common NPC won’t keep anyone safe. Armed only with player foresight and the skills of an S-tier craftsman, he’ll need every ounce of cunning he can muster to turn the tides of battle and bring his prince home.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

205968.description:
Kohaku, outcast of the White Tiger Clan, once shared an unbreakable bond with Seiryu, chieftain of the Dragon Clan and lord of the beastfolk. As children, Seiryu was the only one who made Kohaku feel like he belonged. But the centuries have driven them apart—Seiryu now hides behind the facade of a constant smile, and Kohaku can no longer trust his heart to the whims of another. On the rare occasions that the two met, Seiryu would casually propose marriage, only for Kohaku to refuse, unwilling to believe in his cavalier promises. However, things change when Kohaku finds himself next in Seiryu’s long line of matchmaking partners. Despite everything, nothing could have prepared Kohaku for the secret Seiryu has been hiding for all these years. As the truth begins to unravel, can Kohaku finally understand his old friend’s feelings? Or have time and trauma already doomed their chance at happiness?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.english: The Azure Dragon's Devotion: An Offering of Three Centuries to You
title.native: 青龍の献身 ~ 貴方に捧げる300年

205969.description:
Seo-U always knew that running away from the son of a murderer would eventually haunt her, but she never expected to be locked underground with him. Years after she abandoned Won-Hyeok following a bloody secret on some stairs, a twist of fate traps them together in the suffocating darkness of an abandoned bunker. As the heavy door clicks shut, Seo-U must decide if the boy she betrayed is here to finally protect her, or if he’s been waiting all these years to exact his revenge.

(Source: WEBTOON)

205971.description:
Harboring deep hatred for his master, Gu Lingxiao, a rebellious immortal disciple, brutally slaughtered all his fellow disciples and imprisoned his once-beloved master, Chi Ning. Angered by Lingxiao’s ruthless killings and his choice to seek power through demonic cultivation, the Way of Heaven descended three Thunder Tribulations upon him—an event guaranteed to take one’s life. Yet, on the brink of Lingxiao’s death, Chi Ning stood before him, willing to sacrifice his own soul to save this demon.

(Source: WebComics)

205973.description:
Leicia is a famed genius mage who rules over the magic tower. However, when her own pupil betrays her, Leicia’s soul wakes up in the body of Grand Duchess Priscilla Eckhart. Unfortunately, Priscilla’s body cannot wield magic, so Leicia needs to take the long way around to getting her body back and restoring the Grand Duchess’s soul as well. The odd complication is Calix Eckhart, who is intent on finding out who is in his wife’s body, even if it means hiding his own identity to do so. Will this tag-team succeed in restoring their original lives?

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: 大公妃になった魔塔主

205975.description:
Kadowaki Yukina is a hardcore online game nerd, and recently she's become addicted to "Iluse," an online RPG game using VR avatars! She logs in every day under the handle name "Shirayuki." The reason she's so addicted to it is because she's acquired a "secret skill"! This secret skill allows VR avatars that normally wouldn't be able to touch each other to interact, meaning she can do naughty things with the avatars! But she must keep this a secret from her coworkers! Because, in her everyday life, she's a 30-something virgin!!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

205977.description: Keisuke decided to get married when Ayaka was transferred to Matsuyama. They started their married life without even living together, and while Ayaka was hard at work, she lived with her parents before marriage and was not good at housework. Because Ayaka loves alcohol and is a big eater, Keisuke decided to teach her cooking remotely on the weekends. They cooked together, ate together, and enjoyed a delicious time...or so they thought, but their beloved Ayaka was on the other side of the screen. Keisuke's frustration was growing, and what would Ayaka think...?

205979.description:
The assistant teacher that she hates turns out to be a fellow writer with whom she continued to create in a genre of her favorite game that has since been discontinued --!? Just as tensions begin to build between high school girl artist Kumai and high school teacher Shirokawa, a certain project is announced by the official website for the discontinued content...

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

205980.description:
The Blanket Kingdom and the Laculus Empire are rival nations. Toto, the princess of the Blanket Kingdom, and Rayona, the princess of the Laculus Empire, both become apprentices to the great wizard Ozuno. But after three years as his apprentice, all he's taught them is the magic to produce a little salt water and a little wind...

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

205981.description:
Nekomiya Shion, a second-year high school student, is spending her days bored. Then, a sheltered young lady with love on the brain, Kami Rurika, transfers to her school. As she is led around by the unpredictable young lady, her school life begins to change little by little...!?

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

205982.description:
"I have a capsule toy!!!"

Having failed to get off to a good start, Kashima Shizuka has become a complete loner at school. Her only joy is spinning her favorite capsule toy. Today, she headed to the capsule toy section with her pocket money, but for some reason, she found Kamiya Kaede, the most popular boy in her class, there !?

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

205983.description:
Yua, a high school girl who has always been treated like a boy because of her large physique, falls in love with Haruto, the only boy who treats her like a girl. Meanwhile, Yua discovers the unexpected kindness of Neko-kun, a very dangerous person in her class...

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

205988.description:
One day, Yoh meets Nana, a cheerful mermaid. They go to the movies together and he teaches her how to read and write, but then Nana says she wants to go to an event in town. The next day, Nana appears in front of Yoh with legs! Yoh enjoys spending time with Nana, but at the same time...

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

205989.description:
Appearing in a film by the talented director Hyeon Jung-Hui is every actor's dream. Yeon-Woo, a longtime fan, gets a chance to audition for Jung-Hui's new film by accident. But the audition was actually a setup by the casting director to offer Jung-Hui sexual favors. Unaware of this, Yeon-Woo, hearing Jung-Hui's mocking words telling him to seduce him, naturally assumes it's acting and obediently climbs on top...

“What? You didn't prepare? You want me to undo your belt too?”

A romance where a prickly older man peels away layer after layer of a cheeky young man's charm.

Twenty-year-old So-Hui, with no sexual experience but a lustier than anyone else, dreams of being smitten by a powerful man! However, this dream faces many obstacles.

Harvey scrapes by working part-time at a fast-food joint. His only escape from this grueling life? Watching band performances! Then one day, through some incident, he gets tangled up with Logan, the vocalist of his idol band Vanilla Sunday...

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

205993.description:
Today too, he tried hard to strike up conversations, but due to his faint presence, Ha-Woon returned home without speaking to anyone. Lying in bed, tears streaming down his face from loneliness, he suddenly felt a hand patting him gently from above his head. That's how Ha-Woon became aware of the ghost Kwon Gi-Jin. At first, he pretends not to know, but so lonely, he ends up spending the night with Gi-Jin, who is always affectionate toward him...

“Hey... Can't you just stay by my side forever?”
